title: Credit Controller
description:
**Company Description**
PKV A$OCIATES | Compatriot Consultants (Contact Strictly through WhatsApp @ 9496439703) is a professional services firm focused on delivering reliable finance and business support solutions to clients across diverse sectors. The organization emphasizes strong financial governance, compliance, and operational efficiency to help clients manage risk and improve performance. Team members work in a structured yet collaborative environment, with opportunities to contribute to client-facing projects and internal process improvements. The firm values integrity, accuracy, and client service, creating a workplace where finance professionals can build their expertise and grow their careers.

**Role Description**
The Credit Controller role is a full-time, on-site position based in Kochi. The Credit Controller will monitor customer accounts, evaluate creditworthiness, and ensure timely collection of outstanding payments. Day-to-day responsibilities include tracking debtors, following up on overdue accounts, resolving billing and payment queries, and maintaining accurate records in financial systems. The role involves preparing credit reports, coordinating with finance and sales teams, and recommending credit limits and terms based on risk assessments. The Credit Controller will also support month-end closing activities, contribute to cash flow forecasting, and help refine credit control procedures to reduce bad debt and improve collection efficiency.

**Qualifications**

* Strong credit control and debt collection skills, including experience managing debtor accounts and overdue payments.
* Knowledge of credit management practices, such as assessing creditworthiness and setting appropriate credit limits and terms.
* Solid finance foundations, including understanding of accounts receivable, cash flow, and basic accounting principles.
* Proficiency with spreadsheets and financial software, and ability to maintain accurate, well-organized records.
* Effective communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to handle difficult conversations professionally.
* Attention to detail, analytical thinking, and a structured approach to prioritizing multiple accounts and deadlines.
* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Finance, Accounting, Business, or a related field is preferred.
* Experience in a similar credit control or finance role, particularly within corporate or consulting environments, is an advantage.

title: Human Resources Executive
description:
**Company Description**
G3 Renewables (G3R) is an ISCC EU certified producer of sustainable animal feed, nutraceuticals, and biofuels, built around a holistic, zero-waste approach to food waste management and processing. The organization is strongly R&D driven, prioritizing continual growth through cutting-edge technologies, including AI integration and process innovation. G3R focuses on transforming conventional food waste management into a mainstream, scalable ecosystem that supports a cleaner and greener future. Team members join a disruptive, mission-led environment that encourages new ideas, challenges existing norms, and contributes directly to sustainable impact.

**Role Description**
The Human Resources Executive is a full-time, on-site role based in Coimbatore, handling both Kochi and Coimbatore plant, responsible for supporting and enhancing the end-to-end HR function at G3 Renewables. This role involves managing day-to-day HR operations, including employee onboarding and offboarding, maintaining HR records, and coordinating payroll and benefits administration with relevant stakeholders. The Human Resources Executive will handle employee relations by addressing workplace concerns, supporting performance management processes, and helping to foster a positive, inclusive culture aligned with the company’s sustainability-driven mission. Responsibilities include implementing and updating HR policies and procedures, ensuring compliance with local labor regulations, assisting in recruitment and selection, organizing training and development initiatives, and supporting HR data reporting and documentation for management. The role requires close collaboration with leadership and operational teams to ensure HR practices effectively support organizational growth and employee engagement.

**Qualifications**

* Experience 2 to 3 yrs
* Strong foundation in Human Resources (HR) and HR Management, with experience supporting core HR functions in a growing organization.
* Hands-on experience in HR Operations, including onboarding, documentation, HR information systems, and coordination of payroll and benefits.
* Demonstrated skills in Employee Relations, including addressing concerns, facilitating conflict resolution, and promoting an inclusive, respectful workplace.
* Ability to develop, interpret, and implement HR Policies while ensuring adherence to applicable employment laws and regulations.
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field; HR certifications are an advantage.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively across different teams and levels of the organization.
* Proficiency in MS Office and familiarity with HR software or HRIS platforms; comfort working with HR data and basic reporting.
* Detail-oriented, organized, and able to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced, innovation-driven environment, preferably within sustainability or manufacturing sectors.

title: Test Lead
description:
**Job Summary**
This hybrid role is for a seasoned Test Lead with ten to twelve years of experience in complex embedded environments focusing on Windows XP Embedded automation using Python and Robot Framework and Embedded C validation. The Test Lead will oversee end to end test planning and execution assure high quality delivery for research and clinical products and collaborate closely with cross functional teams while working primarily in a day shift with no travel requirements.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead the design and maintenance of comprehensive test strategies for embedded solutions built on Windows XP Embedded to ensure robust functionality performance and reliability across all targeted configurations and use cases.
* Oversee the planning and execution of manual and automated test cycles using Robot Framework and Python automation to deliver predictable and repeatable validation outcomes that align with project milestones and quality benchmarks.
* Provide technical guidance on the implementation of test scripts in Python and Embedded C to verify firmware behavior interface stability and error handling while ensuring traceability from requirements to test cases.
* Drive continuous improvement of the automation framework by extending reusable Python libraries and Robot Framework resources that simplify test development and reduce execution time for regression cycles.
* Coordinate defect management activities by reviewing failures with development and research teams analyzing logs and traces from embedded systems and ensuring timely resolution and retest of defects with clear documentation.
* Collaborate with research and product teams in R and D as well as preclinical and clinical domains to understand user scenarios regulatory expectations and product risks then translate them into meaningful test coverage and risk based prioritization.
* Ensure that hybrid work execution remains efficient by using secure remote access methods clear communication in English and structured reporting practices that keep all stakeholders informed during day shift operations.
* Prepare detailed test reports and metrics that highlight coverage defect trends automation effectiveness and readiness for release enabling informed decisions that protect user safety and enhance societal trust in the company products.
* Support test environment setup and maintenance for embedded platforms by installing builds configuring hardware and interfaces and validating that test beds mirror intended production conditions for accurate results.
* Contribute to product and process quality by identifying opportunities to refine requirements improve design testability and promote early defect detection within the overall development lifecycle.
* Guide junior test engineers in applying structured test design techniques for embedded software fostering consistent use of automation clear documentation standards and effective collaboration without formal people management responsibilities.
* Participate actively in cross functional discussions to clarify issues propose test optimizations and align on release criteria ensuring that test insights directly support business goals and positive impact on end users.
* Champion the use of systematic risk assessment in embedded testing by mapping potential failure modes to targeted test scenarios thereby reducing field issues and enhancing safety for clinical and preclinical applications.

**Qualifications**

* Demonstrate strong hands on experience in testing solutions based on Windows XP Embedded with a proven track record of validating system behavior resource constraints and peripheral interactions in complex setups.
* Exhibit advanced proficiency in Robot Framework by designing modular test suites keyword driven scenarios and robust automation pipelines that integrate seamlessly with continuous integration tools.
* Apply expert level Python and Python automation skills to build maintainable test scripts utilities and automation harnesses that enable scalable regression testing and efficient analysis of test outputs.
* Show solid understanding of Embedded C principles including memory management real time constraints and hardware abstraction so that test cases and automation can effectively validate embedded software behavior.
* Bring domain awareness of R and D as well as preclinical and clinical environments by appreciating safety considerations data integrity needs and validation expectations that shape test strategies and documentation.
* Utilize excellent English reading writing and speaking skills to communicate requirements defects risks and test results clearly with global stakeholders in a hybrid work setting.

**Certifications Required**
ISTQB Advanced Test Analyst or Certified Test Automation Engineer or equivalent certification in software testing and automation.

title: Resources Manager
description:
**About the Role :**
The RMG Lead is a critical enabler of delivery excellence. You will own the resource management function end-to-end — ensuring seamless fulfilment of project demands, optimising workforce utilisation, and partnering with leadership to future-proof the organisation's talent supply.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1/ Demand & Supply Management**

a/ Drive real-time visibility into open demands and available talent supply across all practices.

b/ Own the fulfilment lifecycle — from demand intake to deployment — including staffing, backfill, and internal mobility.

c/ Lead weekly and monthly resource review cadences with delivery managers and practice heads.

d/ Work closely with Talent Acquisition to bridge gaps that cannot be covered internally, and ensure SLA adherence on time-to-fill

**2/ Utilisation & Bench Management**

a/ Own billable utilisation targets at the practice and BU level.

b/ Proactively identify bench risks, track ageing, and build action plans to redeploy or upskill idle resources.

c/ Partner with Learning & Development and Practice to align skilling programs to the forward demand pipeline.

d/ Ensure bench employees are engaged, career-pathed, and deployment-ready.

**3/ Workforce Planning & Analytics**

a/ Translate headcount, skills, and project pipeline data into actionable hiring and workforce plans.

b/ Build and maintain dashboards and MIS reports covering utilisation, bench status, demand coverage, attrition, and headcount trends.

c/ Present insights and recommendations to senior leadership on a regular cadence.

**4/ Stakeholder Management**

a/ Serve as the primary point of contact for delivery managers, BU heads, project leads, and HR/TA for all resource-related matters.

b/ Balance competing priorities across stakeholders, negotiate trade-offs transparently, and manage expectations proactively.

c/ Build trust with bench employees by understanding their aspirations and advocating for their growth and transitions.

**5/ Governance, Process & Tools**

a/ Design and continuously refine RMG operating models, workflows, and SLAs.

b/ Ensure data accuracy and hygiene across resource management systems.

c/Champion internal mobility programs and cross-skilling initiatives as strategic levers for demand fulfilment.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* 8–12 years of overall experience with at least 8 years in a Resource Management or Workforce Management role within an
  **500+ employee sized**
  IT services, consulting, or technology organisation.
* Deep familiarity with IT delivery models (Time & Material, Fixed Price, Managed Services) and their direct impact on resourcing strategy.
* Strong technical acumen and JD-reading and role-matching ability.
* Strong command of resource management and HRMS tools; advanced Excel skills.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to synthesise large workforce datasets into clear, actionable insights.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and influencing skills — comfortable engaging VP/Director-level stakeholders.
* Track record of designing and executing internal mobility and bench utilisation programs.
* MBA or equivalent postgraduate degree preferred; Bachelor's degree in any discipline is required

**Benefits:**

1/ High-visibility, high-impact position that sits at the crossroads of people strategy and business delivery.

2/ Direct line of sight to senior leadership, influence over how the organisation deploys its most important asset — its people

3/Fast growth trajectory for strong performers.

4/ Exposure to diverse technology domains and global clients.

5/ Competitive CTC, performance bonus, and health benefits.

title: SAP GRC/Security
description:
**Job Summary**
This hybrid role for a Technology Architect focuses on designing and governing secure SAP landscapes with a strong emphasis on SAP Security SAP GRC Access Control and ABAP Authorization for complex enterprise environments. The architect will translate business risk requirements into scalable security architectures ensure robust compliance controls and guide implementation teams toward sustainable solutions that protect critical data assets while enabling efficient business operations.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design comprehensive SAP security architectures that align with enterprise risk posture and compliance objectives while supporting scalable business processes across multiple SAP systems and modules
* Oversee configuration and optimization of SAP GRC Access Control components to enforce risk based access policies and ensure consistent governance of user provisioning and access review activities
* Provide expert guidance on ABAP Authorization design including roles creation authorization objects and permission strategies that minimize risk exposure and streamline access management workflows
* Drive end to end assessment of existing SAP security controls and GRC frameworks to identify gaps recommend remediation actions and prioritize enhancements that strengthen overall security resilience
* Develop detailed security design documents and standards that describe roles segregation of duties rules workflow configurations and control mechanisms for implementation teams to follow
* Collaborate closely with functional consultants and technical developers to embed security and authorization requirements into solution designs ensuring traceability to regulatory and business obligations
* Coordinate periodic reviews of user access risk violations audit findings and compliance reports generated through SAP GRC and related tools translating insights into actionable improvement plans
* Guide performance optimization and stability of authorization checks in ABAP and SAP applications ensuring secure operations without compromising response times or user experience in day to day business activities
* Implement robust controls for transport management change governance and emergency access handling in SAP landscapes to reduce operational risk and maintain strong audit readiness across environments
* Support hybrid work model collaboration by establishing secure connectivity guidelines device access standards and data protection practices that enable flexible working while safeguarding sensitive information
* Contribute to company purpose by designing security solutions that protect mission critical data and processes enabling reliable delivery of products and services that positively impact clients and communities
* Advise stakeholders on how domain understanding of data models and computational biology can be securely integrated with SAP platforms where relevant ensuring appropriate protection of research and analytical data assets
* Document architecture decisions patterns and security baselines in a clear and reusable form that helps teams sustain secure operations and reduces future onboarding time for new initiatives

**Qualifications**

* Possess extensive experience in SAP Security across multiple modules with proven ability to design and maintain complex role structures and authorization concepts for large scale organizations
* Demonstrate strong hands on expertise in SAP GRC Access Control including configuration of risk rules user provisioning workflows access risk analysis and periodic access review processes
* Show advanced proficiency in ABAP Authorization concepts including authorization objects role design field level restrictions and troubleshooting of authorization issues in custom and standard applications
* Bring practical exposure to enterprise data models with capability to interpret how data structures and relationships influence access control strategies and security design for business critical information
* Exhibit familiarity with computational biology or similar analytical domains enabling secure handling of research data models and specialized workflows where they intersect with SAP and related systems
* Display solid understanding of compliance frameworks and audit requirements relevant to SAP environments such as risk management controls and documentation standards that support external and internal reviews
* Apply strong problem solving communication and collaboration skills to work effectively in a hybrid setting coordinating with cross functional teams and stakeholders across locations and time zones
* Utilize minimum ten years and up to fourteen years of progressive experience in SAP technology and security architecture to independently drive complex assignments and deliver dependable outcomes for the organization

**Certifications Required**
Preferred certifications include SAP Certified Technology Specialist SAP System Security Architect and SAP GRC Access Control certification or equivalent security focused credentials

title: Assistant Payroll Manager
description:

**Industry:**

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a detail-oriented Payroll Executive / Payroll Manager to manage end-to-end payroll operations, statutory compliance, salary processing, employee compensation and payroll reporting across multiple units. * Prepare salary bank files, salary statements and ledger reports.

**2. Statutory Compliance**

* Prepare and verify Provident Fund (PF), Employees’ State Insurance (ESI) and Professional Tax reports and challans.
* Ensure timely statutory payments and compliance with applicable regulations.
* Reconcile statutory reports with payroll records and coordinate with unit HR teams and Corporate Accounts.

**3. Payroll Taxation and Reporting**

* Prepare monthly and quarterly TDS reports and tax computation statements.
* Coordinate Form 16 distribution and employee tax-related activities.
* Manage tax regime selection and investment proof submission processes.
* Upload bonus, LTA, medical allowance and incentive details for tax calculations.

**4. Compensation and Benefits Administration**

* Prepare annual bonus and ex-gratia calculations and payment statements.
* Manage LTA and medical allowance payment reports.
* Prepare annual increment and promotion reports and employee communication letters.
* Coordinate annual gratuity renewals and process gratuity claims.

**5. Attendance and Employee Data Management**

* Monitor monthly attendance regularization and follow up with employees.
* Coordinate with unit HR teams to ensure accurate and timely payroll inputs.
* Provide salary slips, payroll cost reports and other payroll-related information as required.
* Coordinate payroll system updates and employee tax declaration activities.

**6. Payroll Coordination and Process Control**

* Coordinate with HR teams, Corporate Accounts and the payroll service provider.
* Verify payroll invoices and obtain approval before processing payments.
* Maintain accurate payroll records, reports and supporting documentation.
* Identify payroll discrepancies and ensure timely resolution.

**Required Skills**

* Strong knowledge of end-to-end payroll processing.
* Good understanding of PF, ESI, Professional Tax and TDS.
* Experience in salary reconciliation, payroll reporting and statutory challan preparation.
* Knowledge of bonus, gratuity, increments, LTA and employee benefits administration.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and MS Office.
* Experience working with payroll software or HRMS platforms.
* Strong analytical, coordination and problem-solving skills.
* High attention to detail, confidentiality and deadline management.

**Experience:**
Min - 4yrs

**Qualification:**
MBA in Human Resources (CA also Preferred)

title: R&D Engineer - Electronics & Embedded Systems
description:
**R&D Engineer – Electronics and Embedded Systems**

**Company:**
Perleybrook Labs

**Location:**
Kochi, Kerala

**Employment:**
Full-time, on-site

**Department:**
Hardware R&D

**Experience:**
3–5 years of relevant hands-on experience preferred

**Reporting to:**
VP – Hardware & Application Engineering

**Role overview**

We are looking for an engineer with hands-on experience in electronic circuit design, PCB development, board bring-up and embedded Linux systems.

The engineer will develop and improve hardware for industrial safety products, taking assigned designs from requirements and component selection through prototyping, validation and production handover. The role involves working closely with the Senior R&D Engineer, supporting an Associate R&D Engineer and collaborating with Software, Production, Procurement and Field teams.

**Key responsibilities**

* Translate product requirements into circuit designs, component specifications and testable engineering requirements.
* Design schematics and PCB layouts, select components and prepare BOMs, Gerbers, assembly drawings and manufacturing files.
* Define appropriate PCB stackups and layout constraints, considering signal integrity, grounding, power distribution, protection, thermal performance and manufacturability.
* Bring up newly assembled boards, verify circuit operation, diagnose faults and implement design corrections.
* Configure and troubleshoot embedded Linux systems, including flashing, boot issues, system logs, peripheral configuration and connectivity.
* Integrate cameras, sensors, displays, communication modules and other peripherals.
* Develop or modify scripts, test utilities, interface code and relevant microcontroller firmware.
* Define wiring harnesses, connector pinouts and cable specifications. Review mechanical drawings and coordinate PCB, enclosure and mounting fitment.
* Prepare test plans and conduct functional, stability, power and thermal testing. Investigate field failures and verify corrective actions.
* Evaluate new technologies and components, resolve technical queries with vendors and coordinate prototype fabrication.
* Maintain revision-controlled design files, code, test reports, application guides and production release documentation.
* Support production handover, occasional site validation and technical troubleshooting.

**Essential skills and experience**

* Demonstrated ownership of electronic board development, including schematic design, PCB layout, prototype bring-up and testing.
* Strong electronics fundamentals covering power supplies, analog and digital circuits, component ratings, protection, grounding and decoupling.
* Proficiency in KiCad, Altium Designer or an equivalent PCB design tool, with willingness to work in the company’s design environment.
* Understanding of PCB design rules, return paths, power and ground planes, manufacturing constraints and assembly requirements.
* Hands-on experience with embedded Linux platforms, including board bring-up, peripheral integration and system troubleshooting.
* Practical experience with relevant interfaces such as UART, I²C, SPI, GPIO, USB, Ethernet, CAN and RS485.
* Working knowledge of Python or shell scripting and the ability to understand and modify relevant C/C++ code.
* Ability to diagnose faults using an oscilloscope, multimeter, bench power supply and relevant diagnostic tools.
* Ability to interpret datasheets, schematics and mechanical drawings, including PCB dimensions, mounting arrangements and connector clearances.
* Clear technical documentation, familiarity with version control and the ability to complete assigned development work with appropriate design reviews.
* Ability to use AI tools for engineering research, coding, testing and documentation while independently verifying technical recommendations and generated outputs.

**Preferred experience**

* Successful design and bring-up of four-layer PCBs.
* Camera integration, device trees, embedded module carrier boards or controlled-impedance routing.
* Mechanical CAD experience using Autodesk Fusion, SolidWorks, Creo, FreeCAD or an equivalent tool.
* Industrial electronics development, including EMC/ESD considerations, electrical noise, thermal management and environmental testing.
* Practical integration or deployment of AI models on embedded hardware.
* Experience transferring designs into production and guiding junior engineers.

**Education**

BE/BTech in Electronics, Electrical, Instrumentation or a related discipline, or a relevant diploma supported by strong practical design and development experience.

**Selection process**

Assessment will focus on demonstrated engineering capability and completed projects. Candidates should be able to explain a board they personally designed and tested, their contribution to an embedded Linux system and a technical failure they diagnosed using measurements.

The technical assessment will include a schematic or PCB review and practical troubleshooting scenarios. Non-confidential or anonymised project examples are welcome.

description:

The role combines learning transformation, organisational change management, business development and AI-enabled learning. The successful candidate will work with MENA partners and account teams across government, energy and financial services, with KSA as the primary growth market.

* Pursuit leadership: Creates clear win themes, compelling proposal narratives and realistic delivery approaches.
* Executive communication and facilitation: Leads workshops and presents recommendations with clarity and confidence.
* AI fluency: Uses AI responsibly to improve speed and quality and can shape AI-enabled learning solutions.
* Builder mindset: Is comfortable creating repeatable capability while delivering client work in a lean, growth-stage team.

**Essential**
**QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE**

* Proven end-to-end engagement leadership with responsibility for quality, team, financials and client outcomes.
* Demonstrable experience leading pursuits, developing proposals and shaping learning or change solutions.
* Depth in learning strategy, needs analysis, curriculum and journey design, facilitation, evaluation and capability building.
* Working knowledge of change impact assessment, stakeholder engagement, communications, readiness, adoption and reinforcement.
* Hands-on, responsible use of generative AI and Microsoft Copilot for consulting, proposals and learning work.

**Preferred**

**Preferred / Differentiating**

**WAYS OF WORKING**

* Once deployed to a billable engagement: approximately 70% client delivery and 30% pursuits, proposal support and capability building, subject to engagement commitments and portfolio priorities.

title: Vendor & Hospital Coordinator (Part-time, 3-month start)
description:
About KlanKare

KlanKare is a technology platform that connects families who urgently need medical equipment with trusted surgical and medical shops in their own neighbourhoods. We make renting equipment such as oxygen concentrators safer, clearer in price and easier to arrange, especially for families caring for parents in Kerala.

We verify local shops, coordinate secure delivery and handover, and handle deposits and payments transparently. For distributors and vendors, we bring local rental demand through simple WhatsApp requests, so they can earn more from equipment they already own without changing how they work.

We are starting in Kochi with oxygen concentrators and growing area by area, working closely with distributors, vendors and hospital partners. KlanKare does not provide medical advice.

About the role

We are looking for a Vendor Onboarding & Hospital Coordinator for an initial 3-month part-time contract in Kochi. After a successful 3 months, the role can be converted to full-time. You will find and sign up our first partner shops, build relationships with hospital discharge desks, and be the human link between shops, hospitals and families while we build our WhatsApp automation. For these first three months, you will also handle rental requests and replies by hand.

When you will work

• On-site: 3 days a week (days agreed with you), visiting shops and hospitals in Kochi

• On call: 4 hours a day, 5 days a week, reachable on phone and WhatsApp in an agreed time window

• Duration: first 3 months as a part-time contract, with the option to move to a full-time role after a successful 3 months

What you will do

Find and onboard vendors

• Identify surgical and medical equipment shops, distributors and vendors in Kochi and build a list of leads

• Visit distributors and vendors, explain KlanKare in the regional language, and answer their questions about how it works and how they earn

• Collect and verify shop details, equipment and documents, and walk them through our handover and verification process

• Follow up with interested shops until they are signed up and ready to take their first request

• Track every lead and its stage in a shared sheet, and help us bring our first 10 partners on board

Work with hospitals

• Meet discharge desk and billing staff at hospitals, explain the service, and build relationships so families are pointed to us

Handle requests by hand

• Receive rental requests and pass them quickly to the nearest partner shop by WhatsApp or phone

• Follow up until a shop accepts, and move to the next shop if it cannot

• Confirm delivery, handover and return with the shop and the family, and answer booking and payment-status questions

Report and improve the service

• Send the leadership team a short daily update on leads, requests and problems

• Pass on what distributors, vendors and hospital staff tell you, in the regional language, so we can fix what is going wrong

• Help us document and improve our processes

What you need

• Strong spoken and written English

• Fluency in the regional language, for working with distributors, vendors, hospital staff and families

• Comfortable meeting new people and explaining a new idea to busy distributors, vendors and hospital staff

• Based in or near Kochi, and able to travel to shops and hospitals on field days

• A smartphone, and comfort using WhatsApp, calls and Google Sheets

• Polite, calm and dependable when dealing with stressed families

• Availability for the on-site days and on-call hours

Nice to have

• Experience in pharmacy, hospital work, medical sales (such as a medical representative) or customer support

title: Senior Associate - Resource Management
description:
**Position Summary**
The Senior Associate, Resource Management supports staffing, scheduling, capacity planning, workforce analytics, and resource optimization activities for the India Tax practice. This role works closely with the Manager, Talent Optimization and Tax leadership to facilitate effective resource deployment, monitor capacity and utilization, support staffing decisions, and maintain accurate workforce data.
  
  
The Senior Associate serves as a key contributor to workforce planning efforts by providing reporting, analysis, and operational support to help ensure resources are aligned with business demands while supporting employee development, engagement objectives, and operational excellence across U.S. and India teams.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Scheduling & Staffing Support**

* Support the scheduling of tax professionals across multiple industries within the India Tax team.
* Assist with processing staffing requests and ensuring schedules remain accurate, current, and aligned with business needs.
* Monitor resource availability, capacity, PTO, training, and other scheduling commitments.
* Identify potential scheduling conflicts, capacity constraints, or workload imbalances and communicate findings to the Manager, Talent Optimization.
* Assist with work transitions, reassignments, and workload balancing activities as directed.
* Maintain accurate staffing information in scheduling tools, trackers, reports, and workforce planning systems.

**Capacity, Utilization & Workforce Analytics**

* Prepare and analyze capacity, utilization, staffing, and availability reports for leadership review.
* Track employee availability, chargeable hour projections, and scheduled commitments to support workforce visibility.
* Monitor schedule changes and ensure updates are reflected in timely reporting systems.
* Identify trends in staffing, utilization, and resource availability and communicate insights to support decision-making.
* Support data validation efforts to improve reporting accuracy, workforce visibility, and data integrity.
* Assist in workforce planning activities by monitoring forecasted workload, resource demand, and skill requirements.
* Provide scheduling, utilization, and capacity-related information as requested by management.

**Coordination & Stakeholder Communication**

* Serve as a resource for routine scheduling inquiries from team members, managers, and engagement teams.
* Coordinate with U.S. and India Tax teams to gather staffing information, scheduling updates, and resource needs.
* Build effective working relationships with U.S. and India leadership teams to support resource deployment decisions.
* Facilitate communication regarding staffing conflicts, priorities, workload balancing, and schedule changes.
* Escalate staffing concerns, scheduling issues, or capacity risks to the Manager, Talent Optimization when appropriate.

**Process & Administrative Support**

* Follow established scheduling procedures, guidelines, and best practices.
* Assist with maintaining scheduling documentation, process materials, and training resources.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to enhance scheduling efficiency, reporting quality, and data accuracy.
* Participate in team meetings, scheduling calls, capacity review exercises, and workforce planning discussions.
* Assist with onboarding and training activities related to scheduling tools, reporting processes, and resource management procedures.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in business, Accounting, Finance, Human Resources, Operations, or related fields.
* 2-4 years of experience in resource management, workforce planning, scheduling, professional services operations, project coordination, or related discipline.
* Experience in a CPA firm, tax practice, public accounting, or professional services environment preferred.
* Strong Excel and reporting skills, including pivot tables, data analysis, and report preparation.
* Experience with resource management, workforce planning, scheduling, ERP, or reporting platforms; Microsoft Dynamics or similar systems preferred.
* Excellent attention to detail, organization, critical thinking, and follow-through.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to coordinate across teams and levels.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and shift business needs in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong analytical mindset with the ability to identify issues, summarize findings, and support practical solutions.

**Core Competencies**
Resource Coordination
  
  
Relationship Management
  
  
Schedule Management
  
  
Problem Solving
  
  
Capacity Planning & Tracking
  
  
Business Acumen
  
  
Workforce Analytics
  
  
Time Management
  
  
Operational Support
  
  
Attention to Detail
  
  
Data Accuracy & Reporting
  
  
Adaptability
  
  
**Success Measures**

* Accuracy and integrity of staffing, scheduling, and workforce planning data.
* Timely and effective processing of staffing requests and schedule updates.
* Quality, reliability, and usefulness of capacity, utilization, and availability reporting.
* Proactive identification and communication of capacity constraints, staffing risks, and workload imbalances.

* Facilitate defect triage, prioritization, and resolution processes.

* Validate intelligent workflows, autonomous service processes, and automation capabilities.
* Support adoption of quality engineering and test automation best practices.

**Required Qualifications**
**Must Have**

* Experience developing enterprise test strategies and governance frameworks.
* Deep understanding of:

+ Integration Testing

+ Defect Management

* Experience managing stakeholder expectations and quality reporting.
* Experience working within Agile, Scrum, and DevOps delivery models.

* Experience testing Agentforce implementations.
* Exposure to Conversational AI and Generative AI platforms.

* Think beyond defect identification and focus on business outcomes.

* Enjoy mentoring teams and driving continuous improvement.
* Have excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Champion quality engineering and innovation.
* Are passionate about Salesforce, Agentforce, AI, and Enterprise Service Management.

* Work with cutting-edge technologies including Agentforce, AI, MuleSoft, Salesforce, and Enterprise Automation platforms.
* Influence testing strategy, governance, and quality engineering practices across projects.

* Proven experience gathering and interpreting business requirements.

* Proven understanding of Lean Six Sigma and Business Process Modelling and Notation.
* Knowledge on application building using Python would be an added advantage.

**Ideally, you’ll also**

* Preferably CA/MBA/B.E/B.Tech with 8 to 10 years of implementation and advisory experience on Oracle Cloud ERP/EBS security and controls.

+ Segregation of duty concerns in an ERP environment along with an ability to design SoD (Segregation of Duties) risk libraries, and preparation of remediation roadmaps.
+ System role-design, build security and troubleshoot security defects.
+ Design risk control matrices by conducting workshops with business process owners.
+ Review Oracle ERP IT Application Controls (ITAC) for test of design and test of effectiveness.
+ Identify potential opportunities to automate current ITDM/manual controls leveraging Oracle EBS/ERP Cloud.
+ Deep understanding of regulatory frameworks like COSO, COBIT.
+ Knowledge and audit experience across regulations like SOX, GDPR, CCPA.

* Functional knowledge on Oracle EBS/ERP Cloud Financials, Procurement, Supply chain management, Projects and HRMS is a pre-requisite.
* Sound relevant experience in either an internal or external business analysis role and/or software / technical analysis role or similar, evidenced by adding business value through identifying, analysing and articulating problems and solutions.
* Developed technical knowledge and experience in delivering IT solutions, providing technical advice and understanding user requirements.
* Some stakeholder management experience.
* Ability to simplify data and explain trends through Excel spreadsheets, dashboards, power-point presentations is highly desirable.
* Knowledge of Oracle GRC (Governance, Risk & Compliance) & Oracle Risk Management Cloud (RMC) is highly desirable.
* Working knowledge on Peoplesoft, NetSuite, MS Dynamics and Workday would be an added advantage.
* Willing to learn and work on different ERPs and CRM solutions

**What We Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment with consulting skills.
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 1400 + professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY Consulting practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development**
: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture:**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits**
: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply**

description:
Child Psychologist Responsibilities and Duties:

Conduct psychological assessments to identify and diagnose emotional, behavioural, or developmental disorders in children.

Develop and implement treatment plans that are tailored to the needs of each child, including individual therapy, family therapy, and group therapy.

Provide counselling and support to children and their families to help them manage their emotional or behavioural difficulties.

Monitor the progress of each child and modify treatment plans as needed.

Maintain detailed and accurate records of each child's treatment progress and communicate regularly with other professionals and caregivers.

Provide training and support to other professionals, such as teachers and speech therapists, occupational therapists on how to identify and manage emotional and behavioural difficulties in children.

LISSUN is a dynamic and innovative mental health startup focused on providing comprehensive care for children with neurodevelopmental delays under the sub-brand Sunshine by LISSUN. We are committed to making a significant impact in the mental health and child development space.

title: Human Resources Specialist
description:
**Company Description:**
Katha – Sharing Stories, Scaling Impact is an AI-powered martech platform that helps brands move beyond traditional channels like TV, billboards, and digital ads to become part of real conversations. Through Katha Ads, the company enables personal sharing of campaigns at scale via WhatsApp, along with nano-influencer marketing campaigns powered by hundreds of influencers. The platform focuses on creating authentic, shareable brand stories that are spread by real people within their own networks. Every share, view, and engagement is tracked in real time, providing brands with clear, measurable impact. Katha empowers organisations to reach audiences where they are and turn them into active storytellers for the brand.

**Role Description**

We’re hiring a full-time human resources specialist for the Founders’ Office Team. The role is hybrid, with mandatory travel to Kochi every alternate week for 1-2 days per visit. You’ll own HR at Katha and work directly with the founders to build the function from the ground up.

* **Recruitment (primary focus):**
  Run end-to-end hiring, especially for sales and campaign roles, from choosing sourcing channels to designing screening tasks and structured interviews. Track hiring metrics such as time-to-hire and offer acceptance.
* **Employee lifecycle:**
  Manage onboarding, confirmations, documentation and offboarding, and keep accurate records in our HR system.
* **Payroll and compliance:**
  Prepare payroll inputs and statutory compliance data, and coordinate with the finance team, who handle filings.
* **Policies and processes:**
  Draft and roll out HR policies (leave, attendance, conduct, remote work, POSH) and build workflows that reduce manual follow-up.
* **Performance management:**
  Run review cycles with clear KPIs, and manage performance improvement plans separately from misconduct and disciplinary matters.
* **Employee relations:**
  Handle sensitive matters with proper investigation, documentation and confidentiality, and escalate to the founders when needed.
* **Engagement and retention:**
  Keep a distributed team connected, run feedback surveys, and track attrition and its root causes.
* **HR reporting:**
  Report to leadership on headcount, hiring, attrition and performance outcomes.

**Qualifications**

* 2+ years of HR experience, including independent ownership of HR without reliance on leadership for routine decisions.
* Working knowledge of Indian labour laws and statutory compliance (PF, ESI, TDS, professional tax, Shops & Establishment).
* Prior experience hiring for sales or other non-technical roles.
* Experience supporting remote or multi-location teams.
* Sound judgement, with the discretion to handle confidential and sensitive situations.
* A root-cause, data-driven approach to problems, with a focus on measurable outcomes.
* Excellent communication and conflict-resolution skills in English and Malayalam (other South Indian languages are a plus).
* Comfort in a fast-paced, tech-driven environment.
* Proficiency with HRIS tools (Zoho preferred), Google Workspace and MS Office.
* Bachelor’s degree in human resources, business administration or a related field. MBA/PGDM-HR or HR certifications are an advantage.

title: Charge Entry / Medical Billing Analyst - RCM
description:
**Job Summary:**

We are seeking a detail-oriented and accuracy-focused Charge Entry User to join our US Healthcare Revenue Cycle Management team. The Charge Entry User will be responsible for accurately entering and validating patient charges based on clinical and billing documentation, ensuring that services are captured correctly and submitted in accordance with payer, client, and billing requirements. The ideal candidate should possess strong analytical skills, attention to detail, knowledge of US healthcare billing processes, and the ability to identify and resolve charge-related discrepancies.

This is a strictly Work from Office (WFO) position. Candidates must be willing to work from the company office and comply with assigned shift schedules. Remote, hybrid, or work-from-home arrangements are not available for this role.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Charge Entry & Validation:**

• Accurately enter patient charges into the designated practice management or billing system based on clinical documentation, charge tickets, superbills, encounter information, and client-provided source documents.

• Review and validate CPT, HCPCS, ICD-10-CM, modifiers, units, dates of service, places of service, and other charge-related information for accuracy.

• Ensure all billable services documented for an encounter are captured accurately and completely.

• Identify missing, duplicate, incorrect, or inconsistent charges and take appropriate corrective action.

• Apply client-specific charge entry guidelines and billing rules consistently.

**Coding & Billing Review:**

• Review charge information for consistency with the supporting clinical or encounter documentation available for billing.

• Apply basic knowledge of CPT, HCPCS, ICD-10-CM, and medical billing concepts while processing charges.

• Validate modifiers, units, and other billing elements based on established client and payer requirements.

• Identify potential coding or billing discrepancies and escalate issues requiring coder, client, or management review.

**Claim & Revenue Cycle Support:**

• Ensure charges are entered accurately and within the required turnaround time to support timely claim submission.

• Review charge-related system edits and resolve issues within the scope of the role before claims are released.

• Identify recurring charge-related errors that may contribute to claim rejections, denials, or payment issues.

• Coordinate with coding, billing, quality, AR, and other RCM teams when clarification or correction is required.

**Quality, Productivity & Documentation:**

• Maintain high accuracy and quality standards while meeting established daily productivity targets.

• Perform assigned quality checks and correct errors identified during the charge entry process.

• Document relevant actions, clarifications, and exceptions accurately in the billing system or designated workflow.

• Follow client-specific workflows, standard operating procedures, and management instructions.

**Compliance:**

• Maintain HIPAA compliance and protect patient confidentiality.

• Adhere to applicable healthcare billing requirements, client policies, and company procedures.

• Ensure accurate handling of patient and billing information at all times.

**Required Qualifications:**

• Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent qualification is required.

• Minimum 1–2 years of experience in US Healthcare Revenue Cycle Management (RCM), preferably in Charge Entry, Medical Billing, or a related process.

• Basic understanding of the US healthcare medical billing and claims lifecycle.

• Working knowledge of CPT, HCPCS, ICD-10-CM, and common billing concepts.

• Ability to interpret charge-related documentation and identify missing or inconsistent billing information.

• Proficiency in healthcare billing software and Microsoft Office applications.

**Required Skills:**

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to billing accuracy.

• Good analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to identify discrepancies and follow established correction procedures.

• Good written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to work with large volumes of transactions while maintaining accuracy.

• Ability to prioritize workload and meet defined turnaround times and productivity targets.

• Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

• Experience with PracticeSuite or other healthcare practice management/billing platforms.

• Experience in physician billing, specialty billing, or multi-specialty healthcare RCM.

• Knowledge of medical coding concepts and common CPT modifiers.

• Experience handling charge corrections, claim edits, or billing-related work queues.

• Exposure to payer-specific or client-specific billing requirements.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):**

• Charge entry accuracy and quality score.

• Daily charge entry productivity.

• Timeliness/turnaround time for assigned charges.

• Error and rework rate.

• Charge-related rejection and edit rate.

• Accuracy of documentation and corrections.

• Attendance and adherence to work schedules.

**Location:**
Kochi, Kerala (Complete WFO)

**Shift:**
Day Shift

PracticeSuite is a national, fast-growing cloud computing software company based in Tampa, FL that provides a cloud-based 360°Office Platform to healthcare facilities. PracticeSuite has an agile management team, high employee morale, and high customer satisfaction and retention. PracticeSuite is growing rapidly and is being recognized as one of the 5 top cloud-based systems within healthcare.

description:
**Role Summary**

Alight is seeking a Lead AI Engineer to design, build and operationalize enterprise AI solutions for Business Health, Commercial and Finance. Based in India, this hands-on technical leadership role will improve forecasting, planning, performance visibility and executive decision support.

You will combine structured commercial and financial data with enterprise knowledge to create predictive models, AI agents, retrieval solutions and automated workflows that help leaders understand performance, anticipate risk and act faster.

**Key Opportunity**

* Improve forecast accuracy and risk visibility through predictive models, opportunity-movement analysis and scenario planning.
* Support bookings, territory, quota and capacity planning using pipeline coverage, conversion, deal-size and sales-cycle assumptions.
* Create Business Health scorecards and executive narratives across plan, forecast, pipeline, bookings, renewals, client risk, cost and margin.
* Automate recurring Commercial and Finance analysis, MBR/QBR preparation and action tracking.
* Build pricing, comparable-customer, market and closed-lost analytics for renewals, pursuits and account planning.
* Connect Salesforce, Clari, Power BI and enterprise content through governed GenAI, RAG and agentic workflows.
* Establish traceable, secure and evaluated AI for commercially and financially significant decisions.

**Responsibilities**

* Design, build, test, deploy and continuously improve enterprise GenAI, agentic AI and machine-learning solutions.
* Partner with business and technology leaders to identify and prioritize AI opportunities based on value, feasibility, risk and expected outcomes.
* Establish success measures and value hypotheses, then use results to guide iteration, scaling or retirement decisions.
* Architect scalable LLM applications, AI agents, RAG systems, predictive solutions and supporting data and integration patterns.
* Develop high-quality Python applications, APIs, microservices, integrations and reusable components.
* Design and optimize ingestion, chunking, embeddings, semantic and hybrid search, vector retrieval, grounding and knowledge-management patterns.
* Build AI agents that securely use enterprise data, tools, APIs, memory, orchestration and human-in-the-loop controls.
* Define evaluation approaches for accuracy, relevance, groundedness, safety, robustness, latency, scalability and business effectiveness.
* Implement CI/CD, observability, logging, monitoring, incident response, versioning, and performance and cost optimization.
* Apply security, privacy, governance, explainability, auditability and human oversight throughout the solution lifecycle.
* Create reference architectures, reusable patterns, coding standards, documentation expectations and AI engineering best practices.
* Lead technical workstreams, conduct architecture and code reviews, mentor engineers, and communicate decisions, risks, trade-offs and results.

**Required Qualifications**

* 6+ years in software engineering, data engineering, AI/ML engineering or a related discipline, supported by a bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience.
* Demonstrated experience designing, building and deploying GenAI, agentic AI, RAG or machine-learning solutions tied to defined outcomes.

title: SME-Learning & Development
description:
**Job Summary**
This hybrid role as a subject matter expert in learning and development focuses on creating and delivering training solutions for claims adjudication and health care compliance within provider and payer environments. The position supports night shift operations enabling global coverage while ensuring accurate claims handling regulatory alignment and continuous capability building across multiple functional teams.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design comprehensive training programs that build strong capability in claims adjudication processes for provider and payer operations while aligning with current business objectives and quality standards.
* Develop detailed learning content that simplifies complex health care claim rules and workflows so that new and existing team members can perform adjudication tasks with high accuracy and consistency.
* Deliver engaging virtual and classroom training sessions during night shift hours to support hybrid team members and ensure consistent knowledge transfer across locations.
* Conduct targeted training needs analysis by collaborating with operations and quality teams to identify skill gaps in claims adjudication and prioritize high impact learning interventions.
* Monitor learner performance data and quality audit outcomes to refine course materials and ensure that training directly improves claim resolution accuracy and turnaround time.
* Ensure that all learning content reflects current health care regulations and privacy requirements related to HIPAA so that team members handle sensitive information responsibly.
* Create practical simulations and case based exercises that mirror real life provider and payer claim scenarios to help learners build confidence and decision making skills.
* Provide ongoing floor support during production hours by answering process queries and clarifying adjudication rules so that associates can resolve complex claims efficiently.
* Collaborate with process experts and compliance teams to update training materials whenever there are changes in benefit designs coding standards or regulatory guidance.
* Track training effectiveness through feedback surveys assessments and quality metrics and present insights that show how learning programs support business performance and member satisfaction.
* Maintain detailed training records and documentation that support internal audits and demonstrate adherence to organizational learning standards and regulatory expectations.
* Coordinate with workforce management and team supervisors to schedule training sessions that minimize business disruption while meeting the needs of night shift hybrid associates.
* Support the adoption of digital learning tools and knowledge repositories so that team members can access updated claims adjudication and HIPAA guidance on demand.

**Qualifications**

* Apply strong knowledge of health care claims adjudication rules benefit structures and payment policies to design technically accurate learning content for provider and payer processes.
* Use hands on experience with provider and payer workflows to explain real world scenarios and guide learners in applying policy rules to complex claim situations.
* Apply working knowledge of HIPAA requirements and data privacy expectations to embed compliance guidelines into every stage of the learning and support process.
* Utilize prior operations or quality experience within claims environments to connect training topics with performance outcomes such as first pass resolution and reduced rework.
* Demonstrate proficiency with common office productivity tools and learning platforms to create clear presentations job aids and reference guides for hybrid teams.
* Communicate clearly and inclusively with diverse audiences across global locations while adapting explanations to suit different experience levels and learning styles.
* Show readiness to work permanent night shifts in a hybrid work model while maintaining high levels of responsiveness reliability and collaboration with onshore and offshore partners.

title: Manager – Revenue (Kochi)
description:
**About The Team**
We are building a high-performance Revenue & Marketing pod — a geography-focused business unit that owns end-to-end top-line and bottom-line delivery for an assigned state or cluster. The pod operates like an autonomous business unit: defining local strategy, executing marketing and growth plans, running platform operations, and generating the consumer insights that drive every commercial decision.
  
  
This is not a support function. Every person in this pod owns outcomes — revenue, margin, platform health, or market intelligence. If you are commercially driven, data-fluent, and thrive in a fast-moving execution environment, this team is built for you.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Revenue & P&L
* Own and deliver revenue and gross margin targets for an assigned geography or function within the pod
* Track P&L on a weekly and monthly basis — identify gaps early and course-correct with data
* Drive revenue growth through a mix of new user acquisition, base reactivation, and improved margin per transaction
* Identify and unlock new revenue opportunities — brand partnerships, channel monetisation, and promotional levers
* Marketing, Growth & Campaigns
* Plan and execute user acquisition campaigns to drive installs and first-order conversions at efficient CAC
* Own reactivation marketing for lapsed and install-not-transacted user cohorts
* Design and run CRM, push notification, and in-app messaging campaigns to improve repeat purchase frequency
* Execute on-app promotions, deal constructs, offer panels, and sale events — end-to-end, accurately and on time

* Promote high-margin SKUs and categories to improve the overall GM profile of the geography

* Conduct qualitative research: consumer focus groups, in-depth interviews, and retailer feedback sessions
* Produce competitive intelligence reports — share of wallet, competitor activity, and whitespace opportunities
* Generate data-backed demand signals for new SKUs and assortment decisions
* Platform Health & Fulfilment

* Identify and plug revenue leakage — stock-outs during campaign periods, broken listings, and fulfilment failures
* Coordinate with Supply Chain and Inventory teams to ensure stock availability ahead of activations
* Escalate platform issues — broken listings, payment failures, checkout drop-offs — with revenue-impact quantification
* Own fulfilment SLAs; work with logistics partners to reduce TAT, RTO, and delivery failures
* Analytics & Reporting
* Maintain a real-time revenue dashboard and weekly health scorecard accessible to the entire pod

* Report on key metrics: installs, CAC, reactivation rate, traffic, GM impact, and channel revenue contribution
* Translate complex data into clear, commercially actionable narratives for business decisions

**Who We Are Looking For**

* Engineering degree from a Tier 1/2 institution [IIT (Bombay/ Delhi/ Madras/ Kanpur/ Kharagpur/ Roorkee/ Guwahati/ Hyderabad/ Indore/ Gandhinagar/ Bhubaneswar/ Ropar), BITS Pilani (Pilani/ Goa/ Hyderabad), NIT (Trichy/ Warangal/ Surathkal/ Calicut/ Rourkela), DTU, VIT, NSIT, IIIT (Hyderabad/ Bangalore)]
* 2–6 years of experience in one or more of: revenue management, performance marketing, trade sales, consumer insights, e-commerce operations, or P&L-owning commercial roles
* Strong commercial acumen — ability to connect marketing and operational actions directly to revenue and margin outcomes
* Data fluency: comfortable with Excel, SQL, BI tools (Tableau, Looker, or equivalent), and building dashboards or revenue models
* Experience working cross-functionally across Brand, Supply Chain, Product, and Marketing teams
* Proven track record of execution in a fast-paced, high-accountability environment

Good to Have
  
  

* Prior experience in a geography or zonal business role in e-commerce, Q-commerce, FMCG, or consumer tech
* Exposure to CRM platforms, push notification tools, or on-app promotion management dashboards
* Experience with qualitative research methodologies: FGDs, in-depth interviews, ethnographic observation
* Knowledge of trade economics: margins, sell-through rates, distributor ROI, and channel profitability
* Basic knowledge of Python or R for data processing and analysis
* Proficiency in regional language(s) of the assigned state — advantage for primary research and on-ground activation

**What We Offer**

* Competitive compensation — reviewed based on role level, experience, and fitment
* Direct ownership of business outcomes from Day 1 — revenue, margin, or market intelligence
* Mentorship from senior P&L leaders and a clear pathway to leadership roles
* High-velocity, commercially focused culture built on ownership, experimentation, and speed

title: Senior Executive – Revenue (Kochi)
description:
**About The Team**
We are building a high-performance Revenue & Marketing pod — a geography-focused business unit that owns end-to-end top-line and bottom-line delivery for an assigned state or cluster. The pod operates like an autonomous business unit: defining local strategy, executing marketing and growth plans, running platform operations, and generating the consumer insights that drive every commercial decision.
  
  
This is not a support function. Every person in this pod owns outcomes — revenue, margin, platform health, or market intelligence. If you are commercially driven, data-fluent, and thrive in a fast-moving execution environment, this team is built for you.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Revenue & P&L
* Own and deliver revenue and gross margin targets for an assigned geography or function within the pod
* Track P&L on a weekly and monthly basis — identify gaps early and course-correct with data
* Drive revenue growth through a mix of new user acquisition, base reactivation, and improved margin per transaction
* Identify and unlock new revenue opportunities — brand partnerships, channel monetisation, and promotional levers
* Marketing, Growth & Campaigns
* Plan and execute user acquisition campaigns to drive installs and first-order conversions at efficient CAC
* Own reactivation marketing for lapsed and install-not-transacted user cohorts
* Design and run CRM, push notification, and in-app messaging campaigns to improve repeat purchase frequency
* Execute on-app promotions, deal constructs, offer panels, and sale events — end-to-end, accurately and on time
* Build and manage hyperlocal BTL activation plans tied to regional events, festivals, and seasonal demand peaks
* Promote high-margin SKUs and categories to improve the overall GM profile of the geography
* Market Intelligence & Consumer Insights
* Build and maintain a revenue intelligence framework covering consumer spending patterns, competitive pricing, and category growth
* Lead quantitative research: cohort analysis, pricing elasticity studies, and transactional data mining
* Conduct qualitative research: consumer focus groups, in-depth interviews, and retailer feedback sessions
* Produce competitive intelligence reports — share of wallet, competitor activity, and whitespace opportunities
* Generate data-backed demand signals for new SKUs and assortment decisions
* Platform Health & Fulfilment
* Own platform revenue health KPIs: availability rate, catalogue fill, listing quality, order completion, and RTO
* Identify and plug revenue leakage — stock-outs during campaign periods, broken listings, and fulfilment failures
* Coordinate with Supply Chain and Inventory teams to ensure stock availability ahead of activations
* Escalate platform issues — broken listings, payment failures, checkout drop-offs — with revenue-impact quantification
* Own fulfilment SLAs; work with logistics partners to reduce TAT, RTO, and delivery failures
* Analytics & Reporting
* Maintain a real-time revenue dashboard and weekly health scorecard accessible to the entire pod
* Run weekly sales trend and insights analysis to identify performance gaps and activation opportunities
* Report on key metrics: installs, CAC, reactivation rate, traffic, GM impact, and channel revenue contribution
* Translate complex data into clear, commercially actionable narratives for business decisions

**Who We Are Looking For**
Must Have
  
  

* Engineering degree from a Tier 1/2 institution [IIT (Bombay/ Delhi/ Madras/ Kanpur/ Kharagpur/ Roorkee/ Guwahati/ Hyderabad/ Indore/ Gandhinagar/ Bhubaneswar/ Ropar), BITS Pilani (Pilani/ Goa/ Hyderabad), NIT (Trichy/ Warangal/ Surathkal/ Calicut/ Rourkela), DTU, VIT, NSIT, IIIT (Hyderabad/ Bangalore)]
* 1–3 years of experience in one or more of: revenue management, performance marketing, trade sales, consumer insights, e-commerce operations, or P&L-owning commercial roles
* Strong commercial acumen — ability to connect marketing and operational actions directly to revenue and margin outcomes
* Data fluency: comfortable with Excel, SQL, BI tools (Tableau, Looker, or equivalent), and building dashboards or revenue models
* Experience working cross-functionally across Brand, Supply Chain, Product, and Marketing teams
* Proven track record of execution in a fast-paced, high-accountability environment

Good to Have
  
  

* Prior experience in a geography or zonal business role in e-commerce, Q-commerce, FMCG, or consumer tech
* Exposure to CRM platforms, push notification tools, or on-app promotion management dashboards
* Experience with qualitative research methodologies: FGDs, in-depth interviews, ethnographic observation
* Knowledge of trade economics: margins, sell-through rates, distributor ROI, and channel profitability
* Basic knowledge of Python or R for data processing and analysis
* Proficiency in regional language(s) of the assigned state — advantage for primary research and on-ground activation

**What We Offer**

* Competitive compensation — reviewed based on role level, experience, and fitment
* Direct ownership of business outcomes from Day 1 — revenue, margin, or market intelligence
* Mentorship from senior P&L leaders and a clear pathway to leadership roles
* High-velocity, commercially focused culture built on ownership, experimentation, and speed
* Work at the intersection of marketing, technology, and commerce — in a category with significant growth headroom

title: R&D Engineer – Drone & UAV Technologies (M.Tech – ECE)
description:
**# Hiring: R&D Engineer – Drone & UAV Technologies (M.Tech – ECE)**

**\*Company:\* Interland Technology Services Pvt. Ltd.**

**\*Location:\* Kochi, Kerala, India**

**\*Job Type:\* Full-Time | R&D / Product Engineering**

**\*Experience:\* Fresh Graduates / Final-Year M.Tech Students**

**\*Industry:\* Drone Technology | UAV | Aerospace Electronics | Embedded Systems**

**## About the Opportunity**

Interland Technology Services Pvt. Ltd. is establishing an exciting new technology venture in Kochi, focused on the \*research, design, and development of next-generation Drone, FPV (First Person View) UAV, and advanced unmanned aerial systems.\*

We are looking for passionate, innovative, and technically strong \*M.Tech graduates and final-year postgraduate students in Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE)\* who are eager to apply their academic knowledge to real-world engineering challenges.

This is an opportunity to join an emerging R&D team at an early stage and contribute to the development of innovative UAV technologies, from concept and prototyping to testing and product development.

**## Educational Qualifications**

\*M.Tech / M.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE)\* or a closely related specialization, with a concentration in one or more of the following areas:

1. \*Signal Processing & Digital Electronics\*

2. \*Communication Engineering / Communication Systems\*

3. \*Optoelectronics & Optical Communication\*

4. \*Microwave & Radar Engineering\*

**\*Who Can Apply:\***

- Recent M.Tech graduates (freshers are welcome).

- Final-year M.Tech students currently working on their dissertation or research projects.

- Candidates with strong academic projects, research experience, or demonstrated interest in UAV, RF, communication, or embedded electronics.

**## Key Responsibilities**

- Participate in the research, design, prototyping, and testing of drone and FPV UAV electronic systems.

- Research and develop wireless communication, telemetry, video transmission, and signal-processing solutions for UAV applications.

- Work on RF systems, antennas, communication links, and related electronic subsystems.

- Explore applications of radar, optical sensors, imaging, and sensor technologies in unmanned aerial platforms.

- Support the design, integration, and validation of embedded electronic hardware and communication modules.

- Conduct laboratory experiments, simulations, performance evaluations, and technical feasibility studies.

- Collaborate with the engineering team on proof-of-concept development, prototype integration, and product innovation.

- Prepare technical documentation, research findings, and engineering test reports.

**## Desired Technical Skills**

Candidates with knowledge or practical exposure in any of the following areas will have an advantage:

- Digital Signal Processing (DSP), FPGA, and digital electronics.

- RF communication, wireless systems, antenna design, and microwave engineering.

- Digital and analog communication systems, modulation, and signal analysis.

- Embedded systems, microcontrollers, and electronic circuit design.

- MATLAB, Simulink, Python, C/C++, or relevant engineering simulation tools.

- Software Defined Radio (SDR), telemetry, and wireless video transmission.

- Optical sensors, image processing, radar, and sensor integration.

- UAV systems, FPV drones, flight controllers, or robotics.

\*Prior drone industry experience is NOT mandatory.\* Strong engineering fundamentals, practical problem-solving abilities, and a willingness to learn are more important.

**## What We Offer**

- Opportunity to be part of a new and ambitious UAV technology startup from its early stages.

- Hands-on exposure to cutting-edge drone, FPV, and advanced electronics technologies.

- Opportunity to transform academic research and M.Tech dissertation work into practical engineering solutions.

- Direct involvement in R&D, prototyping, testing, and product development.

- A collaborative, innovation-driven environment with opportunities for professional growth.

**## Ideal Candidate**

We are particularly interested in candidates who enjoy \*building, experimenting, researching, and solving complex engineering problems\*, rather than focusing exclusively on theoretical work.

If you are passionate about electronics, communication technologies, and unmanned aerial systems, we would love to hear from you.

**## How to Apply**

Interested candidates are invited to apply through LinkedIn with:

- Updated CV / Resume

- M.Tech specialization and academic background

- Brief description of dissertation, research, or relevant technical projects

\*Join us in Kochi and help shape the future of unmanned aerial technology!\*

\*Interland Technology Services Pvt. Ltd.\*
