**Fleet Manager – Last Mile Operations**
to manage rider hiring, fleet availability, productivity, and delivery performance across its Quick Commerce Dark Store network in Kerala.
  
  
The role will be the primary point of contact for Last Mile-related matters, responsible for ensuring adequate rider availability, driving productivity, resolving ground-level challenges, and coordinating with recruitment teams and Dark Store operations to achieve business targets.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* 1. Rider Hiring & Workforce Planning
* Drive rider hiring and onboarding in coordination with the recruitment team to meet Dark Store manpower requirements.
* Prepare rider hiring plans based on order volumes, business growth, attrition, and peak demand.
* Monitor recruitment pipelines, joining ratios, and deployment timelines.
* Ensure timely replacement of attrited riders and closure of manpower gaps across locations.
* 2. Fleet Productivity & Performance Management
* Monitor daily rider productivity, orders per rider, login hours, attendance, utilisation, and delivery performance.
* Analyse store-wise and rider-wise productivity trends and identify performance gaps.
* Implement corrective action plans to improve fleet efficiency and delivery turnaround time.
* Ensure adequate rider deployment during peak order volumes and promotional periods.
* 3. Rider Engagement & Issue Resolution
* Act as the primary point of contact for riders and delivery partners for all Last Mile operational concerns.
* Resolve issues related to attendance, incentives, payouts, app access, login problems, and delivery operations in coordination with relevant teams.
* Ensure timely escalation and closure of unresolved rider grievances.
* Build strong rider engagement practices to improve retention and reduce attrition.
* 4. Last Mile Operations Management
* Ensure smooth delivery operations across the assigned Dark Store network.
* Monitor delivery TAT, order allocation, cancellations, rider availability, and service-level adherence.
* Coordinate with Dark Store Managers and Operations teams to address delivery bottlenecks.
* Ensure rider readiness and operational preparedness during high-demand periods.
* 5. Reporting & Data Analysis
* Maintain daily and weekly reports covering rider strength, hiring pipeline, active fleet, productivity, attrition, and delivery performance.
* Track key performance indicators and share regular updates with management.
* Use operational data to identify trends, manpower shortages, and opportunities for improvement.
* 6. Stakeholder Management
* Work closely with Talent Acquisition, Dark Store Operations, HR, Payroll, and delivery partners.
* Establish clear ownership for rider-related issues and ensure timely resolution.
* Drive accountability across stakeholders to achieve fleet and operational targets.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
  
  

* Rider hiring fulfilment and joining conversion.
* Active rider availability and fleet utilisation.
* Orders per rider and rider productivity.
* Delivery turnaround time and SLA adherence.
* Rider attendance and login-hour adherence.
* Rider attrition and retention.
* Rider grievance resolution turnaround time.
* Reduction in delivery cancellations attributable to fleet shortages.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* 5–6 years of experience in Quick Commerce, preferably in Last Mile Operations and Fleet Management.
* Strong hands-on experience in rider hiring, onboarding, deployment, and workforce planning.
* Proven track record of managing rider productivity and improving fleet utilisation.
* Experience managing frontline delivery workforces across multiple locations or Dark Stores.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Proficiency in Excel, operational dashboards, and performance reporting.
* Good knowledge of the Kerala market and local rider availability; Malayali candidates preferred.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced operational environment and manage time-sensitive challenges.

Ideal Candidate Profile
  
  
The ideal candidate is an execution-focused Last Mile professional who can take complete ownership of fleet availability and rider productivity. The candidate should be comfortable working on the ground, coordinating with recruiters, resolving rider issues independently, analysing operational data, and ensuring that every Dark Store has the right rider strength to support business demand.

title: Assistant Manager – Revenue (Kochi)
description:
**About The Team**
We are building a high-performance Revenue & Marketing pod — a geography-focused business unit that owns end-to-end top-line and bottom-line delivery for an assigned state or cluster. The pod operates like an autonomous business unit: defining local strategy, executing marketing and growth plans, running platform operations, and generating the consumer insights that drive every commercial decision.
  
  
This is not a support function. Every person in this pod owns outcomes — revenue, margin, platform health, or market intelligence. If you are commercially driven, data-fluent, and thrive in a fast-moving execution environment, this team is built for you.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Revenue & P&L
* Own and deliver revenue and gross margin targets for an assigned geography or function within the pod
* Track P&L on a weekly and monthly basis — identify gaps early and course-correct with data
* Drive revenue growth through a mix of new user acquisition, base reactivation, and improved margin per transaction
* Identify and unlock new revenue opportunities — brand partnerships, channel monetisation, and promotional levers
* Marketing, Growth & Campaigns
* Plan and execute user acquisition campaigns to drive installs and first-order conversions at efficient CAC
* Own reactivation marketing for lapsed and install-not-transacted user cohorts
* Design and run CRM, push notification, and in-app messaging campaigns to improve repeat purchase frequency
* Execute on-app promotions, deal constructs, offer panels, and sale events — end-to-end, accurately and on time
* Build and manage hyperlocal BTL activation plans tied to regional events, festivals, and seasonal demand peaks
* Promote high-margin SKUs and categories to improve the overall GM profile of the geography
* Market Intelligence & Consumer Insights
* Build and maintain a revenue intelligence framework covering consumer spending patterns, competitive pricing, and category growth
* Lead quantitative research: cohort analysis, pricing elasticity studies, and transactional data mining
* Conduct qualitative research: consumer focus groups, in-depth interviews, and retailer feedback sessions
* Produce competitive intelligence reports — share of wallet, competitor activity, and whitespace opportunities
* Generate data-backed demand signals for new SKUs and assortment decisions
* Platform Health & Fulfilment
* Own platform revenue health KPIs: availability rate, catalogue fill, listing quality, order completion, and RTO
* Identify and plug revenue leakage — stock-outs during campaign periods, broken listings, and fulfilment failures
* Coordinate with Supply Chain and Inventory teams to ensure stock availability ahead of activations
* Escalate platform issues — broken listings, payment failures, checkout drop-offs — with revenue-impact quantification
* Own fulfilment SLAs; work with logistics partners to reduce TAT, RTO, and delivery failures
* Analytics & Reporting
* Maintain a real-time revenue dashboard and weekly health scorecard accessible to the entire pod
* Run weekly sales trend and insights analysis to identify performance gaps and activation opportunities
* Report on key metrics: installs, CAC, reactivation rate, traffic, GM impact, and channel revenue contribution
* Translate complex data into clear, commercially actionable narratives for business decisions

**Who We Are Looking For**
Must Have
  
  

* Engineering degree from a Tier 1/2 institution [IIT (Bombay/ Delhi/ Madras/ Kanpur/ Kharagpur/ Roorkee/ Guwahati/ Hyderabad/ Indore/ Gandhinagar/ Bhubaneswar/ Ropar), BITS Pilani (Pilani/ Goa/ Hyderabad), NIT (Trichy/ Warangal/ Surathkal/ Calicut/ Rourkela), DTU, VIT, NSIT, IIIT (Hyderabad/ Bangalore)]
* 2–6 years of experience in one or more of: revenue management, performance marketing, trade sales, consumer insights, e-commerce operations, or P&L-owning commercial roles
* Strong commercial acumen — ability to connect marketing and operational actions directly to revenue and margin outcomes
* Data fluency: comfortable with Excel, SQL, BI tools (Tableau, Looker, or equivalent), and building dashboards or revenue models
* Experience working cross-functionally across Brand, Supply Chain, Product, and Marketing teams
* Proven track record of execution in a fast-paced, high-accountability environment

Good to Have
  
  

* Prior experience in a geography or zonal business role in e-commerce, Q-commerce, FMCG, or consumer tech
* Exposure to CRM platforms, push notification tools, or on-app promotion management dashboards
* Experience with qualitative research methodologies: FGDs, in-depth interviews, ethnographic observation
* Knowledge of trade economics: margins, sell-through rates, distributor ROI, and channel profitability
* Basic knowledge of Python or R for data processing and analysis
* Proficiency in regional language(s) of the assigned state — advantage for primary research and on-ground activation

**What We Offer**

* Competitive compensation — reviewed based on role level, experience, and fitment
* Direct ownership of business outcomes from Day 1 — revenue, margin, or market intelligence
* Mentorship from senior P&L leaders and a clear pathway to leadership roles
* High-velocity, commercially focused culture built on ownership, experimentation, and speed
* Work at the intersection of marketing, technology, and commerce — in a category with significant growth headroom

title: Teamleader
description:
**👊 We zoeken een teamleader om ons team in het tankstation langs de autosnelweg aan te sturen!**

* Ben jij iemand die niet bang is om de handen uit de mouwen te steken?
* Hou je ervan om een team aan te sturen, verantwoordelijkheid te nemen én tegelijk zelf mee te werken op de vloer?

👉 3x ja? Dan ben jij misschien onze nieuwe
**collega**
!
  
  
**💼 Wat ga je doen?**
Als Teamleader ondersteun je de manager in het dagelijkse beheer van het autostrade tankstation. Samen met je collega-teamleaders draag je verantwoordelijkheid voor de shop, de broodjeszaak én het restaurant.
  
  

* Samen met de Manager en de andere Teamleader(s) stuur je een Team aan. Je motiveert hen door te luisteren en te helpen waar nodig: je bent een echte people manager
* Je zorgt voor de netheid en goede staat van het station (shop/piste), de beschikbaarheid van producten in de rekken en een verzorgde presentatie van de broodjesbar
* Je waakt over het goede verloop van alle activiteiten en de tevredenheid van de klanten
* Je ziet toe op het naleven van procedures en geldende voedselveiligheidsnormen
* Je draait regelmatig mee in shift en verzekert de permanentie samen met de andere Teamleaders en de Manager
* Je neemt deel aan de administratieve opvolging (bestellingen, inventarissen, enz.)
* Je analyseert verkoopcijfers en stelt indien nodig actieplannen op

Kortom: jij bent een
**dynamische leider**
die niet alleen aanstuurt, maar ook zelf meewerkt 💪.
  
  
**🎓 Opleiding & ondersteuning**
Je krijgt alle opleidingen die je nodig hebt om je rol met vertrouwen uit te voeren. Je Manager staat altijd klaar om je te ondersteunen.
  
  
**🌟 Wie zoeken wij?**

* Je hebt enkele jaren ervaring in leidinggeven, bij voorkeur in een voedingsomgeving
* Je bent een echte doener en durft verantwoordelijkheid te nemen
* Je geeft het goede voorbeeld en werkt graag samen met je team op de vloer
* Je hebt verantwoordelijkheidszin, organisatietalent en een flinke dosis energie
* Je spreekt Nederlands en durft klanten ook in het Engels of Frans te helpen
* Diploma is minder belangrijk dan je inzet en doorzettingsvermogen

Iedereen is welkom, zolang je zin hebt om erin te vliegen en je schouders eronder te zetten!
  
  
**💰 Wat bieden wij?**
We waarderen je inzet en zorgen voor een correcte verloning.
  
  

* Loon volgens Paritair Comité 311: tussen € 2598.43 bruto en € 2981.38 bruto, afhankelijk van relevante ervaring
* Maaltijdcheques, bijkomende premies en woon-werkvergoeding
* GSM met abonnement zodat je ook vanop afstand je team kan ondersteunen
* Groeps- en hospitalisatieverzekering, individuele premie, 13e maand, extra verlofdagen
* Een groot bedrijf met goede organisatie, maar een klein teamgevoel in je station
* Uitgebreid opleidingstraject en reële doorgroeikansen 🚀
* Mogelijkheid om ervaring op te doen in andere stations voor extra dynamiek

**✨ Waarom kies je voor ons?**
Omdat we geloven dat wie zich goed voelt, gaat schitteren. Hier krijg je niet alleen een job, maar een loopbaan in een omgeving waar je écht gewaardeerd wordt 🌟.

title: Microservices Architect
description:
**Job Description**
We are seeking an experienced Microservices Architect to perform the role of Engineering Manager, leading the architecture, design, planning, and delivery of large-scale eCommerce initiatives built on a Java-based microservices ecosystem. This role combines engineering leadership, solution architecture, and delivery ownership to ensure successful execution of strategic platform modernization and customer experience initiatives.
  
  
This is a technology-first, hands-on engineering leadership role. The successful candidate must remain actively involved in architecture, technical decision-making, engineering quality, and solution delivery while leading distributed engineering teams.
  
  
**Core Requirements**

* 15+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 5 years in engineering leadership, architecture, or delivery leadership roles.
* Design distributed data architectures and determine appropriate database strategies across relational, NoSQL, cache, search, and event-streaming platforms.
* Familiar with observability platforms like Jaeger, Prometheus, Grafana.
* Define microservices architecture, service boundaries, bounded contexts, and domain decomposition using DDD principles.
* Experience with service mesh technologies such as Istio or equivalent.
* Strong hands-on engineering background in Java and Spring Boot microservices, with the ability to review architecture, designs, APIs, and implementation approaches.
* Experience designing and delivering large-scale eCommerce or digital-commerce platforms.
* Deep understanding of REST APIs, distributed systems, integration patterns, event-driven architecture, and messaging or streaming technologies such as Kafka.
* Strong knowledge of cloud-native architecture and public cloud platforms, preferably AWS.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, DevOps, observability, SRE practices, resiliency, and production operations.
* Strong understanding of database technologies, caching strategies, scalability, performance optimization, security, and high-volume platform readiness.
* Lead technical design reviews and guide teams on scalable, secure, maintainable, resilient, and high-performing solution designs.
* Collaborate closely with SRE and platform engineering teams to drive observability, reliability, performance optimization, capacity planning, and operational excellence.
* Define and enforce engineering standards, architecture principles, development practices, and technical governance.
* Foster a culture of engineering excellence through continuous improvement, innovation, automation, code quality, technical debt reduction, and adoption of modern engineering practices.
* Mentor engineering leads and senior engineers on architecture, design thinking, engineering best practices, problem solving, and technical decision-making while supporting their professional growth.
* Champion engineering quality through code reviews, testing strategies, CI/CD practices, release governance, and production readiness assessments.
* Working knowledge of AI and GenAI concepts and their practical application in software development, engineering productivity, personalization, recommendation systems, and customer experience initiatives.
* Act as the primary technical and delivery leader for customer and internal stakeholders, driving technical discussions, resolving escalations, influencing solution decisions, and building stakeholder confidence.
* Strong stakeholder communication, project planning, risk management, negotiation, and decision-making skills.
* Proven experience leading distributed engineering teams, including offshore teams, and owning complex delivery from estimation through deployment and production stabilization.
* Coordinate execution across cross-functional teams, product & platform teams, and external vendors or partners involved in the client engagement.

title: Specialist, Engineering Services
description:
Being the go-to MEP/CIVIL person
  
  
Are you considered to be the go-to person for all MEP/CIVIL matters? That’s what you’ll be in this role. You’ll manage all activities related to mechanical, engineering and plumbing in terms of planning, designing, procurement, construction, testing and commissioning, and final handover. Your task is to fully understand, collect and deliver clients’ MEP/CIVIL requirements. The design manager in MEP/CIVIL will depend on you to help schedule or plan establishment, value engineer, and design change management. You’ll also assist the contract manager in MEP/CIVIL-related procurement and VO management. On top of that, you’ll support the construction manager in MEP/CIVIL-related installation, site inspection and contractor management.
  
  
Making visions come true
  
  
You’ll develop big ideas that will spark the effective management and successful execution of all phases of a project—from initiating, designing, planning, controlling, executing, monitoring, and closing. You’ll need to carefully identify and take note of our clients’ needs, and figure out what exactly needs to be done. This involves defining the scope of the work and expected outcome, while also detailing all the necessary objectives to get there.
  
  
While you do all of these, you’ll need to keep tabs on company resources used in the projects, and to allocate these resources to complete the project within the budget. You’ll also need to help clients organize and analyze all tender and procurement for all contractors and suppliers; and represent them from the beginning to the end of a project.
  
  
Building strong teams and business reputation
  
  
One of your priorities will be to produce high-performing teams that drive successful project execution. You’ll also represent and promote the company throughout projects and in pursuit of more project opportunities.
  
  
Keeping risks at bay
  
  
How do you deal with risks? You’ll need to identify any potential risks in the MEP/CIVIL field and report them to the Project Manager. It will be critical to design a risk management and solution provision, particularly to identify health & safety issues. You will understand why this is your responsibility.
  
  
**Sound like you? To apply you need to be:**
An MEP/CIVIL pro
  
  
You have a degree in MEP/CIVIL engineering-related discipline or related field, and five years of combined educational and work experience. You also need to have sufficient experience in construction site management, as well as a strong understanding of all aspects of development management including, financial appraisal, risk management, negotiation, etc.
  
  
Do you have a strong background of all aspects of MEP/CIVIL-related management—including the development of MEP/CIVIL project plan and procedures and construction schedules? Are you familiar with HVAC, electrical engineering, and BMS? Do you have knowledge of security system, AV system, and IT system? If your answers are yes, let’s talk.
  
  
A business savvy leader who can walk the talk
  
  
You understand the business well enough, particularly in terms of the systems and tools to use, the best practices and the safety requirements. You’re also knowledgeable of key industries and local market, with the real estate and construction business above all. You also have a basic understanding of the key drivers that push the projects forward, while also considering the client’s business requirements.
  
  
You’ll back up your business know-hows with the necessary communication skills, as you need to regularly do business development presentations to potential clients in both English and Chinese. You’ll also manage site activities, negotiate with contractors, review the legal aspects of contracts, contribute to market analysis, and manage change orders.
  
  
A flexible leader with superb interpersonal skills
  
  
Are you a people person with superb interpersonal skills? You’ll need to create a proactive working environment that not only motivates your employees, but also encourages them to maintain good relationship with clients, communicate effectively with each other, and contribute enthusiastically to the project. You also need to be a results-oriented leader with good problem-solving skills, as well as someone who can nurture positive relationships with all stakeholders involved, including your team members and clients.
  
  
**What we can do for you:**
At JLL, we make sure that you become the best version of yourself by helping you realise your full potential in an entrepreneurial and inclusive work environment. We will empower your ambitions through our dedicated Total Rewards Program, competitive pay and benefits package.
  
  
Apply today!

title: Delivery Manager
description:
**Delivery Manager**

Client Delivery & Operations • Digital Marketing

**Purpose of the Role**

Ensemble delivers digital marketing and AI services to a growing base of clinical and healthcare clients. The Delivery Manager owns the system that keeps that growth running smoothly — making on-time, on-scope delivery the standard across every account by owning intake, planning, capacity, cadence, and quality end to end.

This is a dedicated operations role focused on one outcome: consistent, reliable delivery. It is the foundation that lets clients trust us with more work and lets the team do its best work without friction.

**Reporting**

**Reports to:**
COO / Managing Director

**Works with:**
Account leads, the offshore (India) delivery team, and specialists across SEO, Paid Ads, Creative, Video, Web Development, Content, and AI.

**Core Responsibilities**
**1. Own on-time delivery across all accounts**

•  Hold end-to-end accountability for every client deliverable shipping on time and to standard.

•  Maintain one live view of all work in flight — status, owner, due date, and risk — so nothing stays invisible until it is already late.

**2. Plan capacity and resources**

•  Forecast team capacity against committed work and flag over-allocation
**before**
it causes slippage.

•  Balance workload across the offshore team and specialists; reassign to clear bottlenecks.

•  Translate client commitments into realistic timelines the team can actually hit — push back when they can’t.

**3. Control intake, priorities, and scope**

•  Run a disciplined intake process — no work starts without a clear scope, owner, and deadline.

•  Set and communicate priorities across accounts; resolve conflicts between competing client demands.

•  Catch scope creep early and escalate the trade-off rather than silently absorbing it into the timeline.

**4. Run the delivery cadence**

•  Lead a recurring delivery rhythm (daily standup + weekly account review) that surfaces risk early.

•  Coordinate across time zones so the offshore team stays unblocked and handoffs don’t stall overnight.

•  Track dependencies and escalations and drive them to resolution.

**5. Enforce quality**

•  Review deliverables before they reach the client — nothing ships below standard.

•  For healthcare and clinical clients, ensure work meets compliance expectations (HIPAA-aware handling, compliant tracking and reporting).

•  Reduce rework by catching issues internally, not at the client.

**6. Report to clients and leadership**

•  Give clients clear, consistent status updates — progress, what’s next, and any risks to the timeline.

•  Give leadership an honest, data-backed view of delivery health and where it is at risk.

**7. Build the delivery system**

•  Develop and maintain SOPs, checklists, and workflows so delivery is predictable, not heroic.

•  Continuously remove recurring blockers and improve throughput without simply adding headcount.

•  Mentor coordinators and the offshore team toward accountability and ownership.

**What Success Looks Like (KPIs)**

Delivery health is measured, reviewed monthly, and owned by this role:

**Metric Target**

1. On-time delivery rate ≥ 95% of deliverables shipped by the committed date
2. Rework rate < 10% of deliverables needing rework after internal review
3. Client-reported quality issues Trending down quarter over quarter
4. Team utilization 75–85% (productive, not overloaded or idle)
5. SLA / turnaround compliance ≥ 95% of requests handled within agreed timeframes
6. Delivery visibility 100% of active work tracked in one live source of truth
7. Escalation handling Risks flagged and resolved before the deadline, not after

**Qualifications**

•  Minimum 5+ years in project or delivery management, ideally in a digital or creative agency.

•  Proven track record improving or scaling on-time delivery across multiple concurrent accounts.

•  Working knowledge of SEO, Google Ads, Meta Ads, social, creative and video production, web development, content, and analytics — enough to judge quality and timelines, and to execute hands-on, if essential.

•  Experience coordinating distributed or offshore teams across time zones.

•  Familiarity with healthcare or clinical client requirements (HIPAA awareness) is a strong plus.

•  Strong on process design, prioritization, communication, and stakeholder management.

**Ideal Candidate**

An operations leader who makes delivery boringly predictable. Organized, calm under competing deadlines, hands-on and relentless about removing blockers and building the systems that let good quality work ship on time — every account, every time.

**CTC:**
As per market for the right fit candidate

title: Enterprise  partnerships Lead
description:
Job Description: Enterprise Partnerships Lead
  
  
Company: Glaring Labs (early-stage fintech)
  
Location: Kochi / Mumbai (frequent travel)
  
Experience: 5+ years
  
Reports to: Founder/CEO
  
  
About Glaring Labs
  
  
Glaring Labs is building a new commerce-linked financial product that helps large merchants drive committed customer spend and repeat purchases. We work with regulated banking and financial partners. We're pre-launch and hiring the person who will sign our first enterprise merchants.
  
  
The Role
  
  
You will own enterprise merchant acquisition end-to-end: pitch, commercial negotiation, legal and procurement, and go-live. This is a closer's role, not a lead-generation role.
  
  
What You Will Do
  
  
• Build and close the pipeline. Build and close a pipeline of large enterprise merchants across retail, utilities, fuel, and consumer categories.
  
• Sell at the right level. Sell to CFO, CMO, Head of Loyalty, and Head of Payments, and map the full buying committee.
  
• Negotiate commercial partnership agreements. Own the terms, pricing, and co-marketing commitments.
  
• Build business cases. Show the merchant's revenue, customer acquisition cost, and working capital impact.
  
• Run public-sector processes. Navigate PSU procurement, including empanelment, tenders, and committee approvals.
  
• Coordinate internally. Work with our banking partners and tech team so that what you sell is deliverable.
  
• Drive time-to-live. Push from signature to live integration.
  
• Feed the product. Bring structured merchant feedback into the roadmap.
  
  
Must-Haves
  
  
• 5+ years of B2B enterprise sales or partnerships, with at least 4 years selling to large retailers, PSUs, or national brands.
  
• A proven record of closing multi-crore annual contracts with 6–12 month cycles.
  
• Background in payments, merchant acquiring, affordability or EMI programs, loyalty, or bank merchant partnerships.
  
• A strong grasp of merchant economics, including MDR, settlement cycles, and promotional funding.
  
• Existing CXO-level relationships at large Indian retailers or PSUs.
  
• Comfort negotiating MSAs with legal and procurement.
  
• Malayalam is a plus.
  
  
Good to Have
  
  
• Experience selling to government bodies or state utilities.
  
• Exposure to RBI-regulated products.
  
• Having been the first sales hire at an early-stage startup.
  
  
What Success Looks Like
  
  
Timeline Target
  
90 days 2 enterprise merchants at term-sheet stage
  
6 months 2 merchants signed and live, and a PSU empanelment underway
  
12 months 8+ live enterprise merchants
  
  
Compensation
  
  
Competitive fixed pay, a significant performance variable, and ESOPs.

title: CyberArk Engineer
description:

**CyberArk Cloud Specialist**

**Privileged Access Management (PAM)**

, ensuring secure integration of applications and cloud environments into the CyberArk ecosystem.

+ Onboard enterprise applications into CyberArk for secure credential management.
+ Collaborate with application owners to integrate privileged accounts.
+ Automate onboarding processes to improve efficiency and reduce manual intervention.

+ Integrate cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) with CyberArk for privileged account security.
+ Configure and manage cloud connectors, vaults, and policies.
+ Ensure compliance with organizational cloud security standards.

+ Manage CyberArk components including PVWA, CPM, PSM, and Vault.
+ Perform upgrades, patches, and health checks.

+ Implement best practices for privileged access management.
+ Ensure adherence to regulatory requirements (ISO, GDPR, SOC2).
+ Conduct audits and generate compliance reports.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 5–9 years of IT security experience with strong focus on CyberArk Cloud.
* Hands-on expertise in Application Layer onboarding and Cloud Layer onboarding with CP and CCP configurations.
* Strong knowledge of AWS, Azure, GCP integration with CyberArk.
* Proficiency in scripting (PowerShell, Python, Shell) for automation.
* Experience with Identity & Access Management (IAM) and Zero Trust frameworks.
* Excellent troubleshooting and communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* CyberArk Certified Trustee / Defender / Sentry.
* Experience in DevOps pipelines and CI/CD integration with CyberArk.
* Familiarity with containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes).

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to work on cutting-edge cloud security projects.
* Collaborative environment with exposure to global enterprise applications.

Continuous learning and certification support

title: Senior AI/ML Specialist
description:
**Job title: AI/ML Senior Specialist**

**Location: Kochi (Hybrid)**

**Contract: Permanent, full-time**

**About us:**

Cyncly is a global technology powerhouse with 2,800+ employees and 70,000+ customers across 100+ countries and 46+ offices. Cyncly transforms the way customizable products and spaces are imagined, designed, sold, managed and made. Our end-to-end software solutions connect professional designers, retailers and manufacturers to the world's largest repository of product content. Today, our business spans across the Kitchen & Bath, Furniture, Window, Glass & Door, and Flooring industries with operations in North & South America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Africa.

Cyncly offers over 30 years of experience to deliver more value for our customers through an expanded portfolio of end-to-end solutions. Our global presence allows us to provide world-class support and sales with a local touch, providing the best possible customer experience.

Cyncly is now embarking on an exciting journey as we continue to expand through strong organic growth and complementary acquisitions, backed by leading growth private equity firms specializing in technology

**About the Role**

Cyncly is establishing a dedicated AI Centre of Excellence (AI CoE) in Kochi, India, to build, fine-tune, and operationalize on-premises large language models across Cyncly's product suite. The AI/ML Engineer is a hands-on technical role responsible for training pipelines, fine-tuning domain-specific models, embeddings infrastructure, and integrating AI across five LLM use cases: product knowledge search, document intelligence, Service Desk ticket classification and resolution drafting, developer copilot assistance, and conversational product configuration.

**Key Responsibilities**

**LLM Fine-Tuning & Training Pipelines**

* Implement and maintain supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and RLHF pipelines for Cyncly domain-specific models, leveraging proprietary product catalogue, documentation, and support data.
* Apply LoRA/QLoRA fine-tuning via Hugging Face PEFT; manage model checkpointing, hyperparameter tuning, and training run tracking. Work with quantised models (GGUF, AWQ, GPTQ) to optimise inference on GPU.
* Maintain reproducible experiments, model versioning, and artefact management using MLflow or Weights & Biases; collaborate with Data Engineering to curate and version domain datasets with PII scrubbing and data-quality checks.

**Embeddings Infrastructure & Semantic Search**

* Develop and optimise embedding pipelines using models such as BGE-M3 and E5-large; manage vector database ingestion, indexing strategies, and retrieval quality for Cyncly's product catalogues and documentation.
* Design, benchmark, and maintain vector database deployments (Qdrant, Weaviate, or equivalent), including index configuration, filtering strategies, and scalability planning.
* Implement retrieval quality metrics (MRR, NDCG, recall@k), run A/B evaluations of embedding model upgrades, and build hybrid search pipelines combining dense vector retrieval with BM25 sparse search to maximise product discovery accuracy.

**RAG Architecture & Use Case Integration**

* Design and implement RAG layers for Cyncly's five LLM use cases, ensuring context relevance, faithfulness, and latency targets; integrate MCP connectors to expose internal data sources and product APIs to the LLM inference layer.
* Build and maintain the developer copilot integration using Continue.dev and custom language-server extensions; implement prompt injection defenses, output filtering, and guardrail layers across all inference paths.
* Work closely with Product and Engineering squads to expose AI capabilities through REST/OpenAI-compatible APIs and integrate them into Cyncly's product surfaces.

**Model Evaluation & Quality Assurance**

* Write model evaluation harnesses and regression test suites; track and report quality metrics (BLEU, ROUGE, faithfulness score, hallucination rate, answer relevance) per deployed model and use case.
* Partner with the AI/ML QA team to design human evaluation workflows and validate model outputs before production release; maintain a model leaderboard and evaluation artefacts for all active models enabling data-driven decisions on upgrades and rollbacks.
* Implement continuous evaluation pipelines triggered on model updates, ensuring quality regressions are detected before reaching production.

**Inference Infrastructure & Observability**

* Deploy and manage LLM inference using vLLM or Text Generation Inference (TGI) on Cyncly's on-premises GPU infrastructure, targeting production-grade throughput and latency SLAs.
* Instrument inference latency, throughput (tokens/sec), GPU utilisation, and cost metrics; surface results to operational dashboards for the AI leadership team; participate in on-call rotation and incident response for model-serving issues.
* Contribute to the containerisation and orchestration of AI workloads using Docker and Kubernetes, ensuring deployments are reproducible, scalable, and integrated with Cyncly's CI/CD pipelines.

**Knowledge Graphs & Advanced Data Pipelines**

* Contribute to Cyncly's product knowledge graph (Neo4j) — entity-extraction pipelines, schema design, and graph query integration with RAG; build NLP pipelines to enrich product and document knowledge.
* Explore and prototype agentic AI patterns (tool use, multi-step reasoning) for complex information retrieval and action execution use cases.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5–8 years of hands-on software and/or AI/ML engineering experience, with at least 2 years working directly with large language models or transformer-based systems.
* Strong Python programming skills; proficiency with PyTorch or JAX training ecosystems, and Hugging Face Transformers, PEFT (LoRA, QLoRA), and model evaluation frameworks.
* Working knowledge of at least one vector database (Qdrant, Weaviate, Pinecone, Chroma, or equivalent), including indexing, filtering, and retrieval optimisation; solid understanding of embedding models, semantic search quality metrics, and RAG architecture patterns.
* Experience building and consuming REST/OpenAI-compatible APIs; solid understanding of prompt engineering best practices including few-shot prompting, chain-of-thought, and structured outputs.
* Familiarity with containerisation (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes), and experience working within CI/CD pipelines.

**Mandatory Technical Experience**

* **LLM Frameworks:**
  Proficiency in Python with the Hugging Face ecosystem (Transformers, Datasets, PEFT, Accelerate, Evaluate).
* **Fine-Tuning & Quantisation:**
  Experience with LoRA, QLoRA, and quantisation techniques (GGUF, AWQ, GPTQ) for on-premises model deployment.
* **Inference Serving:**
  Hands-on experience with vLLM, Text Generation Inference (TGI), or Ollama for production LLM serving.
* **Vector Databases & RAG:**
  Practical experience designing and querying vector databases; proficiency in retrieval evaluation and hybrid search implementations.
* **Experiment Tracking & Evaluation:**
  MLflow, Weights & Biases, or LangSmith for experiment tracking and LLM observability; strong background in model evaluation — automated metrics (BLEU, ROUGE, RAGAS), human evaluation, and regression testing.
* **Infrastructure & DevOps:**
  Experience with Docker and Kubernetes; ability to write Dockerfiles, Helm charts, and CI/CD pipeline configurations.

**Preferred / Nice-to-Have**

* Exposure to knowledge graphs (Neo4j, Cypher/SPARQL) for entity extraction and graph-augmented retrieval; experience integrating helpdesk or ticketing platforms (e.g. Zendesk APIs) for NLP-driven classification and resolution drafting.
* Familiarity with agentic AI frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen) or MCP connector development; experience with developer tooling integrations such as Continue.dev, GitHub Copilot extensions, or custom LSP implementations.
* Open-source contributions to ML projects, LLM tooling, or evaluation frameworks; experience with multi-modal or vision-language models (VLMs) for product image understanding.

**Competency Requirements**

* **Engineering Excellence:**
  Writes clean, well-tested Python code; comfortable with code reviews, Git workflows, and contributing to shared ML infrastructure libraries.
* **Analytical & Experimental Mindset:**
  Designs experiments with clear hypotheses, tracks results rigorously, and uses evaluation data to make evidence-based model decisions.
* **Collaboration & Communication:**
  Works effectively with Data Engineers, QA, Product, and Platform teams; communicates ML concepts clearly to non-specialist stakeholders.
* **Ownership & Initiative:**
  Able to take ownership of a workstream, manage ambiguity in early-stage AI projects, and deliver iterative results in a fast-moving AI programme.

**Working for us:**

At Cyncly, we call our team OneCyncly, a reflection of how we work together as one, united by our purpose: powering businesses that bring spaces to life. Our strength comes from our diversity of experiences, perspectives, and skills - and we thrive when we work together with openness, trust, and respect.

Here, you’ll join a group of colleagues who take ownership, solve problems, and focus on making an impact. We embrace curiosity, welcome new ideas, and see mistakes as opportunities to learn. You’ll have the freedom to work flexibly and autonomously, supported by teammates and leaders who are committed to your growth.

We celebrate the different ways people contribute and encourage everyone - from every background - to bring their authentic self to work. Because when we collaborate, challenge each other, and share what we know, we build something better together.

If you want to work in a place where your ideas matter, your growth is valued, and your work shapes the spaces people live, work, and play in - come join us.

title: Software Verification & Testing Lead

We are seeking an experienced Software Verification & Testing Lead to lead software verification, validation, and quality assurance activities for medical device and connected healthcare applications.
  
  
The ideal candidate should have strong experience in software testing methodologies, test automation, requirement traceability, defect management, and regulatory compliance. The role involves ensuring the reliability, safety, security, and performance of embedded software, mobile applications, cloud platforms, and integrated medical device systems.
  
  
‍
  
  
**Key Competencies**

* Strong understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC).

* Experience with test automation tools such as Selenium, Appium, Playwright, or equivalent frameworks.

* Experience in integration testing, system testing, regression testing, and defect management.

* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and team management skills.

Software Verification & Validation
  
  

* Lead end-to-end software verification and validation activities across the software development lifecycle.
* Develop and execute test strategies, test plans, test cases, and verification protocols based on software requirements.
* Perform functional, integration, system, regression, and performance testing.
* Ensure complete requirement-to-test traceability and maintain verification documentation.
* Review software requirements and design specifications to ensure testability and compliance.
* Identify, document, track, and resolve software defects in collaboration with development teams.

Test Automation & Technical Testing
  
  

* Design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks to improve test coverage and efficiency.
* Perform API testing, database validation, and end-to-end application testing.
* Validate data communication and integration between wearable devices, mobile applications, backend services, and cloud platforms.
* Test real-time data acquisition, transmission, processing, and visualization.
* Perform reliability testing, including connectivity interruptions, data loss, recovery, and error-handling scenarios.
* Integrate automated tests with CI/CD pipelines where applicable.

Medical Device Quality & Compliance
  
  

* Support software verification and validation activities in accordance with applicable medical device standards.
* Maintain verification evidence, test reports, defect records, and traceability matrices.
* Participate in risk-based testing and verification of safety-critical software functions.
* Support design reviews, quality audits, and regulatory documentation.
* Collaborate with quality assurance and regulatory teams to ensure compliance with applicable requirements.

Team Leadership & Coordination
  
  

* Lead and mentor software verification and testing engineers.
* Assign testing activities, monitor progress, and ensure timely completion of verification milestones.
* Coordinate with software developers, embedded engineers, system architects, and product teams.
* Review test deliverables and communicate testing status, risks, and quality metrics to stakeholders.
* Drive continuous improvements in testing processes, automation, and software quality.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Mortgage Rate Lock Management:

Process rate lock requests from Loan Officers (LOs) and Loan Processors (LPs), verify loan details (amount, program, interest rate, LTV, FICO, occupancy, property type, and lock period), ensure eligibility and compliance with company policies and investor guidelines, and accurately process new locks, changes, extensions, relocks, and cancellations on time. Monitor lock expirations, communicate confirmations, rejections, and required corrections, and maintain accurate records in the loan origination system.

2. Mortgage Pricing and Rate Sheet Management:

Download and review daily investor rate sheets for dates, pricing adjustments, product availability, and lock periods. Upload and maintain rate sheets and pricing data in the pricing engine. Compare investor pricing with internal systems to identify differences. Review base pricing, loan-level price adjustments (LLPAs), margins, concessions, discount points, and lender credits. Calculate and verify final borrower or broker pricing according to company policies. Provide accurate pricing information to Loan Officers for eligible loan scenarios.

3. Lock Extensions, Relocks, and Pricing Exceptions:

Review and process lock extensions, relocks, and pricing exceptions according to company policies. Calculate extension fees, relock fees, and pricing adjustments. Check lock history, expiration dates, previous extensions, and available free extension days. Process pricing concessions and exceptions only after obtaining the required approvals. Verify approval authority and maintain supporting documents. Communicate applicable fees, pricing impacts, and processing restrictions to the requesting teams.

4. Investor Guidelines and Product Eligibility:

Review investor guidelines and product eligibility before processing lock requests. Verify delegated and non-delegated lending channels, where applicable. Confirm product availability based on loan program, credit score, occupancy, LTV, loan purpose, and other applicable criteria. Identify investor-specific restrictions and escalate exceptions when needed. Coordinate with investor representatives to resolve pricing, eligibility, and lock-related issues. Ensure all pricing and lock activities follow investor requirements and internal policies.

5. Communication and Issue Resolution:

Respond to inquiries from Loan Officers, Loan Processors, Secondary Marketing, and other internal teams. Explain pricing differences, lock rejections, extension fees, and investor restrictions clearly. Follow up on pending lock requests, pricing exceptions, and unresolved system issues. Escalate complex pricing and eligibility concerns to the appropriate manager or authorized approver. Maintain professional communication and meet established service-level agreements (SLAs).

6. Quality Control and Reporting:

Maintain accurate records of lock requests, confirmations, extensions, relocks, cancellations, and pricing exceptions. Check loan details and pricing for accuracy. Prepare daily or periodic reports on lock activity, expiring locks, pending requests, and pricing issues. Follow internal controls, audit requirements, and documentation standards.

**Required Qualifications**

A Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field is preferred.

At least 1 year of experience in U.S. mortgage operations, Secondary Marketing, or mortgage rate lock desk operations is preferred.

Knowledge of mortgage pricing, rate locks, extensions, relocks, cancellations, and Conventional, FHA, VA, USDA, and applicable Non-QM products is required, along with Excel, Microsoft Office, and pricing analysis skills.

Strong analytical, numerical, problem-solving, and communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple requests under tight deadlines are essential.

**Key Competencies & Performance Metrics**

• Strong analytical, numerical, and problem-solving skills.

• Accuracy in mortgage pricing, rate locks, extensions, and relocks.

• Good time management, prioritization, and attention to detail.

• Effective communication, teamwork, and knowledge of investor guidelines and compliance requirements.

• Timely processing of lock requests, quick resolution of pricing issues, and adherence to company policies and service-level agreements (SLAs).

• Accurate documentation, audit readiness, and reduction of processing errors.

**Work Schedule & Location**

Must be available to work according to U.S. mortgage business hours, including the applicable U.S. time zone and market-related deadlines.

Shift Time: 7:30pm to 4:30am IST

Location: Inforpark Phase 2, Kochi

Candidates from Kerala and Tamil Nadu are preferred.

title: Founding Food Sourcing & Export Operations Executive – Spices, Dry Fruits & Grains
description:
Founding Food Sourcing & Export Operations Executive – Spices, Dry Fruits & Grains
  
  
Company: HALBEX Private Limited
  
Location:Kochi / location to be finalised
  
Work Mode: On-site
  
Employment Type: Full-time
  
  
About HALBEX
  
  
HALBEX is building a B2B international export marketplace focused exclusively on halal FMCG food products sourced from India and supplied to international buyers.
  
  
We follow a merchant-trader model in which HALBEX manages the commercial transaction between Indian suppliers and international buyers, coordinating product compliance, seller onboarding, export documentation, and logistics.
  
  
We are currently in the pre-launch stage, preparing for our planned commercial launch in March 2027.
  
  
About the Role
  
  
We are looking for a hands-on professional to join HALBEX's founding team and help build our food sourcing and export operations from the ground up.
  
  
The first priority is to identify reliable Indian farmers, FPOs, processors, millers, and suppliers who can provide export-quality spices, dry fruits, and grains at competitive prices.
  
  
The selected candidate will work directly with the founder and gradually establish the supplier network, product onboarding processes, compliance data, logistics partnerships, and shipment execution workflow required for HALBEX.
  
  
This is a founding-stage role requiring practical execution, independent research, supplier coordination, and ownership of day-to-day operational tasks.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
1. Supplier Sourcing & Price Comparison
  
  
- Identify major sourcing regions for spices, dry fruits, and grains across India.
  
- Find and contact farmers, FPOs, processors, millers, and export-ready suppliers.
  
- Collect comparable quotations and evaluate prices, quality, MOQ, production capacity, packaging, and delivery timelines.
  
- Identify competitive suppliers while ensuring products meet the required quality and export standards.
  
- Build and maintain a verified supplier database.
  
  
2. Product Development & Seller Onboarding
  
  
- Collect supplier company documents and product specifications.
  
- Verify product details, packaging sizes, weights, supply capacity, and export readiness.
  
- Coordinate supplier registration and product listing on HALBEX.
  
- Ensure required information and documents are collected before product approval.
  
  
3. Product-Country Compliance Data
  
  
- Research applicable food-export requirements using official government and regulatory sources.
  
- Develop structured compliance records for each priority product and destination country.
  
- Identify applicable certificates, testing requirements, labelling rules, restrictions, and supporting evidence.
  
- Record source references, verification status, and responsible parties.
  
- Coordinate with the founder and technology team to implement the verified requirements in the platform.
  
  
4. Logistics Vendor Onboarding
  
  
- Identify freight forwarders, customs brokers, shipping partners, and other relevant logistics providers.
  
- Collect and compare freight quotations.
  
- Establish procedures for shipment planning, documentation, and logistics coordination.
  
  
5. Buyer Order & Shipment Execution
  
  
- Coordinate supplier confirmation, product availability, compliance approval, and shipment planning.
  
- Support buyer orders and export documentation.
  
- Coordinate the complete process from supplier selection to delivery.
  
- Help execute HALBEX's first commercial export shipment through the online platform.
  
  
Initial Six-Month Roadmap
  
  
Month Main target
  
  
November 2026 Research sourcing regions and identify competitive suppliers
  
December 2026 Verify suppliers, collect product data, begin seller onboarding and compliance research
  
January 2027 Expand product compliance data and onboard logistics vendors
  
February 2027 Test the end-to-end order and shipment workflow
  
March 2027 Support buyer onboarding and work towards the first commercial shipment
  
April 2027 Review operations, improve processes, and expand the supplier network
  
  
  
These are proposed targets and will be finalised according to operational readiness and available resources.
  
  
Required Experience
  
  
- Experience in food-product sourcing, agricultural commodities, spices, dry fruits, grains, or food exports.
  
- Practical experience identifying and negotiating with suppliers.
  
- Understanding of product specifications, quality requirements, pricing, and supply capacity.
  
- Familiarity with export documentation and international logistics.
  
- Ability to research regulatory requirements and maintain accurate records.
  
- Strong communication, negotiation, coordination, and problem-solving skills.
  
- Willingness to work hands-on in an early-stage startup.
  
  
Preference will be given to candidates with direct experience in spices, dry fruits, grains, agricultural commodities, and export-oriented food sourcing.
  
  
Who Should Apply?
  
  
This opportunity is suitable for someone who wants to build a new export operation rather than simply manage an established logistics department.
  
  
The selected candidate will initially work directly with the founder and take ownership of supplier discovery, product onboarding, compliance coordination, and logistics execution. The team will expand as HALBEX grows.
  
  
Application
  
  
Please apply with your CV and briefly describe:
  
  
1. The food or agricultural products you have sourced or handled.
  
2. The regions or supplier networks you know.
  
3. Your experience negotiating prices and evaluating suppliers.
  
4. Your export documentation and logistics experience.
  
5. Your availability to join a pre-launch startup.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
The SAP TM Transportation Management Senior Consultant serves as a senior-level advisor responsible for leading complex SAP Transportation Management (TM) transformation initiatives for enterprise clients. This role combines deep SAP TM expertise with strategic consulting capabilities to design, implement, and optimize end-to-end transportation solutions that drive operational excellence, cost reduction, and supply chain visibility. The consultant participates in pursuing client sales opportunities and working on bid & proposal efforts along with activities including configuration and setting up the SAP TM system, assessment of client business problems, conducting the analysis to solve the problems, administration of engagement activities while contributing to practice growth and innovation.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Responsible for the successful delivery of the SAP TM module related deliverables in SAP and S4 HANA implementation, support, and upgrade projects to meet engagement objectives and budget
* Lead design workshops with the client and responsible for requirement gathering, solution design, fit-gap analysis, writing functional specification, system configuration, testing and cutover activities for both standalone SAP TM system and embedded SAP TM in S/4 HANA
* Design SAP TM system Integrations with other modules of SAP/S4 HANA (like EWM, SD, MM etc.) and 3rd Party system
* Provide functional and business process expertise to the project team, resolve TM related client s issues and mentor junior team members
* Handle various industry specific complex TM scenarios like shipper, LSP and carriers
* Work with sales team, write proposals, define SAP TM scope and effort estimation for the new opportunities and present SAP TM capability to the potential client

**Technical and Professional Requirements:**

* 8-10 years of experience in implementation, support and upgrade projects in SAP TM
* Must have good functional and business knowledge, worked in multiple E2E implementations, integration, testing and application support in S/4HANA embedded TM and SAP TM (latest versions)
* Ability to interact with other cross functional teams from modules like OTC, EWM for integration scenario
* Excellent written and verbal interpersonal skills for co-ordinating across teams
* Should be able to lead workshop or working sessions with business
* Knowledge in ABAP and debugging would be nice to have

**Core SAP TM Competencies:**

* Comprehensive knowledge in all L3 aspects of SAP TM such as Order Management (Logistics Integration, Freight Unit, Forwarding Order, Freight Order, Freight Booking), Transportation Planning and Execution, Carrier Selection, Charge Calculation and Freight Settlement, Invoice Integration and Carrier Communication methodologies
* Proficiency in Master Data setup such as Resource Management, Locations, Business Partners etc.
* Deep understanding of SAP TM integration with SAP ERP S/4HANA logistics (SD, MM, LE) and embedded TM scenarios
* Expertise in Transportation Planning strategies: manual planning, Transportation Cockpit, optimizer-based planning (VSR), and automated freight unit building
* Proficiency in Freight Order Lifecycle Management, Freight Tendering processes, Subcontracting and Execution monitoring
* Advanced knowledge of Charge calculation, Freight Agreement Management, Rate tables and Transportation cost allocation

**Technical Skills:**

* SAP TM configuration and customizing across all functional areas (master data, organizational structures, profiles setup for Planning, business rules such as BRF+ conditions)
* Data migration methodologies using DRF, LSMW, SAP Data Services, or Migration Cockpit; system landscape design (Development, Quality, Production)
* Understanding of SAP TM on HANA optimization, performance tuning, and analytics capabilities
* Expertise in implementation planning, fit-gap analysis, SAP TM system configuration E2E, testing, rollout and post-implementation support.

**Industry Knowledge:**

* Expertise in logistics and supply chain operations across multiple transportation modes (road, rail, ocean, air, intermodal)
* Knowledge of carrier management practices, freight procurement, contract negotiations, and service level agreements
* Familiarity with industry best practices, benchmarks, and emerging trends (sustainability, real-time visibility, autonomous transportation)

**Client Management**

* Proven ability to engage with client and influence strategic decision-making
* Expertise in requirements gathering through workshops, interviews, and process analysis; translating business needs into technical specifications
* Change management and organizational adoption strategies, including training program design, communication planning, and stakeholder engagement

* End-to-end solution architecture spanning SAP TM, ERP or S/4 HANA, EWM, GTS, and third-party logistics systems (TMS, WMS, visibility platforms)

* Integration strategy development including point-to-point, hub-based, and API-led connectivity approaches

**Leadership & Delivery**

title: General Manager, BibleOn
description:
General Manager, BibleOn

**Location:**
Kochi, Kerala

**Employment:**
Full-time, on-site

**Reporting to:**
Thomson Philip, Co-founder of BibleOn and CEO of Eloit Innovations

**About BibleOn**

BibleOn is a free, ad-free Bible app with a mission to bring the Word of God to people in their own language. Rooted in the Catholic faith and welcoming everyone, BibleOn offers text and audio Scriptures in international, regional and tribal languages, helping individuals and families build a deeper relationship with Jesus through His Word.

Our vision extends beyond an app. We are building a global community of readers, listeners, volunteers, supporters and digital missionaries who help others discover and engage with the Holy Scriptures.

**The Opportunity**

We are seeking an exceptional, mission-driven leader to take full responsibility for leading BibleOn into its next stage of growth.

The General Manager, BibleOn will assume day-to-day leadership from the Co-founder and lead the initiative with independence, sound judgement and accountability. Working within the vision, strategic direction and agreed budgets set with the Co-founder, you will translate that vision into clear priorities, build the right team and deliver measurable results.

This role combines ministry leadership with the discipline of running a growing digital platform. You will lead operations, product priorities, language expansion, content, audience growth, Church partnerships, fundraising and campaigns, working with the existing team and recruiting additional talent as required.

We are looking for someone who can take ownership, make decisions and move the mission forward with limited day-to-day supervision.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Lead the Mission and Strategy**

* Translate BibleOn’s vision into an actionable growth plan with clear milestones, budgets and measures of success.
* Take ownership of execution across the entire initiative, resolving challenges and keeping priorities focused.
* Work closely with the Co-founder on strategic direction, major partnerships and decisions requiring his guidance.
* Provide concise, regular updates on progress, finances, opportunities and matters requiring leadership attention.

**2. Lead Operations and Build the Team**

* Assume responsibility for daily operations and coordinate the existing team across technology, content, languages, outreach and user support.
* Recruit, develop and lead employees, volunteers, language coordinators and external collaborators.
* Establish clear responsibilities, practical workflows and a culture of service, accountability and follow-through.
* Manage budgets, resources and delivery schedules to support sustainable growth.

**3. Expand Languages and Content**

* Develop and execute a plan to expand BibleOn’s text and audio Bible offerings, particularly for underserved language communities.
* Build relationships with Bible publishers, rights holders, translators, recording partners and Church organisations.
* Oversee permissions, content sourcing, production, quality review and publication.
* Develop Scripture-centred content and initiatives that encourage regular Bible reading, listening and spiritual growth.
* Maintain fidelity to Catholic teaching in BibleOn’s original faith content, supported by appropriate theological review.

**4. Grow the Audience and Community**

* Lead user acquisition, engagement and retention across countries and language communities.
* Plan and deliver digital campaigns, parish outreach, community programmes and partnerships.
* Build a network of digital missionaries, volunteers and ambassadors who introduce BibleOn to others.
* Use audience insights and performance data to improve campaigns, content and the user experience.

**5. Build Global Church Relationships**

* Develop active partnerships with dioceses, parishes, religious congregations, Catholic institutions, ministries and lay movements.
* Draw on an established global Catholic network to create opportunities for distribution, language expansion, collaboration and support.
* Represent BibleOn professionally at Church gatherings, conferences and partner meetings.
* Build lasting relationships grounded in trust, service and a shared commitment to spreading the Word of God.

**6. Lead Fundraising and Campaigns**

* Develop and execute a fundraising strategy that supports BibleOn’s free, ad-free mission.
* Build relationships with individual donors, Catholic foundations, institutions and other mission-aligned supporters.
* Lead donation campaigns, sponsorship proposals and supporter communications.
* Establish responsible donor stewardship, with clear reporting on the use of funds and the impact achieved.
* Work with finance and professional advisers on donation processes, financial controls and applicable requirements.

**7. Guide Product Development and User Experience**

* Work with the technology team to prioritise improvements based on mission needs, user feedback and growth opportunities.
* Coordinate product releases, content launches and campaigns.
* Champion accessibility, reliability and ease of use across languages and user groups.
* Monitor adoption, engagement, user support and product performance, turning findings into practical improvements.

**Mandatory Requirements**

* **A practising Catholic**
  , with a personal commitment to prayer, Scripture, the sacramental life and the mission of the Church.
* **An established and active global network within the Catholic Church**
  , with the ability to build trusted relationships across clergy, religious communities, institutions, ministries and lay leaders.
* Proven experience leading an organisation, ministry, business unit or substantial initiative, with responsibility for people, budgets, execution and results.
* The ability to function independently, exercise sound judgement and take full ownership while remaining accountable to the Co-founder’s vision and guidance.
* Strong communication and relationship-building skills, including the ability to present BibleOn’s mission convincingly to partners, donors and communities.
* Willingness to work full-time from Kochi and travel within India and internationally when required.

Experience and Capabilities We Value

* Leadership experience in digital products, technology, Catholic ministry, publishing, media, fundraising or the social impact sector.
* A demonstrated record of growing audiences, communities, partnerships or donor support.
* Experience recruiting and leading multidisciplinary teams, including volunteers and external partners.
* Confidence with budgets, performance metrics, digital campaigns and project delivery.
* Experience working across languages, cultures and international networks.
* A relevant degree or equivalent professional experience. An MBA or postgraduate qualification is an advantage.

**What Success Looks Like**

* BibleOn operates effectively under your leadership, with the Co-founder able to focus on strategic guidance.
* The team has clear priorities, defined responsibilities and consistent delivery.
* More people discover BibleOn, return regularly and engage deeply with Scripture.
* New language communities gain access to quality text and audio Bible content.
* Church partnerships generate active collaboration and measurable reach.
* Donations and supporter relationships provide a stronger foundation for the mission.
* BibleOn grows while remaining faithful to its Catholic identity and free, ad-free purpose.

**Who Will Thrive in This Role**

You combine a heart for evangelisation with the ability to build and lead. You are comfortable developing strategy, meeting a bishop, presenting to a donor, guiding a team and following through on practical details.

* You see bringing the Word of God to more people as a personal calling, and you have the leadership ability to turn that commitment into sustained action.

What You Bring

* **Experience:**
  5+ years of SEO experience, ideally within a digital marketing agency.1
* **Technical Expertise:**
  Advanced knowledge of technical, on-page, local, and off-page SEO, plus content strategy.

  Strong proficiency in tools like Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs, Semrush, and Screaming Frog, with a demonstrated ability to evaluate complex CRM and call-tracking data.

  Exceptional root-cause analysis and commercial judgment, with the ability to translate findings into clear, prioritized recommendations.

  Strong written and verbal communication skills; the ability to influence cross-functional teams and stakeholders without direct managerial authority.

title: Software Diagnostics & Performance Test Engineer
description:
SOTI is committed to providing its employees with endless possibilities; learning new things, working with the latest technologies and making a difference in the world.
  
  
*SOTI does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process. You can verify the authenticity of any SOTI job opportunities by visiting SOTI Careers. SOTI shall not be liable for any fraudulent recruitment activities carried out by unauthorized individuals or organizations.*
**What You Will Do**

* Investigate complex and ambiguous software failures and performance problems.
* Perform deep root-cause analysis across application, system, network, database, and infrastructure layers.
* Analyze application logs, system logs, stack traces, thread dumps, heap dumps, metrics, traces, and profiling data.
* Analyze network traffic and protocols to identify latency, connectivity, retransmission, timeout, and communication issues.
* Investigate issues that occur only under specific workloads, concurrency levels, configurations, environments, or long-running conditions.
* Understand product architecture and critical customer workflows deeply enough to reason about failure modes.
* Learn the product in depth, including core workflows, customer usage patterns, deployment models, and performance-sensitive areas.
* Design experiments to isolate variables and prove or disprove hypotheses.
* Develop diagnostic scripts, instrumentation, and small tools when necessary to accelerate investigations.
* Perform exploratory testing and deliberately challenge system assumptions to discover weaknesses and failure modes.
* Investigate performance degradation, scalability limitations, resource exhaustion, latency spikes, and throughput bottlenecks.
* Create meaningful Performance Test Cases based on product architecture, customer workflows, expected load patterns, scalability goals, and known risk areas.
* Review Performance Test Cases created by other engineers to ensure coverage, clarity, workload relevance, data validity, and alignment with product behavior.
* Execute Performance Test Cases, analyze results, identify bottlenecks or regressions, and communicate findings with clear evidence and recommended actions.
* Correlate evidence across multiple components of distributed systems.
* Work with developers to identify the actual root cause rather than simply identifying the component where the symptom appeared.
* Clearly communicate technical findings, evidence, root cause, impact, and recommended corrective actions.
* Build and maintain diagnostic knowledge, troubleshooting methodologies, and internal technical documentation.
* Mentor other engineers in systematic debugging and root-cause analysis.

**Must-have Qualifications**

* Technical
* 5+ years of software engineering, performance engineering, systems engineering, reliability engineering, production troubleshooting, or a closely related discipline, preferably in a product-based software company.
* Programming/debugging ability in at least one major language such as Java, C++, C#, Python, etc.
* Strong ability to read and understand unfamiliar application code.
* Demonstrated experience troubleshooting complex software problems.
* Strong understanding of operating-system concepts: processes, threads, memory, CPU, file I/O, sockets, synchronization, resource utilization
* Strong understanding of networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, HTTP/HTTPS, DNS, connection management, latency, timeouts, retransmissions
* Experience analyzing logs and traces across multiple components.
* Experience with application profiling and/or performance analysis.
* Hands-on experience creating, reviewing, and executing Performance Test Cases for complex software products.
* Experience diagnosing concurrency, latency, resource contention, or scalability issues.
* Ability to interpret performance test results, compare them with baselines, identify regressions, and connect findings back to product behavior or code-level causes.
* Ability to formulate hypotheses and systematically validate them with evidence.
* Behavioral
* Exceptional curiosity about how software systems work.
* Strong interest in learning the product deeply rather than treating testing as a black-box activity.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Comfortable working with incomplete or ambiguous information.
* Willingness to challenge assumptions.
* Persistence when the first explanation isn't the real root cause.
* Ability to communicate complex technical findings clearly.
* Comfortable collaborating with developers without simply handing problems back to them.
* Strong ownership of difficult investigations
