title: Executive Assistant (with Quickbooks Bookkeeping)
description:
Executive Assistant & Bookkeeper

Location: Kochi (Full-time, On-site)

Company: Intelo.ai

About Intelo

Intelo is a transformation partner building AI agents that drive efficiency, accuracy, and growth across businesses. We solve critical retail and supply chain workflows using purpose-built AI technology.

Our platform enables retailers to:

* Forecast demand accurately
* Reduce excess inventory
* Improve sell-through
* Make faster, smarter decisions

We operate at the intersection of AI, data engineering, and product thinking - building systems that translate complex data into real business outcomes.

Role Overview

We are looking for an Executive Assistant & Bookkeeper to run the day-to-day for our two Co-CEOs and keep the company's books clean.

This is a hands-on role close to the founders, not a back-office desk. About 75% of your time goes to executive support and 25% to bookkeeping in QuickBooks. You will own the Co-CEOs' calendars, inboxes, travel, and follow-through, and you will own the accuracy of our books. Our leadership works across US and India time zones, so this role runs on US Eastern hours, until at least 1:00 pm ET, from our Kochi office.

You will work closely with the Co-CEOs, the People Success team, and the wider leadership group, and you will be accountable for outcomes rather than activity.

What We Expect from Every Intelo Team Member

*This is part of our operating philosophy.*

**Here to Make a Difference**

* Challenges the status quo
* Experiments boldly
* Adapts when the ground shifts

**Open by Default**

* Raises concerns early
* Shares knowledge transparently

**Owns It**

* Takes initiative
* Follows process even when it's hard
* Makes decisions with context - not escalation

**Product Over Tickets**

* Thinks from the customer backwards
* Fights unnecessary complexity
* Automates repetitive work

**Always Learning**

* Seeks deep understanding
* Uses AI as leverage to improve thinking and output
* Continuously upgrades judgment

Key Responsibilities

Executive Support

* Own the Co-CEOs' calendars: protect their time, resolve conflicts, and keep meetings moving across time zones
* Triage email and messages every day; draft replies, chase open loops, and make sure nothing sits unanswered
* Prepare leaders for every meeting with an agenda, context, and a clean record of decisions and action items afterwards
* Plan and book travel; plan backwards from the dates that matter and keep itineraries accurate
* Handle expenses, approvals, and routine admin without being asked twice

Bookkeeping

* Keep QuickBooks current: invoices, bills, payments, and expenses recorded correctly and on time
* Reconcile bank and card accounts regularly; treat an unreconciled account as a defect
* Support month-end close with records the accountant can use without chasing you
* Prepare simple reports for the Co-CEOs and know why each figure is what it is

Judgment and Discretion

* Handle contracts, financials, and people matters with complete discretion
* Prioritise when two leaders ask for different things; surface the conflict early, with a recommendation
* Report status honestly. The worst outcome is not a missed task - it is a leader learning about a problem after it has become a crisis

AI as Leverage

* Use AI heavily to draft, summarise, and prepare - speed matters, but verification is the job
* Keep records tidy: one file, one location, clearly named, and the version that goes out is the version that was checked

Required Qualifications

* 3+ years supporting senior leaders as an executive assistant, chief of staff, or in a similar role
* Strong working knowledge of QuickBooks, including bank reconciliation and month-end support
* Excellent written and verbal communication; can write a clear email for a CEO and explain a number to an accountant
* Comfortable with Google Workspace and Slack
* Able to work from our Kochi office on US Eastern hours, until at least 1:00 pm ET (about 10:30 pm IST, or 11:30 pm IST after US daylight saving ends)
* High energy and a positive attitude; takes initiative without waiting to be asked
* Complete discretion with confidential information

Preferred Experience

We would prefer candidates with experience in:

* Supporting founders or executives at a startup or fast-growing technology company
* Working with US-based leadership teams and US business practices
* Bookkeeping for a US company in QuickBooks Online
* Working with an external accountant or CPA

What This Role Owns at Intelo

An Executive Assistant & Bookkeeper at Intelo:

* Owns the Co-CEOs' time, preparation, and follow-through
* Owns accurate, up-to-date books
* Anticipates what is needed instead of waiting to be asked
* Says the uncomfortable thing early, with context
* Takes accountability for outcomes, not activity

Why Join Intelo

* Work directly with the Co-CEOs of a fast-growing AI company
* Genuine responsibility and trust from day one
* Small senior team, short path from decision to action
* Shape how the company runs at a stage where it is still being set
* Fast-moving, product-first environment
* Culture that rewards initiative and deep thinking

* Ability to create structured lesson plans, design practice exercises, and adapt teaching strategies to different learning speeds and styles.
* Competence in using online teaching platforms, video conferencing tools, digital whiteboards, and educational resources to deliver interactive lessons.
* Excellent communication skills, patience, and the ability to motivate and engage students in a remote learning environment.
* Bachelor’s degree in Malayalam, Education, or a closely related field; formal teacher training or certification is an advantage.
* Reliable high-speed internet connection, a suitable quiet workspace, and familiarity with basic troubleshooting of common technical issues.

Kochi Metro Apprentice Recruitment 2026 notice provides 70 apprenticeships in various trades such as ITI, Diploma, and graduate for a training period of one year. The candidates need to register on NAPS or NATS portal and then submit the application to the corporate office. There is no application fee, written exam and no interview in
**Kochi Metro Recruitment 2026**
. The last date of application is November 10, 2026 and period of application is from October 15, 2026 to November 10, 2026. The fresh technical and non-technical pass outs who want to get hands-on experience in urban rail operations and
**PSU Jobs in India**
should read the conditions before applying. All applicants must check whether they satisfy the conditions before applying for the post.
  
  
Know the Organisation Offering the Training
  
  
Kochi Metro Rail Limited is an operator of metro in Kochi city with its corporate office at JLN Stadium Metro Station, Kaloor. The company also recruits Apprentices to provide young people with hands-on experience in the industry. The opportunity of finding
**Latest PSU Jobs in India**
can be utilized to kick-start the career of a reputed transport utility. Candidates are advised to read the Official Notification carefully before applying as to the training conditions and requirements. The General Manager (HR, ADMN and TRG) has unveiled the
**Kochi Metro Apprentice Vacancy 2026**
announcement.
  
  
Seats Availability for Kochi Metro Apprentice Recruitment 2026
  
  
Training Category UR SC ST OBC EWS
**No. of Posts**
Graduate Apprentice (Tech) 6 2 1 4 2 16 Graduate Apprentice (Non-Tech) 2 1 0 2 1 6 Diploma Apprentice (Technician) 11 4 2 8 3 28 Trade Apprentice (ITI) 8 3 2 5 2 20
**Total Posts**

Educational Standards for Each Training Level
  
  
Training Level Qualification Required Graduate Apprentice (Tech)
  
  

* Full-time 4-year Engineering degree in a listed discipline
* Degree from a recognised university

Graduate Apprentice (Non-Tech)
  
  

* Full-time 3-year BBA, B.Com or BCA degree
* Final consolidated mark sheet showing marks

Diploma Apprentice (Technician)
  
  

* Full-time 3-year Diploma in a relevant discipline
* Eligible disciplines include Civil, Electrical, Mechanical, Electronics and Computer Science

Trade Apprentice (ITI)
  
  

* Full-time ITI certificate in a relevant trade
* Eligible trades include Electrician, Electronics, Welder, Fitter and Plumber

Pass Out Window
  
  

* Final examination result declared within five years of the closing date

Mode of Study
  
  

* Full-time qualifications only
* Part-time, correspondence and distance education not accepted
* Specialisation must appear on the certificate
* An institute letter is required if the certificate omits the specialisation

Important Timelines for Kochi Metro Apprentice Recruitment 2026
  
  

* Notification Date: October 15, 2026
* Application Opening Date: October 15, 2026
* Last Date to Submit: November 10, 2026
* Portal Registration: NAPS for ITI and NATS for degree and diploma before submission

Age Requirement
  
  

* Minimum Age: 18 years
* Maximum Age: Not specified in the notification
* Age Proof: Matriculation certificate, Aadhaar Card or Passport
* Relaxation: Reservation and relaxation follow Government guidelines

Monthly Stipend Structure
  
  

* ITI Apprentices: Rs. 9,600/- per month including DBT
* Diploma Apprentices: Rs. 10,900/- per month including DBT
* Graduate Apprentices: Rs. 12,300/- per month including DBT
* Food Allowance: Additional Rs. 1,200/- per month as food or messing allowance
* DBT Share: Rs. 5,450/- for diploma and Rs. 6,150/- for graduate apprentices from the Government of India under NATS

Fee for Applicants
  
  

* Application Fee: Nil for all candidates

Selection Procedure for Kochi Metro Apprentice Recruitment 2026
  
  

* Interested candidates register on the NAPS portal for ITI trades and the NATS portal for degree or diploma courses, and fill in their profiles with all the information and documents required.
* Once the number is shared, the candidates submit the application form after completing it completely, along with relevant documents, to the corporate office within the given time frame.
* The company takes each application into consideration and will not consider an application if it is incomplete or from an unqualified applicant without prior notice.
* There is no application fee nor written test or interview required for this employment.
* The company fills seats based on Government’s reservation guideline from time to time.
* The company invites candidates who are shortlisted to verify their documents and certificates.
* Selected candidates sign up for the tripartite apprenticeship contract on the NATS or NAPS website and submit a medical certificate and police verification after which they commence training with Government Jobs in Kerala at the Kochi Metro setup.

Training Terms and Service Conditions
  
  

* Apprenticeship Period: Training period will be for one year from the date of enrolment and will terminate at the end of the training period and cannot be extended.
* Stipend Payment: Selected apprentices get the prescribed stipend in their bank account, which has been seeded with Aadhaar, under the Kochi Metro Apprentice Vacancy 2026 engagement.
* Casual Leave: 12 days of Casual Leave can be availed by Apprentices during 1 year Training period on pro-rata basis.
* Medical Leave: Apprentices can take up to 15 days of medical leave for illness during the one-year training period.
* Assessment for the Apprentice: KMRL assesses each Apprentice’s performance at regular intervals during the training programme.
* Employment Claim: Once the apprenticeship is completed there is no guarantee of a job with the employer.
* Amendment Rights: The management reserves the right to change the above terms at any point and informs the apprentices by email or other official means.
* Final Authority: All terms and conditions are final and binding and entering the programme indicates acceptance of the KMRL decision.

Directions Applicants Must Follow
  
  

* Prescribed Format: The candidates are required to use the prescribed application format. No applications are accepted via any other means than KMRL.
* Profile Completion: The candidate needs to have updated his profile in NAPS/NATs before filling the application form.
* Mark Sheet Rule: Consolidated Mark Sheets should display candidates’ final examination percentage. Otherwise, they will be required to include a conversion letter.
* Specialisation Proof: If the certificate does not contain the specialisation, candidates should get a letter from the institute which they have done their studies from.
* Incomplete Forms: KMRL will not accept incomplete applications and applications from ineligible candidates without prior notice.
* Contract and Police Check: Engagement requires tripartite contract, medical certificate and police verification.
* Bank Account: DBT amount is credited to the candidate’s active bank account where he/she will be able to see the DBT amount on which KMRL will facilitate.
* Application Compliance: The candidates are required to check the given information and documents before applying for Kochi Metro Apprentice Recruitment 2026 to avoid rejection.

**Also Read: NIT Calicut Apprentices Recruitment 2026 – Apply Now for 30 Posts**
Process to Apply for Kochi Metro Apprentice Recruitment 2026
  
  

* Check out the official website of Kochi Metro Rail Limited https://corporate.kochimetro.org/
* In “Careers” section, click on the advertisement entitled “Official Notification: KMRL/Apprenticeship/2026-27/HR-Admin/01“
* Carefully read the complete notification, eligibility conditions and terms before applying.
* If you are an ITI candidate, register on NAPS portal of apprenticeshipindia.gov.in.
* If you are a Degree or Diploma student, you need to register on NATS portal at nats.education.gov.in.
* Fill out your profile and upload all documents needed to get your enrolment number.
* Download and complete the apprentice bio-data form in capital letters, attaching your picture.
* Have a scanned copy of educational certificates, age proof and category certificate available with the form.
* Please submit the filled form along with the documents to the General Manager (HR, ADMN and TRG), Kochi Metro Rail Ltd, Corporate Office, 4th Floor, JLN Stadium Metro Station, Kaloor, Kochi, Kerala 682017.
* Ensure that you submit the Kochi Metro Recruitment 2026 application in the prescribed format to the office before November 10, 2026.
* For any query write to kmrl.apprentices@gmail.com and follow official channels for updates.

Conditions That Make Candidates Ineligible
  
  

* Results Pending: If you are waiting for your final examination results, then you are not eligible to apply for the Kochi Metro Apprentice Recruitment 2026 drive.
* Age: All applicants need to be at least 18 years of age.
* Existing Apprentices: The candidates who are undergoing apprenticeship training or have completed apprenticeship training in any organisation cannot apply.
* Distance Education: KMRL does not recognize degrees obtained through correspondence, distance learning or part-time courses.
* Pass Out Window: Applicants should have finished their final examination within five years before the application deadline.
* Medical Fitness: The applicant should fulfill the medical fitness standards stipulated under the Apprentices Act, 1961.

FAQs
  
  
The last date to submit an application for Kochi Metro Apprentice Recruitment 2026 is 10th November 2026. The candidates are required to fill up the necessary formalities of application and submit all the requisite documents before the stipulated date.
  
  
The candidates should have the appropriate degree, diploma, or ITI course in the field of the apprentice program they are interested in. The educational qualification required for the Applicants who are appearing for Graduate, Diploma, and Trade Apprentice exam is as per the official notification.
  
  
Selected candidates will be paid a monthly allowance based on their category of apprenticeship. Graduate Apprentices will be paid Rs. Diploma Apprentices will get Rs. 12300/- Trade Apprentices will get Rs. 10,900/-, 9,600/- per month.
  
  
Kochi Metro Rail Limited (KMRL) has released 70 Graduate Apprenticeship, Diploma Apprenticeship and Trade Apprenticeship opportunities. Eligibility Details of the interested candidates regarding the posts should be checked from the notification before applying.

title: Design & Analysis Engineer – CAD (UAV / Aerospace)
description:
**Company:**
Canary Aerospace Pvt. Ltd. | Part of Canary Digital Group

**Location:**
Kerala Technology Innovation Zone, Kerala Startup Mission, Kalamassery, Kerala – 683503

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time | On-Site

**Experience:**
2–6 Years

**Industry:**
Aerospace, Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAV), Advanced Engineering & Manufacturing

About Canary Aerospace

**Canary Aerospace Pvt. Ltd.**
, part of the
**Canary Digital Group**
, is an emerging aerospace technology company focused on designing, developing and manufacturing next-generation Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs), autonomous aerial systems and advanced aerospace solutions.

Combining aerospace engineering expertise with the Group's capabilities in Artificial Intelligence, Computer Vision, Autonomous Systems and Software Engineering, we are building innovative aerial platforms for surveillance, inspection, logistics and other mission-critical applications.

Our engineering programmes span multicopter UAVs, fixed-wing VTOL platforms, autonomous docking systems and next-generation aerospace technologies.

As we expand our aerospace engineering and R&D operations, we are looking for a passionate and technically accomplished
**Design & Analysis Engineer – CAD (UAV / Aerospace)**
to join our team in Kalamassery, Kerala.

About the Role

We are seeking a hands-on Design & Analysis Engineer who can take complete ownership of mechanical and structural engineering activities — from concept development and 3D modelling to simulation, design optimisation, manufacturing support and flight-test validation.

This is
**not merely a CAD drafting position**
. The selected engineer will actively participate in developing real-world aerospace products, applying engineering analysis to ensure structural integrity, aerodynamic performance, weight optimisation and manufacturability.

You will have the opportunity to work closely with our multidisciplinary teams across aerospace engineering, propulsion, avionics, autonomous systems, AI and manufacturing.

Key Responsibilities

**1. CAD Design & Product Development**

* Develop parametric 3D CAD models and complete assemblies for UAV platforms, including fuselage, wings, booms, tail structures, VTOL arms and landing gear.
* Design aerodynamic surfaces and translate conceptual configurations into manufacturable structures.
* Develop mechanical components, payload integration systems, locking mechanisms, control linkages and battery-swap assemblies.
* Ensure effective integration of propulsion, avionics, wiring, sensors and payload systems.

**2. Structural Engineering & Simulation**

* Conduct Finite Element Analysis (FEA) for static, buckling, vibration and modal performance.
* Analyse metallic and composite aerospace components under relevant operational loads.
* Evaluate structural strength, stiffness, fatigue considerations and margins of safety.
* Interpret simulation results and implement design improvements to optimise performance and weight.

**3. Composite Structures & Manufacturing Engineering**

* Design carbon-fibre and glass-fibre composite structures, sandwich panels and bonded assemblies.
* Develop laminate configurations, ply schedules, joints, inserts and structural interfaces.
* Design moulds, tooling, jigs and fixtures for composite manufacturing.
* Support wet layup, vacuum infusion and prepreg manufacturing processes.
* Apply Design for Manufacturing and Assembly (DFMA) principles throughout product development.

**4. Aerodynamic Analysis & Optimisation**

* Support Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) studies for aerodynamic performance.
* Evaluate airflow, drag, rotor interactions, VTOL transition effects and thermal management.
* Collaborate with flight dynamics and propulsion teams to optimise structural and aerodynamic configurations.

**5. Engineering Documentation & Validation**

* Prepare manufacturing-ready 2D drawings, GD&T specifications, tolerance analyses and Bills of Materials (BOM).
* Maintain engineering design documentation, technical calculations and simulation reports.
* Manage mass properties, centre-of-gravity calculations and configuration updates.
* Support prototype assembly, troubleshooting, ground testing and flight-test activities.
* Incorporate manufacturing and testing feedback into continuous design improvements.

Required Qualifications & Experience

* **2–6 years of relevant professional experience**
  in mechanical design, structural analysis or product development involving physical hardware.
* Strong proficiency in at least one leading CAD platform:
  **SolidWorks, CATIA, Siemens NX, PTC Creo or Autodesk Fusion 360**
  .
* Hands-on experience with FEA tools such as Ansys Mechanical, Abaqus, Altair OptiStruct, Nastran or equivalent.
* Sound understanding of structural mechanics, material behaviour, load cases and engineering design principles.
* Working knowledge of composite materials, including carbon fibre, glass fibre, sandwich structures and adhesive bonding.
* Experience creating manufacturing-ready technical drawings with appropriate GD&T and tolerances.
* Practical understanding of manufacturing processes, assembly constraints and design optimisation.
* Ability to independently design, analyse, refine and validate engineered components.

**Relevant demonstrated engineering experience and project accomplishments will be prioritised over academic pedigree.**

Preferred Skills – Added Advantage

* Previous engineering experience in UAVs, aerospace, drones, motorsport, automotive or robotics.
* Knowledge of fixed-wing aircraft and VTOL configurations.
* CFD experience using Ansys Fluent, Star-CCM+, OpenFOAM or equivalent.
* Experience in composite fabrication, mould development and vacuum infusion.
* Familiarity with aerodynamic tools such as OpenVSP, XFLR5, AVL or XFOIL.
* Experience with vibration analysis, lightweight structural design and fatigue assessment.
* Understanding of mechanism design, battery integration and UAV payload packaging.
* Experience participating in prototype development, hardware testing or flight trials.
* Personal engineering projects involving drones, RC aircraft, Formula Student, robotics or rocketry.

What You Will Work On

You will contribute to challenging aerospace development programmes, including:

* **Fixed-Wing VTOL UAV Platforms:**
  Structural design, simulation, composite airframe development and prototype validation.
* **Autonomous UAV Docking Stations:**
  Mechanical design for autonomous landing, docking and battery-swapping mechanisms.
* **Next-Generation Aerospace Platforms:**
  Research and engineering development involving advanced VTOL configurations and autonomous aircraft systems.
* **Advanced UAV Engineering:**
  Lightweight structures, mechanisms, payload integration and manufacturing solutions.

Why Join Canary Aerospace?

* **Build Real Aerospace Products:**
  Work on engineering designs that progress from CAD models to actual manufactured and tested hardware.
* **End-to-End Engineering Ownership:**
  Participate in the complete product development lifecycle instead of working on isolated drafting assignments.
* **Emerging Aerospace Technologies:**
  Gain experience in UAVs, VTOL platforms, autonomous systems and advanced composite structures.
* **Multidisciplinary Innovation:**
  Collaborate with engineers specialising in aerospace, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Vision, embedded systems and autonomous technologies.
* **Innovation-Driven Environment:**
  Work with a focused R&D team where engineering decisions translate rapidly into practical outcomes.
* **Growth Opportunities:**
  Be part of an ambitious Indian aerospace technology company building capabilities for domestic and international markets.

How to Apply

We invite engineers who are passionate about designing, analysing and building real aerospace systems to apply.

Please submit your
**updated CV along with a technical portfolio**
demonstrating relevant projects.

Your portfolio may include CAD models, design drawings, FEA/CFD results, engineering reports or photographs of manufactured products. Briefly describe your individual contribution, engineering challenges addressed and the outcomes achieved.

**Apply through LinkedIn Jobs.**

**Join Canary Aerospace and help engineer the future of autonomous flight.**

#CanaryAerospace #Hiring #AerospaceEngineering #UAV #VTOL #CADDesign #StructuralAnalysis #FEA #CFD #MechanicalEngineering #CompositeStructures #DroneTechnology #KeralaJobs #EngineeringJobs

title: Quality Analyst
description:
**Company Overview**
Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone is focused on building an employee-first, performance-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. The company specializes in providing solutions across Application Services and Consulting, Digital Product Engineering, Digital Workplace Services, Private Cloud Services, AI/Automation, and ServiceNow. Milestone culture is built to provide a collaborative, inclusive environment that supports employees and empowers them to reach their full potential.
  
  
Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone’s best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short-term and long-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.
  
  
**Job Overview**
We are looking for a detail-oriented and analytical
**Quality Analyst**
to support the delivery of Salesforce-powered Conversational ITSM and Enterprise Service Management solutions.
  
  
This role is ideal for professionals who enjoy validating business requirements, testing end-to-end solutions, identifying defects, and ensuring applications deliver expected business outcomes. You will work closely with Business Analysts, Developers, Architects, and Product Owners to validate innovative Salesforce, Agentforce, and enterprise service management solutions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Quality Assurance & Validation**

* Review business requirements, user stories, process flows, and acceptance criteria.
* Identify gaps, ambiguities, and inconsistencies before development begins.
* Validate delivered functionality against business requirements.
* Ensure quality standards are followed throughout the delivery lifecycle.

**Test Planning & Execution**

* Create and maintain:

+ Test Scenarios
+ Test Cases
+ Test Data
+ Defect Reports
+ Traceability Matrices

* Execute:

+ Functional Testing
+ Integration Testing
+ Regression Testing
+ End-to-End Testing
+ User Acceptance Testing Support

* Document testing results and provide quality reports.

**Salesforce & ITSM Testing**

* Validate solutions developed on:

+ Salesforce Service Cloud
+ Experience Cloud
+ Agentforce
+ Enterprise Service Management Platforms

* Test business processes including:

+ Incident Management
+ Service Request Management
+ Knowledge Management
+ Change Management
+ CMDB
+ IT Asset Management
+ Employee Services

* Verify conversational and AI-enabled workflows.

**Integration Testing**

* Validate integrations between Salesforce and enterprise applications.
* Test APIs, middleware integrations, workflows, and data synchronization processes.
* Ensure data consistency and business process continuity across systems.

**UAT & Stakeholder Support**

* Support User Acceptance Testing activities.
* Assist in defect triage sessions.
* Participate in sprint reviews and solution demonstrations.
* Work with stakeholders to validate business readiness and acceptance.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Identify opportunities to improve testing effectiveness and efficiency.
* Support automation initiatives and quality engineering practices.
* Contribute to a culture of quality and continuous improvement.

**Required Qualifications**
**Must Have**

* 3–5 years of Quality Assurance and Testing experience.
* Experience testing enterprise applications, Salesforce solutions, or ITSM platforms.
* Strong understanding of test planning, execution, and defect management.
* Experience creating test cases, test scenarios, and validation documentation.
* Knowledge of Agile and Scrum delivery methodologies.
* Strong analytical, documentation, and communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Exposure to Salesforce Service Cloud or Experience Cloud.
* Experience testing Enterprise Service Management or ITSM solutions.
* Familiarity with CMDB and IT Asset Management processes.
* Knowledge of API and integration testing.
* ISTQB or equivalent testing certification.

**Added Advantage**

* Exposure to Agentforce or Conversational AI solutions.
* Experience validating AI-powered workflows.
* Knowledge of test automation tools and frameworks.
* ITIL Foundation Certification.

**What We Are Looking For**
We are looking for professionals who:
  
  

* Have a strong attention to detail and quality mindset.
* Enjoy validating business processes and technology solutions.
* Can collaborate effectively with business and technical teams.
* Take ownership of testing outcomes and customer satisfaction.
* Are passionate about Salesforce, Enterprise Service Management, and AI-driven service experiences.
* Thrive in collaborative and fast-paced environments.

**Why Join Us?**

* Be part of strategic Salesforce transformation programs focused on Conversational ITSM and Enterprise Service Management.
* Gain exposure to Agentforce, AI-powered service experiences, MuleSoft integrations, and Salesforce technologies.
* Work alongside experienced Business Analysts, Architects, Developers, and Quality Leaders.
* Build expertise in Salesforce testing, ITSM processes, CMDB, and IT Asset Management platforms.
* Accelerate your career through continuous learning, innovation, and certification opportunities.
* Join a growing organization committed to delivery excellence and customer success.
* Enjoy a flexible hybrid work model across Kochi, Bangalore, and Hyderabad.

**Join Us**
If you are a passionate
**Quality Analyst**
who believes quality is about delivering business value and exceptional customer experiences, we would love to hear from you. Join us and help build the future of
**AI-powered Enterprise Service Management and Conversational Salesforce platforms**
, ensuring every solution is reliable, scalable, and aligned with customer expectations.
  
  
**Compensation**
Estimated Pay Range:
  
  
Exact compensation and offers of employment are dependent on circumstances of each case and will be determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, licenses or certifications, and location.
  
  
****Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion****
At Milestone we strive to create a workplace that reflects the communities we serve and work with, where we all feel empowered to bring our full, authentic selves to work. We know creating a diverse and inclusive culture that champions equity and belonging is not only the right thing to do for our employees but is also critical to our continued success.
  
  
Milestone Technologies provides equal employment opportunity for all applicants and employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, marital status, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, national origin, or any other category protected by applicable federal and state law, or local ordinance. Milestone also makes reasonable accommodations for disabled applicants and employees.
  
  
We welcome the unique background, culture, experiences, knowledge, innovation, self-expression and perspectives you can bring to our global community. Our recruitment team is looking forward to meeting you.
  
  
  
**\*\*\*Notice to Job Seekers Regarding Impersonation and Fraudulent Job Offers\*\*\***

**specifically Naukri.com and Linkedin.com**
**Please be advised of the following official Milestone Technologies recruitment policies:**
**Official Communication Channels**
All legitimate email communications from our recruitment team will originate ONLY from the domains:
**@milestone.tech.**
We do not use generic email services (e.g. @gmail.com, @yahoo.com, @outlook.com) or unofficial third party messaging apps to conduct formal business.
  
  
**No Recruitment Fees**
Milestone Technologies never requests any form of payment, "security deposit", "laptop/equipment fee", or "processing fee" at any stage of the recruitment or onboarding process. Any request for money in exchange for an interview or job offer is a scam.

title: Engineer - BIM Civil
description:
**Dear Candidate,**

**Job Summary:**

We are looking for a detail-oriented and experienced BIM Civil Engineer with a minimum of 3 years of hands-on experience in Revit-based modeling for civil and infrastructure projects. The ideal candidate must have a strong command of Scan-to-BIM workflows, 3D modeling of civil assets, and coordination across disciplines. This role requires an individual with strong technical capabilities in BIM software and a solid understanding of civil engineering principles.

**Key Responsibilities:**

Develop high-quality 3D BIM models using Autodesk Revit for civil infrastructure projects including drainage, utilities, site development, and external works.

Work with point cloud data (Scan-to-BIM) to model existing conditions and integrate laser scan outputs into Revit and Civil 3D environments.

Interpret and process LiDAR scans, photogrammetry, and other survey data to create accurate as-built models.

Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams (architecture, MEP, structural) to ensure accurate model coordination and clash-free design.

Conduct clash detection and resolution using tools such as Navisworks Manage.

Produce construction documentation including plans, sections, and details directly from BIM models.

Adhere to and help enforce BIM execution plans, project standards, and quality checks.

Maintain model accuracy and version control throughout the project lifecycle.

Support project delivery using BIM 360 / ACC or similar collaboration platforms.

Qualifications and Skills:

Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Civil Engineering or a related field.

Minimum of 3 years of relevant BIM experience in civil projects.

Proficiency in Autodesk Revit is mandatory.

Strong experience with Scan-to-BIM workflows, point cloud processing, and as-built modeling.

Working knowledge of Civil 3D, Navisworks, and reality capture tools such as ReCap, Leica Cyclone, or Faro Scene.

Familiarity with BIM standards (e.g., ISO 19650, PAS 1192).

Excellent attention to detail, communication, and problem-solving skills.

Experience with cloud-based collaboration tools (e.g., BIM 360 / Autodesk Construction Cloud) is preferred.

Understanding of local and international standards (e.g., AASHTO, BS, Eurocodes). - this point we can include

title: Administrative Assistant
description:
**Part-Time Administrative Assistant, Kerala (Mobile / Field-Based)**

Globeia is establishing its base in Kerala, and we are looking for a reliable, detail-oriented Administrative Associate to be the first face of our service on the ground.

This is a part-time, hourly role, 10 to 15 hours per week to start, scaling up as our client volume grows. In the early phase, you will be working mobile, meeting clients across the state. Once volumes build, we will establish a permanent office space in Kerala, and you will have the opportunity to grow with us into that.

**What you will be doing**

Meeting our clients across Kerala to assist with administrative paperwork and document handling. Coordinating appointments and managing day to day client communication. Keeping accurate records of every interaction, document, and timestamp. Acting as the local point of contact for our global team. Supporting the rollout of our Kerala office once volumes justify the move.

**Who we are looking for**

Someone comfortable getting around Kerala, whether by car, two-wheeler, Uber, Ola, auto-rickshaw, Kochi Metro, or bus, depending on what the day calls for. Open and flexible with your time, since your weekly schedule will be built around the availability you share with us and may shift week to week based on client demand. Sharp attention to detail, the kind of person who does not miss things and double checks the things that matter. Professional, warm, and presentable when meeting clients. Fluent in English and Malayalam. Prior admin, front office, or client facing experience is preferred but not required. Must have the right to work in India.

**The offer**

₹200 per hour, with all travel and commuting costs reimbursed. Part time hours scheduled around your availability, between 10 and 15 hours per week. Hourly pay, paid regularly. A real opportunity to grow with us as Kerala scales, since early hires often become foundational team members.

**About Globeia**

Globeia is a global identity verification and document services company operating across the US, Canada, UK, India, Australia, Austria, Singapore, Portugal, Colombia, and Qatar, and now expanding in Kerala. We are bootstrapped, profitable, and growing fast, and we believe in hiring people who care about getting the small things right.

title: Hardware Engineer – Embedded Systems & PCB Design (UAV / Aerospace)
description:
Hardware Engineer – Embedded Systems & PCB Design (UAV / Aerospace)

**Company:**
Canary Aerospace Pvt. Ltd. | Part of Canary Digital Group

**Location:**
Kerala Technology Innovation Zone, Kerala Startup Mission, Kalamassery, Kerala – 683503

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time | On-Site

**Experience:**
2–8 Years

**Industry:**
Aerospace | UAV | Embedded Systems | Electronics Engineering

About Canary Aerospace

**Canary Aerospace Pvt. Ltd.**
, part of the
**Canary Digital Group**
, is an emerging Indian aerospace technology company focused on the design, development and manufacturing of advanced Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs), autonomous aerial platforms and next-generation aerospace technologies.

Our vision is to develop indigenous aerospace systems by integrating advanced electronics, embedded computing, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Vision, autonomous navigation and precision engineering.

We are actively developing multicopter and fixed-wing VTOL platforms, proprietary flight-control electronics, ground control systems, communication solutions and autonomous UAV infrastructure.

As we expand our in-house engineering and R&D capabilities, we are seeking a passionate and technically accomplished
**Hardware Engineer – Embedded Systems & PCB Design**
to join our aerospace development team in Kalamassery, Kerala.

About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on Hardware Engineer who can take complete ownership of electronic hardware development — from requirements and circuit design to PCB layout, prototyping, board bring-up, debugging, validation and production readiness.

The selected candidate will play a key role in developing indigenous electronic systems for UAV platforms, including flight-control boards, power distribution systems, sensor interfaces, communication electronics and intelligent payload systems.

**This is not merely a PCB layout position.**
You will be expected to understand the complete hardware–software interface, troubleshoot real-world engineering challenges and work closely with embedded firmware, avionics, mechanical and autonomous systems teams.

Your designs will become part of actual UAV platforms undergoing integration, ground testing and flight validation.

Key Responsibilities1. Electronic Hardware & PCB Design

* Design and develop multi-layer PCBs for UAV and aerospace applications.
* Own the complete PCB development lifecycle, including schematic capture, component selection, PCB layout, design verification and manufacturing release.
* Develop flight-control boards, power distribution boards, Electronic Speed Controller (ESC) interfaces, telemetry boards, sensor interfaces and payload electronics.
* Perform Design for Manufacturing (DFM) reviews and coordinate with PCB fabrication and assembly vendors.
* Prepare Bills of Materials (BOM), fabrication files, assembly documentation and engineering change records.

2. Embedded Systems & Hardware Integration

* Integrate microcontrollers and embedded computing platforms, including STM32, ESP32, NVIDIA Jetson, Raspberry Pi Compute Modules and similar systems.
* Work closely with firmware engineers on hardware bring-up, embedded C/C++ development and peripheral driver debugging.
* Design and validate interfaces such as UART, SPI, I2C, CAN, USB and Ethernet.
* Integrate navigation and environmental sensors, communication modules and mission payloads.
* Troubleshoot hardware–firmware interaction issues through systematic testing and debugging.

3. Power Electronics & Battery Systems

* Design power distribution and regulation circuits for UAV applications.
* Develop and validate buck converters, boost converters, LDO regulators and protection circuits.
* Support high-current battery-powered systems, including 12S–14S lithium-ion battery configurations.
* Implement current and voltage sensing, power monitoring, protection and redundancy mechanisms.
* Contribute to battery management, charging electronics and hot-swap power architectures.

4. Hardware Testing, Debugging & Validation

* Perform PCB bring-up, functional verification and fault diagnosis.
* Use oscilloscopes, logic analysers, programmable power supplies, multimeters and electronic loads.
* Carry out soldering, rework and troubleshooting of complex electronic assemblies, including fine-pitch and QFN components.
* Analyse signal integrity, power integrity, grounding and noise-related issues.
* Support EMI/EMC, vibration, thermal and environmental testing relevant to UAV applications.
* Participate in ground integration and flight-test validation activities.

5. Aerospace Electronics & Autonomous Systems

* Contribute to the development of proprietary autopilot and flight-control electronics.
* Support integration of IMU, GNSS/RTK, magnetometer, barometer, airspeed, voltage and current sensors.
* Develop electronic interfaces for telemetry, communications, propulsion and autonomous payloads.
* Support autonomous UAV docking infrastructure, including charging systems, battery-swapping electronics, safety interlocks and station-control boards.
* Collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams to ensure reliable system-level integration.

6. Engineering Documentation & Product Development

* Maintain schematics, PCB design files, wiring diagrams, interface control documents and test reports.
* Document hardware revisions, validation results, technical specifications and design decisions.
* Support the complete engineering lifecycle from concept development and prototyping to testing, qualification and manufacturing.
* Identify design improvements to enhance reliability, performance, manufacturability and cost efficiency.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* **2–8 years of relevant hands-on experience**
  in electronic hardware design, embedded systems or PCB development.
* Proven experience designing PCBs using Altium Designer, KiCad, OrCAD or equivalent EDA tools.
* Strong knowledge of analog and digital electronics, circuit design and electronic components.
* Practical understanding of power supply design, signal integrity, grounding and protection circuits.
* Working proficiency in Embedded C/C++ for hardware bring-up, debugging and peripheral interfacing.
* Experience with microcontrollers, communication protocols and embedded peripheral integration.
* Hands-on familiarity with oscilloscopes, logic analysers, power supplies and other electronic laboratory equipment.
* Ability to troubleshoot and rework assembled PCBs.
* Experience integrating sensors such as IMUs, GNSS, barometers and current/voltage monitoring devices.
* Ability to independently take a PCB design from schematic to a functioning, tested hardware prototype.

**Education:**
An engineering degree or diploma is welcome; however, relevant practical experience, demonstrated engineering capability and a strong technical portfolio will carry greater weight than academic background. Self-taught engineers with proven expertise are also encouraged to apply.

Preferred Skills – Added Advantage

* Experience with UAV flight-control systems, autopilot electronics or drone hardware.
* Familiarity with PX4, ArduPilot, Pixhawk hardware architecture, MAVLink or DroneCAN/UAVCAN.
* Experience with radio-frequency systems, telemetry, antenna integration, LTE/5G modules or satellite communication interfaces.
* Knowledge of functional safety, redundant system architecture or aerospace assurance practices such as DO-178C/DO-254.
* Experience with high-voltage UAV propulsion electronics, including battery configurations above 12S.
* Exposure to FPGA development or high-speed digital circuit design.
* Previous hardware engineering experience in UAV, aerospace, automotive, space or defence applications.
* Personal engineering projects involving drones, robotics, embedded electronics or autonomous systems.

What You Will Work On

You will contribute to the development of challenging and innovative aerospace technologies, including:

* **Indigenous UAV Flight-Control Electronics:**
  Proprietary autopilot hardware, navigation sensor interfaces and flight-control boards.
* **Power Management & Propulsion Electronics:**
  UAV power distribution, monitoring, protection and battery integration.
* **Advanced Embedded Computing:**
  Electronics supporting autonomous navigation, onboard AI processing and intelligent camera payloads.
* **Autonomous UAV Docking Systems:**
  Charging electronics, battery-swapping mechanisms, control interfaces and safety systems.
* **Next-Generation UAV Platforms:**
  Electronic hardware for multicopter and fixed-wing VTOL aircraft.

Why Join Canary Aerospace?

**Build Real Aerospace Technology**

Work on electronic systems that will be manufactured, integrated and tested on actual UAV platforms.

**End-to-End Engineering Ownership**

Take responsibility for complete hardware development, from schematics and PCB design through prototype validation.

**Indigenous Technology Development**

Contribute directly to the development of proprietary Indian aerospace and embedded technologies.

**Multidisciplinary Innovation**

Collaborate with teams working in aerospace engineering, AI, Computer Vision, avionics, autonomous systems and advanced manufacturing.

**Hands-On R&D Environment**

Work in a focused, engineering-driven environment with direct access to hardware prototyping and testing.

**Professional Growth**

Be part of a growing aerospace technology company with opportunities to contribute to increasingly advanced platforms and engineering programmes.

How to Apply

We invite passionate electronics and embedded systems engineers who enjoy designing, building, debugging and validating real-world hardware.

Please submit your
**updated CV along with a technical portfolio**
showcasing relevant projects.

Your portfolio may include:

* PCB schematics, layouts or photographs of developed boards.
* Embedded hardware or firmware projects.
* Prototype development, testing or debugging demonstrations.
* Engineering reports, photographs, videos or other evidence of working hardware.

Please briefly explain your individual technical contribution to the projects submitted.

**Apply through LinkedIn Jobs.**

Shortlisted candidates may be invited to complete a practical technical assessment relevant to the role.

title: Btech engineer
description:
Hiring: Civil Site Engineer – Railway Infrastructure Project

Project: IPN Irumpanam Railway Yard – Augmentation of Freight Maintenance Facilities

Location: Irumpanam, Ernakulam, Kerala

Department: Civil Engineering / Project Execution

Employment Type: Full-time, Site-based

About the Role

We are looking for a technically competent and result-oriented Civil Site Engineer to join our railway infrastructure project at Irumpanam, Kerala. The candidate will be responsible for supervising site execution, ensuring quality and safety standards, monitoring work progress, maintaining project documentation, and coordinating with railway officials, consultants, subcontractors, and material suppliers.

The ideal candidate should have practical experience in civil construction and the ability to manage site activities independently while maintaining compliance with approved drawings, technical specifications, and Indian Railways requirements.

Key Responsibilities

\* Supervise and execute civil construction activities in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, and project schedules.

\* Manage reinforced cement concrete (RCC), plain cement concrete (PCC), concrete pavement (CC), reinforcement steel, excavation, earthwork, and structural works.

\* Coordinate dismantling and reconstruction of catwalks, permanent way (P.Way) activities, and associated railway infrastructure works.

\* Monitor daily labour deployment, machinery utilisation, material consumption, and work productivity.

\* Prepare and maintain measurement books (MBs), quantity statements, daily progress reports (DPRs), and records required for running account (RA) bills.

\* Maintain site registers, including cement, steel, cube testing, excavation, attendance, and hindrance registers.

\* Coordinate concrete sampling, cube testing, material inspections, soil testing, and other required quality-control procedures.

\* Ensure proper reinforcement inspection, shuttering checks, concrete placement, curing, and quality documentation.

\* Identify site hindrances, drawing discrepancies, pending approvals, and work-front constraints; report them promptly with supporting records.

\* Coordinate with railway engineering officials for site inspections, measurements, approvals, work permissions, and execution requirements.

\* Monitor construction progress against planned targets and proactively resolve execution-related issues.

\* Ensure compliance with site safety requirements, railway working protocols, and applicable technical specifications.

\* Maintain accurate records of materials received, consumed, and balance quantities at the site.

Eligibility Criteria

\* Diploma or B.Tech/B.E. in Civil Engineering.

\* Relevant experience in civil construction, infrastructure projects, or railway works.

\* Working knowledge of RCC, PCC, CC pavement, reinforcement detailing, quantity estimation, and construction measurements.

\* Familiarity with BOQs, technical specifications, RA billing, and site documentation.

\* Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and coordinate with project stakeholders.

\* Proficiency in MS Excel and basic project reporting tools.

\* Strong site-management, problem-solving, communication, and coordination skills.

Preferred: Experience in Indian Railways projects, railway yards, P.Way-related civil works, government infrastructure contracts, or construction projects involving formal inspection and billing procedures.

What We Expect

We are looking for an engineer who takes ownership of site execution, maintains accurate documentation, identifies issues before they affect progress, and ensures that work is completed safely, efficiently, and to the required quality standards.

Interested candidates: Apply through LinkedIn or share your CV, relevant project experience, current location, notice period, and salary expectations.

Keywords: Civil Site Engineer | Railway Construction | Indian Railways | RCC | PCC | CC Pavement | P.Way | RA Billing | Quantity Surveying | Quality Control | Infrastructure Projects

title: Independent Director
description:
**What this Board needs protected**

The institution's licence to grow rests on the quality of its lending, funding, customer treatment and control environment. The independent director will sit across the Audit, Risk, NRC and CSR agenda, bringing the ability to see how a commercial decision migrates through credit behaviour, liquidity, collections, provisioning, reputation and regulatory accountability.

This is not a role for a specialist who views risk only through policy limits. The Board requires an individual who can interrogate portfolio movement at cohort and segment level, recognise when apparent stability is being produced by restructures or collection practices, and judge whether capital and liquidity remain adequate under a plausible operating shock. The director must also understand that conduct failures can begin in target design, vendor incentives or digital journeys long before they become complaints.

**The mandate in practice**

The appointee will challenge credit strategy using vintage curves, roll rates, concentration, collection efficiency, loss emergence and collateral realisation rather than a single gross-NPA number. Product approval papers should show the customer need, risk appetite consumed, operational readiness, model limitations, adverse-case economics and accountable owner after launch.

Funding and asset-liability oversight will require close attention to tenor mismatches, refinancing dependence, encumbrance, covenant headroom and liquidity under name-specific stress. The director should insist that contingency actions are executable within the time shown in the stress test—not merely available in theory.

On Audit Committee matters, the member will examine expected-credit-loss governance, management overlays, write-offs, income recognition, related parties, securitisation or assignment accounting, technology access and third-party assurance. On the Risk Committee, the same person must connect those accounting judgements to appetite, collections, fraud, cyber events and operational resilience.

Customer outcomes form a separate line of responsibility. The Board should see complaints by root cause, repeat incidence, vulnerability, channel, product and resolution quality. Outsourced sales, field collection, recovery agents, digital consent and grievance handling must be governed as extensions of the institution, not as vendor matters.

**Questions candidates should be ready to answer**

* When can rapid portfolio growth make the headline delinquency ratio temporarily more reassuring rather than more informative?
* What evidence would cause you to challenge a management overlay even when the external auditor accepts it?
* How do you test whether a liquidity contingency plan can be executed during simultaneous market and reputation stress?
* Which early conduct indicators belong at Board level before a regulator or ombudsman trend is visible?
* How would you distinguish healthy digital underwriting from a model whose exclusions are producing unfair or unstable outcomes?

**Appointment standard**

Candidates may come from regulated lending, banking, insurance, credit bureau, risk, finance or supervisory backgrounds. They should have held enterprise accountability for a balance sheet, credit portfolio, treasury, risk framework or regulated operation. The Board values evidence of independent challenge, remedial follow-through and clear communication under regulatory scrutiny. A valid DIN and completion of statutory independent-director databank obligations are required by appointment. Expect quarterly meetings, committee preparation, an annual risk workshop and occasional availability for material regulatory or liquidity events.

title: Lock Desk Analyst – U.S. Mortgage
description:
**The Lock Desk Analyst manages mortgage rate lock requests, pricing, lock changes, extensions, relocks, and cancellations according to company policies, investor guidelines, and market pricing. The role involves coordinating with Loan Officers (LOs), Loan Processors (LPs), Secondary Marketing, underwriting, and investors to ensure accurate pricing, timely lock execution, and compliance with established procedures. The analyst also reviews daily investor rate sheets, maintains pricing accuracy in mortgage systems, investigates and resolves pricing discrepancies, and supports the smooth functioning of the mortgage lock desk.**

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Mortgage Rate Lock Management: 

 

Process rate lock requests from Loan Officers (LOs) and Loan Processors (LPs), verify loan details (amount, program, interest rate, LTV, FICO, occupancy, property type, and lock period), ensure eligibility and compliance with company policies and investor guidelines, and accurately process new locks, changes, extensions, relocks, and cancellations on time. Monitor lock expirations, communicate confirmations, rejections, and required corrections, and maintain accurate records in the loan origination system.

 

2. Mortgage Pricing and Rate Sheet Management: 

 

Download and review daily investor rate sheets for dates, pricing adjustments, product availability, and lock periods. Upload and maintain rate sheets and pricing data in the pricing engine. Compare investor pricing with internal systems to identify differences. Review base pricing, loan-level price adjustments (LLPAs), margins, concessions, discount points, and lender credits. Calculate and verify final borrower or broker pricing according to company policies. Provide accurate pricing information to Loan Officers for eligible loan scenarios.

 

3. Lock Extensions, Relocks, and Pricing Exceptions: 

 

Review and process lock extensions, relocks, and pricing exceptions according to company policies. Calculate extension fees, relock fees, and pricing adjustments. Check lock history, expiration dates, previous extensions, and available free extension days. Process pricing concessions and exceptions only after obtaining the required approvals. Verify approval authority and maintain supporting documents. Communicate applicable fees, pricing impacts, and processing restrictions to the requesting teams.

 

4. Investor Guidelines and Product Eligibility: 

 

Review investor guidelines and product eligibility before processing lock requests. Verify delegated and non-delegated lending channels, where applicable. Confirm product availability based on loan program, credit score, occupancy, LTV, loan purpose, and other applicable criteria. Identify investor-specific restrictions and escalate exceptions when needed. Coordinate with investor representatives to resolve pricing, eligibility, and lock-related issues. Ensure all pricing and lock activities follow investor requirements and internal policies. 

5. Communication and Issue Resolution: 

 

Respond to inquiries from Loan Officers, Loan Processors, Secondary Marketing, and other internal teams. Explain pricing differences, lock rejections, extension fees, and investor restrictions clearly. Follow up on pending lock requests, pricing exceptions, and unresolved system issues. Escalate complex pricing and eligibility concerns to the appropriate manager or authorized approver. Maintain professional communication and meet established service-level agreements (SLAs).

 

6. Quality Control and Reporting: 

 

Maintain accurate records of lock requests, confirmations, extensions, relocks, cancellations, and pricing exceptions. Check loan details and pricing for accuracy. Prepare daily or periodic reports on lock activity, expiring locks, pending requests, and pricing issues. Follow internal controls, audit requirements, and documentation standards.

 

**Required Qualifications**

* A Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field is preferred.
* At least 1 year of experience in U.S. mortgage operations, Secondary Marketing, or mortgage rate lock desk operations is preferred.
* Knowledge of mortgage pricing, rate locks, extensions, relocks, cancellations, and Conventional, FHA, VA, USDA, and applicable Non-QM products is required, along with Excel, Microsoft Office, and pricing analysis skills.
* Strong analytical, numerical, problem-solving, and communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple requests under tight deadlines are essential.

 

**Key Competencies & Performance Metrics**

* Strong analytical, numerical, and problem-solving skills.
* Accuracy in mortgage pricing, rate locks, extensions, and relocks.
* Good time management, prioritization, and attention to detail.
* Effective communication, teamwork, and knowledge of investor guidelines and compliance requirements.
* Timely processing of lock requests, quick resolution of pricing issues, and adherence to company policies and service-level agreements (SLAs).
* Accurate documentation, audit readiness, and reduction of processing errors.

**Work Schedule & Location**

**Must be available to work according to U.S. mortgage business hours, including the applicable U.S. time zone and market-related deadlines.**

Shift Time: 7:30pm to 4:30am IST

title: AI Architect
description:
We are seeking an experienced AI Architect to design and guide the implementation of secure, scalable, and production-ready artificial intelligence solutions. This role will establish enterprise AI architecture, lead technical design decisions, and support the delivery of machine learning and generative AI capabilities across cloud and enterprise environments.

The ideal candidate combines strong architecture and software engineering experience with hands-on knowledge of large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, AI governance, cloud platforms, and enterprise application integration.

Key Responsibilities

AI Solution Architecture and Delivery

* Design end-to-end architectures for machine learning and generative AI solutions.
* Lead the architecture and implementation of solutions involving large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, intelligent document processing, automation, and predictive analytics.
* Define reusable architectural patterns, reference architectures, and technical standards for enterprise AI.
* Guide engineering teams in developing, testing, deploying, and maintaining AI solutions that support clinical, operational, and administrative use cases.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies and recommend appropriate platforms, models, tools, and implementation approaches.

Enterprise AI Infrastructure

* Design and optimize enterprise AI infrastructure across cloud and hybrid environments.
* Define architectural requirements for scalability, availability, security, reliability, and performance.
* Establish deployment, monitoring, and operational standards for AI workloads.
* Support platform health, system performance, capacity planning, and infrastructure readiness.
* Collaborate with cloud, infrastructure, security, data, and application teams to ensure architectural alignment.

Enterprise Systems Integration

* Design integration patterns connecting AI capabilities with enterprise applications, data platforms, healthcare systems, and business workflows.
* Define secure interfaces, APIs, data pipelines, and orchestration patterns for AI-enabled solutions.
* Partner with business and technical teams to understand system dependencies and integration requirements.
* Support implementation teams in resolving complex integration and architectural challenges.

AI Governance, Security, and Responsible AI

* Establish AI quality, safety, security, privacy, and governance standards.
* Define evaluation frameworks, testing approaches, validation methods, and monitoring requirements for AI solutions.
* Ensure solutions comply with organizational policies, regulatory requirements, and responsible AI principles.
* Identify and mitigate technical, operational, security, privacy, and model-related risks.
* Incorporate human oversight, traceability, and appropriate controls into AI solution designs.

Technical Leadership and Stakeholder Partnership

* Serve as a technical subject matter expert supporting AI strategy, adoption, and solution implementation.
* Translate complex technical concepts into clear recommendations for business and executive stakeholders.
* Lead architectural reviews and provide technical direction to engineering and delivery teams.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies and provide implementation guidance.
* Present findings, recommendations, architectural decisions, and solution options to technical and nontechnical audiences.
* Collaborate across clinical, operational, technical, security, compliance, and executive teams.

Required Qualifications

Education

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* Equivalent combinations of education, relevant certifications, and professional experience may be considered.

Experience

* Minimum of
  **5 years of professional experience**
  in AI, machine learning, software engineering, data engineering, solution architecture, or a closely related field.
* Demonstrated experience designing and implementing enterprise-scale AI or machine learning solutions.
* Experience developing solutions using Python and modern software engineering practices.
* Experience with cloud-based AI services and infrastructure, including Microsoft Azure or Amazon Web Services, and Databricks.
* Experience with generative AI technologies, large language models, prompt engineering, and retrieval-augmented generation.
* Experience integrating AI capabilities with enterprise applications, APIs, data platforms, and business workflows.
* Experience establishing technical standards, reusable architecture patterns, or reference architectures.
* Experience moving AI solutions from proof of concept into secure and supportable production environments.

Required Knowledge and Skills

* Advanced knowledge of artificial intelligence, machine learning, and generative AI technologies.
* Strong understanding of large language models, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector search, and retrieval-augmented generation.
* Knowledge of AI solution architecture, system integration, application architecture, and data architecture.
* Understanding of cloud architecture, containerization, distributed systems, APIs, and modern deployment practices.
* Familiarity with structured and unstructured data management and analytics platforms, such as Databricks or comparable technologies.
* Knowledge of AI governance, model evaluation, validation methodologies, privacy, security, risk management, and responsible AI.
* Ability to evaluate technical tradeoffs and recommend solutions based on business, architectural, security, and operational requirements.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and technical decision-making skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across clinical, operational, technical, security, compliance, and executive teams.

Preferred Qualifications

* Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Engineering, or a related field.
* Relevant cloud, architecture, data, security, or AI certifications.
* Experience working in healthcare or another highly regulated industry.
* Experience with healthcare data, clinical systems, or electronic health record environments.
* Experience implementing AI governance, model monitoring, or AI risk-management frameworks.
* Experience guiding multidisciplinary teams through AI solution design and production implementation

description:
**Company Overview**
Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone is focused on building an employee-first, performance-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. The company specializes in providing solutions across Application Services and Consulting, Digital Product Engineering, Digital Workplace Services, Private Cloud Services, AI/Automation, and ServiceNow. Milestone culture is built to provide a collaborative, inclusive environment that supports employees and empowers them to reach their full potential.
  
  
Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone’s best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short-term and long-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.
  
  
**Job Overview**
Requirements ownership (approx. 80%)
  
  

* Own requirements end to end for Module 3 enablement — elicitation, documentation, prioritisation, traceability from business objective through to delivered capability and acceptance.
* Act as the translator between HEOR business stakeholders and the AI&D and platform engineering teams: convert domain and workflow need into requirements the engineers can build against, and convert technical constraints back into decisions the business can actually make.
* Plan and lead requirements definition working sessions and workshops, bringing the Lead AI Engineer in where feasibility needs to be assessed live rather than discovered later.
* Work with business SMEs to surface nuanced requirements that differ across sections and content types, and document them at a level of precision an engineer can act on without a follow-up conversation.
* Define acceptance criteria for AI-generated content — factual grounding, source traceability, completeness against the section template, tone and terminology consistency — in terms the business owns and the engineers can test against.
* Build on the substantial documentation already produced through the POC work rather than restarting discovery. Establish quickly what is complete, what remains, and what is at risk.
* Refine requirements iteratively across the execution period as SME review cycles reveal what the platform can and cannot yet do, without losing the thread of what was originally agreed.

Delivery coordination (approx. 20%)
  
  

* Hold the pod’s delivery cadence: backlog, sprint rhythm, stand-ups and review cycles, run in the client’s tooling.
* Sequence work realistically against actual capacity and state clearly what can and cannot be delivered within the pilot window.
* Own weekly progress and status reporting to Amgen — at a level of candour that surfaces problems while they are still cheap to fix.
* Identify, log and escalate blockers, risks and dependencies early, particularly those sitting with the core APEX build team, with source-content availability, or with SME review capacity.
* Maintain the risk, issue, decision and assumption log for the engagement.

Stakeholder leadership
  
  

* Hold the day-to-day relationship with HEOR subject-matter experts and the wider business group, and be the single point they come to for scope and progress.
* Coordinate across the three organisations involved — HEOR, AI&D and the platform team — without formal authority over any of them.
* Push back on requirements, scope additions and timeline expectations where the evidence warrants, with reasoning rather than resistance.
* Protect the engineers’ focus: absorb coordination load, filter noise, and ensure they receive requirements that are decided rather than still being argued.
* Document and hand over requirements, decisions and open items in a form the Amgen team can own after the pilot.

**Required Qualifications**

* Experience. 10+ years in business analysis, business systems analysis or a comparable requirements-owning role, including a minimum of 3 years on AI, GenAI, machine learning or intelligent-automation programmes.
* AI lifecycle fluency. Demonstrable experience across the full AI delivery lifecycle — not a single pilot. Practical understanding of hallucination, non-determinism, human-in-the-loop requirements and output variability, and how each changes the way requirements must be written.
* Hands-on GenAI literacy. Working familiarity with GPT/Claude-class tooling — enough to understand how prompting, templatisation and output structuring work, and to hold a credible conversation with engineers about what is and is not achievable.
* Requirements craft. Strong elicitation technique, functional and non-functional specification, acceptance criteria, and traceability discipline across multiple interconnected workstreams.
* Workshop leadership. Proven ability to plan and lead requirements workshops with senior, non-technical business stakeholders and drive them to decisions rather than discussion.
* Delivery discipline. Experience running an agile delivery cadence — backlog, sprints, status reporting, risk and dependency management — for a small team.
* Influence without authority. A track record of holding multiple organisations to commitments from outside all of them, evidenced by unblocking programmes rather than documenting them.
* Autonomy. Demonstrated ability to own a workstream and set its working practices without close supervision, in a client-facing setting.
* Tooling. Proficiency with Jira; familiarity with Smartsheet and SharePoint.
* Communication. Excellent written and verbal English, at the standard required to write for and present to senior commercial stakeholders in the US and Europe, and to disagree constructively.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Prior delivery within a life sciences, pharmaceutical or biotech commercial organisation — market access, HEOR, medical affairs or commercial analytics. Useful context, but not a screening filter.
* Experience with AI-assisted document authoring, content generation, knowledge management or large-scale content transformation.
* Exposure to retrieval-augmented generation and the requirement implications of grounding and source attribution.
* Familiarity with regulated or GxP-adjacent documentation environments and their traceability expectations.
* Experience in a self-directed vendor pod operating alongside, but independently of, a client’s internal build team.
* Formal certification in business analysis (CBAP/CCBA), agile delivery (CSPO, PSM) or project management (PMP).

title: Account Director
description:
**About HyperVerge**

HyperVerge is a deep tech AI company that builds identity verification, fraud prevention and compliance infrastructure for regulated businesses. Banks, NBFCs, insurers, brokers and fintechs use our platform to onboard customers faster, meet regulatory requirements and stop fraud before it reaches their books.

* 2 Bn+ identities verified
* 500+ enterprises served across India and Southeast Asia
* Top-ranked globally in the NIST FRVT face recognition benchmark
* Best in Class Regtech at Global Fintech Fest four times: 2022, 2024, 2025 and 2026
* 300+ team members

**What we build**

* Digital and Video KYC: Aadhaar eKYC, DigiLocker, CKYC, Video KYC, Self Video KYC and Video PD
* Face AI: liveness, face match, face deduplication and deepfake detection
* Document AI: OCR and fraud checks on IDs, bank statements, salary slips and other financial documents
* Verification and compliance: bank account verification, business (KYB) checks, AML screening and monitoring, and eSign
* HyperVerge One: a workflow orchestration platform with case management and analytics, so customers can design and launch onboarding journeys fast

**Key Responsibilities**

* Build and run a pipeline of large banks, NBFCs, insurers, brokers and fintechs

* Build trusted relationships with senior decision makers and multiple stakeholders in each account
* Turn regulatory requirements and fraud trends into clear business cases for customers
* Work with product, solutions and customer success to make every go-live a success
* Forecast accurately and keep CRM hygiene disciplined
* Bring market and customer feedback back to the product team

**Outcomes expected**

* Develop a deep understanding of HyperVerge technology and products within your first month
* Acquire 20+ new logos and generate $50K to $75K in new monthly recurring revenue by 31 March 2028
* Consistently meet or exceed mutually agreed monthly sales goals

**Requirements**

**Must haves**

* 4+ years of client-facing experience (sales or account management) with large BFSI enterprises
* Experience handling accounts with ACV of $75,000 or more
* A track record of consistently over-achieving targets
* Experience mentoring or managing salespeople
* A collaborative, process-oriented way of working

**Good to have**

* B2B enterprise SaaS sales experience
* Deep understanding of onboarding, KYC, credit underwriting and fraud prevention processes in India
* A strong network across the Indian BFSI industry

**Who thrives here**

* Curious and empathetic people who care about the growth of everyone around them
* Self-aware, with humble confidence: you know your craft and your gaps, and you learn openly
* People who want clarity in their goals and bring structure to go after them
* Fast learners. Identity and fraud change every quarter, and so do we

**Why join us**

* Sell award-winning, globally benchmarked AI into one of the fastest-moving markets in Indian finance
* Real ownership: your own number and your own accounts
* Work closely with leadership on how we win in BFSI
* Purpose beyond revenue. We reinvest in the communities that got us here through HyperVerge Academy, and we intend to keep building a company that outlives all of us

**Travel**

10 to 20% domestic travel for client meetings.
