title: Customer Relations Manager
description:
**Company Description**

Incheon Kia is a leading Kia dealership network serving customers across Kerala, with locations in Ernakulam, Thrissur, Alappuzha, Kottayam, Idukki, Palakkad, Kollam, and Trivandrum. The dealership is expanding its presence with an upcoming branch in Pathanamthitta, reflecting a strong focus on growth and accessibility. Incheon Kia provides comprehensive sales and service support, including test drives and booking assistance, to deliver a convenient and reliable customer experience. The team is dedicated to building long-term relationships by offering professional guidance, transparent processes, and responsive service. Applicants joining Incheon Kia will be part of a customer-focused organization committed to excellence in the automotive retail sector.

**Role Description**

The Customer Relations Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in Ernakulam. This role is responsible for managing the customer experience across the dealership, including greeting and assisting customers, responding to inquiries, and ensuring timely follow-up after test drives, bookings, and service visits. Daily tasks include handling customer feedback and complaints, coordinating with sales and service teams to resolve issues, and maintaining accurate customer records in CRM systems. The Customer Relations Manager will implement customer communication plans, monitor satisfaction levels, and support promotional activities or events to strengthen customer loyalty. The role also involves preparing periodic reports on customer feedback, identifying areas for improvement, and supporting team members in delivering consistent, high-quality service.

**Qualifications**

* Strong customer service and relationship management skills, with the ability to handle inquiries, feedback, and complaints professionally.
* Excellent communication skills in English and local languages, with clear verbal and written abilities suitable for customer-facing interactions.
* Organizational and time-management skills, including maintaining records, following up with customers, and coordinating with internal teams.
* Basic proficiency in computer applications and CRM or dealership management systems to log interactions and track customer journeys.
* Experience in the automotive, retail, or service industry is preferred, with a proven focus on customer satisfaction and service quality.
* Ability to work on-site in Ernakulam collaborate with cross-functional teams, and adapt to a fast-paced dealership environment.
* Minimum of a bachelor’s degree in Business, communcation, marketing, hospitality, or a related field is an advantage.

FED Adjuster
  
  
**FED Adjuster**
Otis is the world’s leading elevator and escalator company, moving 2.5 billion people every day and maintaining over ~2.5 million units globally. With a global team of 72,000 colleagues, including 45,000 field professionals, Otis delivers innovative, safe and reliable mobility solutions found in many of the world’s most iconic buildings and busiest transport hubs. Operating in 200+ countries and territories, Otis combines global expertise with strong local capabilities. Guided by a clear vision to help people thrive in a taller, faster, smarter world, Otis is committed to customer‑centric service, future‑focused innovation, and responsible corporate citizenship.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
The Adjustor is responsible for adjustment and commissioning of elevators and escalators in compliance with Otis safety standards, ensuring timely delivery, quality documentation, and on-site technical support.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Be fully conversant and compliant with Otis EH&S policies
* Follow safety procedures as per Otis safety standards.
* Ensure adherence to ethics guidelines.
* Understand layout drawings, Field Installation Manual, wiring diagrams and procedures.
* Responsible for adjustment/commissioning of elevators, escalators and travelators as per Otis Field Installation Manual including high-speed gearless units.
* Manage test engineers on multi-unit sites ensuring safe and efficient commissioning
* Provide technical support and upskilling of test engineers.
* Audit test and EN81 compliance handover documentation.
* Liaise with clients during testing on large multi-unit sites and attend Commissioning meetings.
* Take quality readings and ensure seamless handover from New Equipment to Service.
* Support service teams during Quality Operating Period on technical issues.
* Troubleshoot electrical/mechanical faults and conduct RRCA.
* Prepare installation inspection reports, field test data, safety check reports, and Otis safety audits
* Report on-site field turnbacks at product level
* Ensure 100% on-time delivery to customers
* Address and acknowledge all internal customer complaints

Qualification & Requirements
  
  

* Diploma in Engineering, preferably Electrical or Electronics
* 2 to 5 years of experience in Elevator Industry as Adjustor

**What You Need To Be Successful At Otis**

* Customer‑Centric Mindset

Otis is committed to being a world‑class, customer‑focused service company, success begins with understanding and caring for customer needs.
  
  
If you live in a city, chances are we will give you a lift or play a role in keeping you moving every day.

description:
Position
**: Physiotherapist**

Department : Clinical

Employment Type : Full-Time

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a skilled, compassionate, and patient-focused
**Physiotherapist**

to join our clinical team. The role involves assessing patients,

developing individualized treatment plans, delivering evidence-based

physiotherapy interventions, monitoring progress, and educating patients

and caregivers about rehabilitation and preventive care.

The

physiotherapist is expected to maintain high clinical standards while

ensuring a positive and professional patient experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Patient Assessment

* Conduct detailed physiotherapy assessments based on the patient's condition and medical history.
* Identify functional limitations, pain, movement restrictions, muscle weakness, and other physical impairments.
* Establish appropriate short-term and long-term rehabilitation goals.
* Perform reassessments to track patient progress.

2. Treatment & Rehabilitation

* Develop and implement individualized treatment plans.
* Provide physiotherapy interventions for
  **orthopaedic, neurological, sports, geriatric, and post-operative conditions**
  .
* Deliver treatments such as:
* Therapeutic exercises
* Manual therapy
* Strength and conditioning
* Mobility and flexibility training
* Myofascial release
* Dry needling, where appropriately trained
* Electrotherapy and ultrasound
* Taping techniques
* Functional rehabilitation
* Balance and gait training
* Modify treatment plans based on patient response and clinical progress.

3. Patient Education

* Educate patients and caregivers regarding their condition and rehabilitation process.
* Provide appropriate home exercise programs.
* Explain preventive measures, posture, ergonomics, and lifestyle modifications.
* Encourage patient adherence and active participation in rehabilitation.

4. Documentation & Clinical Records

* Maintain accurate and timely patient records.
* Document assessments, treatment provided, progress, and future treatment plans.
* Follow clinic documentation standards and clinical protocols.
* Ensure all required records are completed within the prescribed timelines.

5. Patient Experience

* Build professional and trusting relationships with patients.
* Communicate treatment plans clearly and respectfully.
* Address patient concerns appropriately.
* Maintain patient confidentiality and professional ethics.
* Ensure every patient receives a safe, respectful, and positive clinical experience.

6. Team Collaboration

* Coordinate with doctors, therapists, nurses, and other healthcare professionals when required.
* Participate in case discussions and multidisciplinary rehabilitation planning.
* Support other physiotherapists and clinical team members when required.

7. Quality & Compliance

* Follow clinical SOPs, safety protocols, infection-control procedures, and organizational policies.
* Maintain professional standards and ethical practices.
* Participate in quality improvement initiatives and clinical audits.
* Stay updated with current physiotherapy practices and evidence-based rehabilitation approaches.

8. Additional Responsibilities

* Participate in camps, health awareness programs, workshops, and community outreach activities.
* Support patient education and rehabilitation-related content when required.
* Assist in promoting awareness of physiotherapy and rehabilitation services professionally.
* Participate in internal training and continuous professional development programs.

Required Qualifications

* **Bachelor of Physiotherapy (BPT)**
  .
* Valid professional registration/licence as applicable.
* Additional certifications in specialized physiotherapy techniques will be an advantage.

Experience

* **Freshers and experienced physiotherapists can apply.**
* Experience in orthopaedic, neurological, sports, geriatric, or rehabilitation settings will be an advantage.

Key Skills

* Strong clinical assessment and treatment skills
* Good knowledge of anatomy, physiology, and rehabilitation
* Manual therapy and exercise prescription skills
* Strong patient communication skills
* Empathy and patient-centred approach
* Good documentation skills
* Ability to work effectively within a multidisciplinary team
* Problem-solving and clinical decision-making skills
* Willingness to learn and develop professionally

**Performance Expectations**

The physiotherapist will be expected to maintain:

* High standards of clinical care
* Accurate and timely documentation
* Patient satisfaction and engagement
* Treatment adherence and follow-up
* Professional conduct and punctuality
* Compliance with clinical SOPs
* Continuous improvement in clinical knowledge and skills

Benefits

24 days of annual leave, 12 days of sick leave, plus maternity leave

(as per the Maternity Benefit Act) and up to 2 weeks of paternity leave

* **Team bonding allowance**
  every quarter for team outings
* **Statutory benefits:**
  PF, ESI and gratuity, as applicable

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a
**patient-focused, clinically competent, responsible, and growth-oriented physiotherapist**

who is passionate about rehabilitation and committed to delivering

measurable outcomes while creating a positive patient experience.

* Opportunity to work with a multidisciplinary rehabilitation team
* Exposure to diverse orthopaedic and neurological cases
* Opportunities for clinical learning and professional development

* Opportunities to participate in community and healthcare initiatives

title: Senior AI Evaluation Analyst
description:
**Senior AI Evaluation Analyst**

**Location:**
Kochi

**Experience:**
5–8 Years

**Role Overview**

Seeking an experienced and detail-oriented professional to join its Machine Learning Science team, supporting the development and improvement of AI-powered travel products. The team works on conversational AI agents that help travelers discover options, compare products, plan trips, and receive assistance throughout their travel journey.

You will play a key role in evaluating the quality, accuracy, relevance, and reliability of AI-generated responses against established guidelines and quality metrics. You will analyze evaluation results, identify recurring errors and quality gaps, and translate findings into actionable insights that help improve AI agent performance.

This role requires a strong foundation in data annotation, quality evaluation, analytical problem-solving, and guideline-based decision-making. The position is suited to professionals who enjoy hands-on evaluation and analysis of AI outputs rather than traditional business reporting or dashboard development.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate is an experienced, hands-on professional who combines strong evaluation and quality assurance skills with analytical thinking. They should be comfortable reviewing large volumes of information, applying structured guidelines, identifying recurring quality issues, and converting observations into meaningful insights.

Candidates with experience in AI evaluation, data annotation, content quality, search relevance, or similar quality-focused roles are encouraged to apply. Direct experience with LLMs or conversational AI is an advantage but is not mandatory for candidates with strong transferable experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Evaluate AI-generated responses from conversational agents against predefined guidelines, evaluation criteria, and quality standards.
* Perform and review data annotation, labelling, and classification to assess the accuracy, relevance, completeness, and appropriateness of AI-generated content.
* Identify and document incorrect, misleading, incomplete, inconsistent, or irrelevant responses, including potential AI hallucinations.
* Conduct quality assurance reviews to ensure consistency, accuracy, and adherence to evaluation guidelines.
* Analyze large and complex datasets to identify recurring errors, quality trends, performance gaps, and opportunities for improvement.
* Interpret quality metrics such as error rates, evaluation consistency, reviewer disagreement, and other relevant indicators.
* Investigate ambiguous or borderline cases and apply sound judgment while adhering to established evaluation criteria.
* Prepare clear documentation of evaluation findings, root causes, observations, and recommended improvements.
* Use Excel or Google Sheets and, where applicable, basic SQL to filter, analyze, and summarize evaluation data.
* Collaborate with Machine Learning Scientists, AI product teams, and other stakeholders to communicate quality insights and support improvements in AI agent performance.
* Contribute to the refinement of evaluation guidelines, quality frameworks, and review processes based on observed issues and emerging patterns.
* Maintain accurate documentation and track identified issues through appropriate ticketing and workflow management systems.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

* 5–8 years of relevant experience in data annotation, data labeling, AI evaluation, content quality, quality assurance, search relevance evaluation, or similar guideline-based assessment roles.
* Strong experience evaluating data, content, or system outputs against predefined guidelines, quality standards, and measurable criteria.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze large datasets, identify patterns, investigate quality issues, and derive actionable insights.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, particularly when dealing with ambiguous or inconsistent information.
* Excellent attention to detail and the ability to apply evaluation criteria consistently.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets for data filtering, analysis, quality tracking, and reporting.
* Strong written communication skills and the ability to document findings, explain issues, and communicate insights clearly.
* Ability to work independently on evaluation tasks while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
* Genuine interest in artificial intelligence, conversational AI, and data-driven product improvement.
* Experience with Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) workflows, AI training data validation, model output assessment, or LLM-as-a-judge evaluation.

**Good to Have**

* Exposure to Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, conversational agents, or AI-generated content evaluation.
* Familiarity with evaluating AI responses for factual accuracy, relevance, completeness, helpfulness, and hallucinations.
* Basic SQL knowledge for extracting, filtering, and analyzing datasets.
* Experience with quality metrics such as error rates, inter-annotator agreement, reviewer disagreement, and evaluation consistency.
* Experience maintaining evaluation guidelines, quality documentation, review workflows, or issue-tracking systems.
* Exposure to travel, hospitality, customer experience, search relevance, policy evaluation, or content quality operations.

title: B2B Content Specialist
description:
2Base Technologies is at a deliberate stage of building its marketing function, and this role owns the written voice of that function end to end.

We are a technology services company with over 16 years of delivery experience, working with mid-market and enterprise clients across the United States and the United Kingdom. Our work spans AI implementation, custom software development, legacy system modernisation, and operational transformation.

This is a writing role with a specific, demanding purpose. It is not a content management role or a social media role. If that distinction is unclear from the outset, this is probably not the right fit.

**What This Role Exists to Do**

This role does not invent the voice. It operationalises, applies, and enforces it across all written output: long-form content that earns search traffic, content written in the voice of senior leadership for professional publishing, and the quality standard for everything written that leaves this company.

The audience spans technical leaders and business decision-makers at mid-market companies. CTOs and IT Directors who evaluate architecture decisions, and Founders, COOs, and Operations leaders who are accountable for technology outcomes without always having a technical background. Writing that works across that range, without oversimplifying for one end or losing the other, is the actual craft challenge of this role. Technically credible, commercially relevant, and written with a clear point of view. That is the standard this role is hired to meet and maintain.

**What You Will Own**

* All long-form written content: pillar pages, blogs, playbooks, decision frameworks, and use-case libraries targeting senior decision-makers in the US and UK
* Written content produced in the voice of senior leadership for professional platforms, which requires the ability to write convincingly as someone other than yourself
* The 2Base content voice, including auditing all published content to ensure it meets the company's brand standards
* Content briefs written clearly enough that a junior team member can produce a first draft without needing to ask clarifying questions
* The content quality gate: nothing is published without passing through this role first
* AI tool usage as a productivity layer, not as a substitute for thinking

**What You Will Not Own**

* SEO keyword selection: the SEO Specialist sets this and you write within it
* Social media scheduling and publishing: a separate team member owns this
* Visual design of content assets: the Visual Designer owns this
* Distribution strategy: the Marketing & Growth Lead decides which channels content goes to
* ICP definition: you write for the ICP and you do not define it

**What We Are Looking For**

**Experience**

* Minimum 2 to 6 years writing B2B content
* Has written content that ranked on Google, not just content that was published
* Has written in voices other than their own, for executives, founders, or senior professionals
* Understands SEO at a working level: knows what search intent means and can write to it without being an SEO specialist
* Has worked with AI writing tools and knows both their value and their limits
* Can show content that contributed to a measurable outcome: traffic, leads, or engagement with the right audience
* Background in technology, SaaS, or professional services strongly preferred

**Writing Ability**

* Writes with a clear point of view, not neutral summaries of other people's ideas
* Can explain complex technical concepts in plain language without losing technical credibility
* Writes concisely with no filler, no padding, and no unnecessary qualification
* Can write in different voices and make each one sound authentic, not just adjusted

**Mindset**

* Treats content as a commercial tool, not a creative exercise
* Comfortable being edited and does not treat feedback as personal criticism
* Genuinely curious about AI, technology, and business operations, not faking interest to get the job
* Fast: this team moves at pace and cannot wait three days for a first draft

**What We Are Not Looking For**

* Portfolios of "Top 10 Tips" articles or trend summaries with no original thinking
* Writers who cannot explain how any of their content performed or what it contributed to
* Anyone who has never written for a technical or senior business audience and considers that detail irrelevant
* Writers who only produce self-directed content and have never worked consistently to a brief
* Anyone who cannot write convincingly in a voice other than their own
* Candidates who treat AI tools as the primary author and apply only light editing

**An Honest Note on This Role**

You will work with a documented marketing strategy and a defined brand voice from Day 1. You will take ownership of B2B content creation and help build the content workflow, writing briefs, and quality review process.

This role suits someone who enjoys writing for business decision-makers, translating technical concepts into clear content, and maintaining a consistent company voice. You should be comfortable taking initiative and building content practices as the team grows.

To apply, send your CV and two writing samples: one long-form B2B piece and one shorter piece written in a voice other than your own. If you do not have the second, tell us why in your cover note.

title: Learning and Change Transformation - Staff - Arabic Proficiency
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**EY GDS \| PEOPLE CONSULTING \| LEARNING \& CHANGE**
**Staff Consultant, Learning \& Change**
 Build consulting craft. Create with AI. Connect across languages.
   

  

**ROLE SNAPSHOT**
**Role:** 
 Staff Consultant, Learning \& Change
   

  

**Portfolio:** 
 Learning \& Development, People Consulting MENA
   

  

**Experience:** 
 2–4 years of relevant professional experience
   

  

**Capability model:** 
 Learning consulting with organisational change capability and AI\-enabled ways of working
   

  

**Travel:** 
 Up to 25% across KSA, UAE and Qatar, engagement\-dependent
   

  

**THE OPPORTUNITY**
 This role is an entry point into a consulting career in Learning and Change within EY GDS People Consulting. You will contribute to live MENA client work, strategic proposals and capability\-building initiatives across government, energy and financial services, with KSA as the primary growth market.
   

  

 You will own defined pieces of work, such as a storyboard, learning asset, stakeholder map, research pack, proposal section, workshop pack, readiness tracker or dashboard. The role blends learning design, change enablement, digital learning, project coordination and responsible use of AI. It is not a learning administration\-only position.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Learning design and capability development**
* Support learning needs analysis, learner personas, skills\-gap reviews and role\-to\-capability mapping.
* Help design learning journeys, curriculum maps, course outlines and blended learning experiences across ILT, VILT, WBT, microlearning and performance support.
* Develop e\-learning modules, storyboards, facilitator and learner guides, job aids, simulations, quick\-reference guides, assessments and reinforcement assets.
* Use adult learning principles and instructional design methods such as ADDIE or SAM, under guidance from senior team members.
* Support learning evaluation, feedback analysis, knowledge assessment and outcome reporting.


**Organisational change and adoption support**
* Maintain stakeholder registers, change\-impact logs, readiness trackers and adoption dashboards.
* Support stakeholder analysis, focus groups, surveys and workshop output synthesis.
* Draft change communications, campaign content, FAQs, toolkits and champion\-network materials for review.
* Assist with readiness, adoption and reinforcement activities that connect learning to business change outcomes.


**Pursuits, proposals and market support**
* Conduct structured client, sector, benchmark and competitor research for RFPs, RFQs and proactive proposals.
* Draft proposal content, credentials, CVs, case studies, methodology slides, workplan inputs and capability\-showcase materials.
* Create clear, consulting\-quality PowerPoint materials and maintain version control under tight deadlines.
* Use business\-level Arabic capability, where required, to review source material, support proposal content and participate in stakeholder discussions.
* Help maintain the capability, proposal and case\-study repositories.


**Client delivery, facilitation and learning operations**
* Own defined deliverables and project tasks, track dependencies and raise risks early.
* Prepare workshop materials, digital collaboration boards, logistics, attendance and feedback instruments; capture and structure outputs.
* Facilitate selected portions of learning sessions, focus groups and working meetings under appropriate supervision.
* Support learning intake, schedules, deployment, LMS or LXP content setup, testing, reporting and post\-course sustainment where included in project scope.
* Build collaborative working relationships with client contacts, subject\-matter experts and internal teams.


**AI\-enabled learning and digital content**
* Use Microsoft Copilot and other approved generative AI tools for research, synthesis, proposal support, storyboarding, assessment generation and content development.
* Apply human review, fact\-checking, privacy, copyright, accessibility and quality controls to all AI\-assisted outputs.
* Contribute to AI\-enabled learning use cases, including learning content generation, microlearning, personalised pathways and analytics support.
* Create or edit digital learning assets using tools such as Articulate Storyline and Rise, Captivate, Vyond, Camtasia, Synthesia, Clipchamp or comparable platforms.
* Support content upload, testing and reporting on platforms such as SuccessFactors Learning, Cornerstone, Workday Learning, Degreed, Docebo, SharePoint or similar environments.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Consulting potential: Structures information clearly, asks good questions and connects deliverables to the client need.
* Written and visual communication: Produces concise English and well\-structured presentations with strong attention to detail.
* Arabic business communication: Reads, writes and speaks Arabic at a level appropriate for proposal support, stakeholder interaction and workshop participation.
* AI fluency: Uses AI productively and responsibly rather than treating generated output as final.
* Design sensibility: Understands learning experience, usability, visual hierarchy and audience needs.
* Ownership and coachability: Closes assigned work, raises risks early and applies feedback quickly.
* Organisation: Manages several tasks, deadlines and versions without losing quality.


**Essential**
**QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE**
* 1–3 years of relevant experience in learning design, L\&D, content development, training delivery, change support, HR or organisational development, consulting or a related area.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, human resources, education, psychology, organisational development, communication, design or a related discipline.
* Working knowledge of adult learning principles and instructional design; exposure to ADDIE, SAM or comparable methods.
* Experience creating professional presentations, learning content, communications or structured business documents.
* Strong Microsoft PowerPoint, Word and Excel capability; familiarity with digital collaboration tools.
* Practical use of Microsoft Copilot or comparable generative AI tools for research, synthesis or content creation, with evidence of responsible review.
* Demonstrated business\-level Arabic proficiency in reading, writing and speaking, sufficient to review proposal content, take part in stakeholder discussions and support workshops. Proficiency will be assessed through a role\-relevant practical evaluation.
* Excellent spoken and written English and willingness to support MENA working hours.


**Preferred**
* Experience in a consulting, professional\-services, GCC\-facing or shared\-services environment.
* Exposure to organisational change frameworks.
* Hands\-on experience with at least one digital learning authoring or media tool.
* Exposure to LMS, LXP, digital adoption platforms, learning analytics or Power BI.
* Experience supporting proposals, market research, credentials or business\-development materials.
* Exposure to government, energy or financial\-services contexts.


**CERTIFICATIONS AND DEVELOPMENT**
**Required**
**Required at joining or within the agreed development plan**
* Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI or comparable applied AI fundamentals
* Design thinking / human\-centred design foundation
* Instructional design or adult learning foundation
* Change management foundation or agreed pathway


**Preferred / Differentiating**
* PROSCI foundation or equivalent
* APTD or similar learning credential
* Agile fundamentals
* Articulate, learning platform or learning analytics credential
* Arabic proficiency certification, where available, supported by practical assessment


**WAYS OF WORKING**
* Initial ramp\-up: approximately 50% client delivery, 30% pursuits and proposals, 10% capability building and 10% internal initiatives, subject to demand and staffing.
* Once deployed to a billable engagement: approximately 70% client delivery and 30% pursuits, proposal support and capability building, subject to engagement commitments and portfolio priorities.


**KEY SUCCESS MEASURES: FIRST 12 MONTHS**
**Dimension**
* Delivery
* Pursuits
* Arabic capability
* AI adoption
* Capability assets
* Growth
* Digital learning
* Utilisation


**Indicative measure**
* Support at least one significant learning or change workstream; deliver assigned outputs at first or second review with limited rework.
* Support at least 5 strategic pursuits and contribute substantive content to at least 3 proposal submissions, subject to pipeline volume.
* Demonstrate effective use of Arabic in agreed proposal, research, stakeholder or workshop activities.
* Demonstrate responsible AI\-assisted working in research, proposals or content; contribute to one AI\-enabled learning use case or accelerator.
* Create or materially improve at least 2 reusable assets, templates, credentials or case studies.
* Demonstrate working competence in at least one authoring or media tool and exposure to one learning platform or analytics tool.
* Complete agreed learning, change and AI development milestones and show progress toward Consultant readiness.
* Meet the approved grade utilisation target and agreed delivery/BD allocation, with targets calibrated to actual staffing.


**Evidence**
* Workplan, review records and engagement feedback.
* Pursuit tracker and proposal records.
* Practical assessment and work samples.
* Approved work samples, demo or use\-case record.
* Repository and reuse log.
* Skills assessment or project evidence.
* Development plan and certification record.
* Utilisation and resource reports.


**What Ey Offers**
* Exposure to live MENA learning, change, digital adoption and workforce capability programmes.
* A structured pathway across learning consulting, organisational change, AI\-enabled learning and consulting craft.
* Hands\-on experience with modern authoring tools, learning platforms, analytics and approved AI tools.
* Coaching from experienced consultants and the opportunity to shape a growing portfolio.
* A career path from Staff Consultant to broader workstream and solution ownership.


**Recruitment note:** 
 Arabic is a functional language requirement for this requisition and should be assessed consistently through a practical business exercise. Candidate selection must be based on role\-relevant skills and experience and not on nationality or ethnic origin.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:

**Adani Group** 
 : Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan\-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large scale infrastructure development in India with O \& M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.
   

  

**Adani Airports Holding Limited** 
 : Adani Airports Holding Limited is reshaping the aviation landscape, transforming airports into dynamic hubs of connectivity, innovation, and service excellence. By prioritizing passenger experience, leveraging state\-of\-the\-art technology, and enhancing operational efficiency, we are redefining airport infrastructure across India. Our vision is to create world\-class airports that serve as gateways to regional development and global connectivity, positioning Adani Airports as a leader in the aviation sector with a focus on sustainable growth and community impact.
   

  

**Job Purpose:**

 Assist the sales team in the execution of sales strategies and initiatives, providing administrative and logistical support.
   

  

 Prepare sales presentations, proposals, and contracts, ensuring accuracy and professionalism.

 Maintain regular communication with clients to address inquiries, provide support, and follow up on outstanding proposals.

**Data Management And Reporting**
 Track and maintain accurate records of sales activities, client interactions, and performance metrics.

**Sales Performance Tracking**
 Continuously monitor and analyze key sales performance metrics, such as revenue growth, conversion rates, and client acquisition costs, to assess the effectiveness of current sales strategies.
   

  

 Prepare detailed reports that highlight trends, identify areas for improvement, and provide actionable insights.
   

  

**Market Research**

 Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or related field.
   

  

**Work Experience**

title: Salesforce Lead
description:
**Company Overview**
 Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone is focused on building an employee\-first, performance\-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category\-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. The company specializes in providing solutions across Application Services and Consulting, Digital Product Engineering, Digital Workplace Services, Private Cloud Services, AI/Automation, and ServiceNow. Milestone culture is built to provide a collaborative, inclusive environment that supports employees and empowers them to reach their full potential.
   

  

 Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone’s best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short\-term and long\-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people\-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry\-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.
   

  

**Job Overview**
 We are seeking an experienced
 **Salesforce Lead** 
 to drive the design, development, and delivery of Salesforce solutions across the organization. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in
 **Salesforce Service Cloud** 
 and hands\-on experience with
 **Agentforce (Salesforce AI/Agent capabilities)** 
 , along with exposure to other Salesforce clouds. This role requires a blend of technical expertise, leadership skills, and stakeholder engagement.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead end\-to\-end Salesforce solution design and delivery for enterprise\-scale projects
* Architect and implement scalable solutions using Service Cloud and Agentforce
* Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions
* Provide technical leadership to development teams and ensure adherence to best practices
* Design and develop custom solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and integrations
* Drive implementation of AI\-driven automation and agent\-based workflows (Agentforce)
* Optimize Service Cloud features such as case management, knowledge base, omnichannel routing, and automation
* Ensure system performance, scalability, and security compliance
* Conduct code reviews, mentor junior developers, and enforce quality standards
* Integrate Salesforce with third\-party systems using APIs and middleware
* Stay updated with new Salesforce releases, especially in AI and automation capabilities


**Required Skills \& Qualifications**
* 9–12 years of IT experience, with 6\+ years in Salesforce
* Strong hands\-on experience with: Salesforce Service Cloud Agentforce / Einstein AI / Salesforce AI capabilities
* Expertise in: Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Web Components (LWC) Salesforce APIs and integrations (REST/SOAP) Data modeling and security model implementation
* Experience in designing scalable and high\-performance solutions
* Strong understanding of Salesforce platform limits and best practices
* Proven experience in leading teams and delivering complex Salesforce projects
* Excellent problem\-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with other Salesforce Clouds: Sales Cloud Experience Cloud Marketing Cloud Data Cloud
* Salesforce certifications (one or more): Salesforce Certified Application/Platform Architect Salesforce Certified Service Cloud Consultant Salesforce AI / Einstein\-related certifications
* Experience with DevOps tools (Copado, Gearset, CI/CD pipelines)
* Knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies


**Key Competencies**
* Leadership and mentorship
* Strategic thinking and solution architecture
* Strong communication and client\-facing skills
* Ability to drive innovation using AI\-driven Salesforce capabilities


**Compensation**
 Estimated Pay Range:
   

  

 Exact compensation and offers of employment are dependent on circumstances of each case and will be determined based on job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, licenses or certifications, and location.

title: Customised Travel Specialist
description:
**Company Description** 
 Gokhair Travel Innovations Pvt Ltd grew from a small travel company founded in 2012 in Calicut into a global travel curator with a strong international presence. The company designs customized travel experiences ranging from inbound medical tourism and healing retreats in the Alps to high\-impact corporate conclaves across Europe and China. Gokhair operates across India, the UAE, Saudi Arabia, and Hong Kong, working closely with trusted agent partners worldwide. The organization focuses on curating purposeful journeys that connect cultures, support organizations, and create lasting impressions. Team members join a culture driven by curiosity, bold thinking, and a commitment to meaningful travel experiences.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Customised Travel Specialist is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Kochi. This role involves designing tailored itineraries for individual and corporate clients, including medical, leisure, and business travel, aligned with client preferences and budgets. The specialist will manage end\-to\-end travel arrangements, coordinate with international and domestic partners, and ensure seamless execution of bookings, documentation, and logistics. Daily responsibilities include communicating with clients, understanding their needs, offering travel recommendations, and providing proactive updates before, during, and after trips. The role also involves handling customer queries, resolving issues, maintaining accurate records, and contributing ideas to improve travel products and client experiences.
 



**Qualifications** 



* Applicant should possess strong skills in Travel Arrangements and Travel Management, including itinerary planning, bookings, and coordination.
* Applicant
 
 should possess excellent Communication and Customer Service skills to interact effectively with diverse clients and partners.
* Applicant
 
 should possess experience in Business Travel planning, including corporate trips, events, and international travel logistics.
* 2 years minimum experience in the travel, hospitality, or tourism industry, ideally in customized or international travel solutions.
* Ability to work on\-site in Kochi, manage multiple client requirements, and handle time\-sensitive requests with attention to detail.
* Proficiency with travel booking tools, MS Office, and basic documentation for international travel; knowledge of medical or corporate travel is an advantage.
* Diploma or degree in Travel \& Tourism, Hospitality, Business, or a related field preferred, or equivalent practical experience.

title: Customer Engagement Executive
description:
**Company Description** 




 PurpleCode is a boutique HR consultancy that supports white\-collar businesses with end\-to\-end recruitment, HR consulting, and training solutions. The company specializes in helping startups and growing organizations hire effectively and build scalable people practices. Clients gain access to senior\-level HR expertise without the cost and complexity of maintaining a large in\-house HR team. PurpleCode emphasizes long\-term partnerships, tailored solutions, and a strong focus on quality and professionalism, creating a dynamic environment for team members to grow their skills.
 



**Role Description** 




 The Customer Engagement Executive is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Lokhandwala, Mumbai, working with one of PurpleCode's clients in the jewellery industry. This role focuses on connecting with customers, sharing new collections and offers, and building lasting relationships that keep customers engaged with the brand. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include reaching out to existing and prospective customers, inviting them to visit the showroom, and creating warm, memorable conversations that reflect the brand's premium positioning. The Customer Engagement Executive plays a key role in strengthening customer relationships and being part of a prestigious, trusted brand experience.
 



**Qualifications** 



* Good communication skills in English and Hindi; Marathi is a plus
* 1–3 years of experience in customer engagement, telecalling, customer service, or a similar client\-facing role
* Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build trust and rapport with customers, over calls and in person
* Comfortable making outbound calls to share new collections, offers, and showroom invitations
* Pleasant, professional communication style suited to a premium retail/jewellery brand
* Ability to work on\-site in Lokhandwala, Mumbai
* Prior experience in retail, jewellery, or luxury customer service is an advantage

title: Psychologist
description:
Psychologist
 
 Organization: Metro Mind Hospitals
 



 Location: Kalamassery, Ernakulam, Kerala
 



 Experience: Minimum 1 year of relevant experience
 



 Qualification: Master's degree in Psychology or a relevant discipline, based on the scope of the role and applicable professional requirements.
 



 Employment Type: Full\-time
 



  

  





**ABOUT THE ROLE** 




  





 Metro Mind Hospitals is looking for a compassionate, skilled, and responsible Psychologist to join our mental healthcare team. The candidate will support psychological assessment, patient counselling, therapeutic interventions within their qualifications and scope of practice, and coordinated patient care.
 



 The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills, clinical understanding, empathy, and the ability to work collaboratively with psychiatrists, psychologists, therapists, and other healthcare professionals.
   





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




  




* Conduct psychological assessments and clinical interviews within professional competence.
* Provide individual counselling and psychological interventions appropriate to the candidate's training and scope of practice.
* Support patients in understanding emotional, behavioural, and psychological concerns.
* Maintain accurate and confidential patient records and session documentation.
* Collaborate with psychiatrists, psychologists, and the multidisciplinary care team.
* Monitor patient progress and communicate relevant observations to the treatment team.
* Apply ethical principles, professional boundaries, and patient confidentiality.
* Participate in case discussions, team meetings, and relevant training programmes.
* Support patient and family psychoeducation where appropriate.
* Follow Metro Mind Hospitals' clinical procedures, documentation standards, and patient safety requirements.



**REQUIRED SKILLS** 




  




* Strong communication and active listening skills.
* Empathy, patience, and professional conduct.
* Basic understanding of psychological assessment and mental health conditions.
* Ability to maintain professional boundaries.
* Good documentation and reporting skills.
* Teamwork and coordination with healthcare professionals.
* Ability to handle sensitive patient interactions responsibly.



  





 🎓 Candidates from reputed psychology and mental health institutions are encouraged to apply.

title: CDP Engineer
description:
Kochi \| Bangalore
   

  

 Apply for this job
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Job Description**
* Configure and maintain CDP data models, audience/segment definitions, and identity resolution.
* Build and maintain CDP integrations with Databricks/Delta Lake (zero\-copy access patterns).
* Design and maintain event streaming integration using AWS MSK (Kafka), including external publishing.
* Build, configure, and maintain destination connectors to Adobe Campaign Classic (email), Airship (push), and Infobip (SMS).
* Build and support journeys/orchestration logic, including governance and suppression across overlapping member experiences.
* Support integration work for experimentation/personalization layers (e.g., Optimizely, Bloomreach) consuming CDP\-supplied segmentation.
* Build ingestion pipelines for engagement feedback loops (delivery/engagement events flowing back into Databricks).
* Scope and deliver platform enhancements as new use cases, channels, audiences, or business requirements emerge.
* Partner with product/marketing stakeholders to translate business requirements into CDP configuration and logic.
* Triage, troubleshoot, and resolve platform issues raised by business/marketing stakeholders (e.g., segment/audience errors, sync failures, journey/campaign delivery issues, data discrepancies).
* Perform root\-cause analysis on production issues and implement fixes or workarounds.
* Monitor platform health (sync jobs, journey runs, data freshness, audience counts) and proactively flag/address problems.
* Maintain documentation for platform configuration, data flows, API contracts, and known issues/resolutions.
* Participate in vendor working sessions to define technical requirements and surface product gaps.

* 5\+ years working directly in/on a CDP or similar MarTech data platform (configuration, activation, and support)
* Hands\-on experience with audience/segment building, identity resolution, and journey/orchestration tooling
* Strong Databricks and Delta Lake experience (Unity Catalog, data\-sharing connectivity)
* AWS experience, particularly MSK/Kafka.
* REST API integration experience with marketing execution platforms (ESP, push, SMS providers)
* Adobe Campaign Classic experience \- hands\-on with workflows, campaign/journey setup, and API\-based integration
* API\-first, composable architecture / connector\-based integration experience
* Experience implementing/maintaining a CDP Web SDK or similar client\-side event tracking SDK (JavaScript) for behavioral/event data capture
* Strong troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis skills; comfortable being a hands\-on point of contact for business\-reported issues
* Strong technical skills


 Support CDP (Customer Data Platform) as part of the Personalization Program covering platform configuration, audience/segmentation build, journey/orchestration support, integrations, enhancements, and ongoing production support. title: Associate III - Cloud Infrastructure Services
description:
**Role Description**
 We are seeking a highly motivated and technically proficient AWS Cloud Engineer with 4–7 years of hands\-on experience in AWS cloud infrastructure, production support, and incident management. The ideal candidate should possess strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex infrastructure and application issues while ensuring high availability, reliability, and security of cloud environments. This role requires close collaboration with cross\-functional teams to support, optimize, and continuously improve cloud infrastructure and operational excellence.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Design, deploy, manage, and support AWS cloud infrastructure in production environments.
* Monitor system availability, performance, and security to ensure reliable service delivery.
* Troubleshoot and resolve infrastructure, networking, and application\-related issues across AWS environments.
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for production incidents and implement preventive measures.
* Manage and support containerized workloads using Amazon ECS and Docker.
* Configure and maintain AWS networking components including VPC, Route 53, Load Balancers, Security Groups, and Network ACLs.
* Support CI/CD deployments and collaborate with development teams for application releases.
* Implement infrastructure automation using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools where applicable.
* Monitor infrastructure using CloudWatch and other enterprise monitoring solutions.
* Ensure adherence to cloud security best practices, compliance standards, and operational procedures.
* Prepare and maintain technical documentation, standard operating procedures, and knowledge articles.
* Participate in production support activities, incident response, maintenance windows, and on\-call rotations as required.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 4–7 years of hands\-on experience managing AWS cloud environments.
* Strong experience supporting production workloads in AWS.
* Excellent troubleshooting, analytical, and problem\-solving skills.
* Good understanding of cloud networking concepts and Linux system administration.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to work effectively in cross\-functional teams.


**Skills**
 AWS, AWS CloudFormation, AWS Security Groups, Amazon CloudWatch, Access Control Lists, Amazon ECS, Amazon Route 53, Amazon VPC, CI/CD, Cloud Infrastructure, Cloud Security

title: GMS-Staff-SSO-MFA
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**GDS – IAM MS– Staff**
 The SSO \& Access Management Staff are responsible for supporting the day\-to\-day operations of enterprise Single Sign\-On (SSO) and Access Management platforms. This role involves application onboarding, incident and request management, user access administration, authentication troubleshooting, and platform monitoring activities.
   

  

 The individual will work with leading access management technologies such as Okta, PingFederate, Ping One, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), and related authentication and federation solutions, while ensuring secure and reliable access to enterprise applications.
   

  

**Key Requirements / Responsibilities:**
* Support the administration and maintenance of enterprise SSO and Access Management platforms including Okta, PingFederate or similar technologies.
* Provide L2/L2\.5 operational support for authentication, authorization, SSO, MFA, and access\-related incidents and requests.
* Assist with the management of user identities and organization groups within the Okta or Ping platform, ensuring accurate and timely provisioning and deprovisioning of access rights.
* Participate in the integration of new applications into the SSO environment, working closely with application owners and IT teams to ensure seamless Single Sign\-On (SSO) functionality.
* Monitor SSO system performance and logs to proactively identify and address potential issues before they impact users.
* Contribute to the development and maintenance of policy documentation, user guides, and training materials to support end\-users and promote best practices.
* Engage in regular security reviews and audits of SSO configurations to ensure alignment with industry standards and compliance requirements.
* Support the implementation of Multi\-Factor Authentication (MFA) policies across the organization to enhance security posture.
* Collaborate with IT and security teams to refine and enforce access control policies, ensuring the principle of least privilege is maintained.
* Assist in the resolution of tickets and service requests related to Okta or Ping Federate, prioritizing based on impact and urgency.
* Keep abreast of new SSO features and updates, participating in relevant training and knowledge\-sharing sessions to maintain expertise in the platform.
* Provide feedback and suggestions to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the SSO service, including automation opportunities.


**Preferred Skills:**
* Good understanding of identity and access management concepts.
* Strong desire to learn and develop skills in IAM operations and cloud security.
* Good problem\-solving abilities and attention to detail.
* Effective communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively within a team environment
* Extensive experience in IAM operations, with a strong focus on Okta, Ping Federate or related technologies
* Knowledge of federation protocols – SAML, OAuth \& OpenID
* Understanding of IAM concepts, cloud security, and operational best practices.


**Education:**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.


**Work Requirements:**
* Willingness to be on call support engineer and work occasional overtime as required
* Willingness to work in rotational shifts as required
* Willingness to travel as required


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Platform Engineer
description:
**The Role** 




 As a Platform Engineer in the Data \& Analytics team, you’ll sit at the vital intersection between software engineering and infrastructure. Your mission is to ensurethat the systemswe build are not only functional, but also resilient, observable, performant, and production ready.
 



 You’ll work closely with engineers, architects, and the central infrastructure team to design and support the environments, tooling, and operational practicesthat power our data platform.From CI/CD pipelines to database performance tuning, observability, and scaling strategy — you’ll be the expert who helps us build mechanical sympathy between our code and the systems it runs on.
 



 This is a hands\-on, enablingrole ideal for someone who loves helpingteams ship great software safelyand reliably.
 



  





  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own and evolve the CI/CD pipelines for the Data Platform, supporting fast, safe, and repeatable deployments.
* Enhance observability across services, pipelines, and data flows, supporting logs, metrics, tracing, and alerts.
* Monitor and optimize databaseperformance, availability, and access patterns.
* Collaborate with Infrastructure teamsto ensure HA, disaster recovery, and scaling strategies are in place and well understood.
* Partner with engineers to define best practices for environment management, secrets, configuration, and infrastructure\-as\-code.
* Support the team in diagnosing and resolving production issues and in building systemsthat are easier to debug and maintain.
* Identify and reduce operational friction, creating tools or automations where needed to improve reliability and developer velocity.



  





  





 Essential Criteria
 



  




* Strong experience working with CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure, and application performance tooling.
* Practical knowledge of observability stacks— including metrics,logs, dashboards, and alerting.
* Hands\-on experience with databases(e.g. PostgreSQL, SQL Server, or cloud\-native DBs), including monitoring and tuning.
* Familiarity with cloud environments (preferably AWS), containerization, and infrastructure\-as\-code tools (e.g. Terraform, CloudFormation).
* A collaborative mindset, able to work across engineering and infrastructure teamsto solve shared problems.
* Passion for enabling others,improving developer experience, and building reliablesystems.



  





  





 Desirable Criteria
 


* Experience supporting data pipelines, analytics platforms, or distributed systems at scale.
* Familiarity with data management frameworks (e.g. AWS Glue, Temporal) and performance profiling in data\-intensive environments.
* Exposure to monitoring tools such as CloudWatch, Grafana,Datadog, Prometheus, or OpenTelemetry.
* Understanding of security best practices relatedto data platforms, secrets management, and access control.
* Knowledge of container orchestration and serverless deployment patterns (e.g. ECS, Fargate, Lambda).



  





  





 What We Offer
 


* A unique opportunity to shape the operational backboneof our company’s data platform.
* A collaborative engineering culturewhere operational excellence is valued and supported.
* The freedom to improvehow things are built, deployed,and run with real impact.
* A close partnership with experienced engineersand infrastructure specialists.
* A modern, cloud\-native stackand a platform that’s scalingrapidly.

title: Engineering Systems Support Analyst
description:
**Job Description**
 The role focuses on supporting Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) systems and related engineering applications, ensuring data integrity, system reliability, and efficient operation across integrated business platforms. Responsibilities include application support, data analysis, SQL reporting, troubleshooting, documentation, process improvement, and collaboration with engineering, IT, and business stakeholders.
   

  

 The analyst will work closely with design engineers, product development teams, IT professionals, and third\-party vendors to resolve technical issues, improve system performance, and support engineering processes. Candidates should enjoy problem solving, working with data, learning new technologies, and supporting enterprise applications within an engineering and manufacturing environment. As experience grows, the role will progress toward ownership of engineering systems, business processes, and system improvement initiatives.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Provide technical support for PLM systems and associated engineering applications across multiple business units and engineering disciplines.
* Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve application, system, and data\-related issues while ensuring minimal disruption to engineering operations.
* Write, maintain, and execute SQL queries to support reporting, data validation, data reconciliation, and engineering business processes.
* Monitor and maintain data integrity, accuracy, and consistency across PLM and integrated enterprise systems.
* Support engineering teams in the effective use of engineering systems, business applications, and product data management processes.
* Assist in analysing engineering and product data to identify discrepancies, investigate root causes, and recommend corrective actions.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders and third\-party vendors to gather requirements, support projects, and resolve technical issues.
* Support system enhancements, upgrades, testing activities, and implementation of process improvements.
* Contribute to the development and maintenance of reports, dashboards, validation tools, and business intelligence outputs that support engineering operations.
* Assist with administration and routine maintenance activities for Windows Server environments supporting engineering applications.
* Produce and maintain technical documentation, user guides, process documentation, test reports, release notes, and technical specifications.
* Support user training activities and assist in developing subject matter expertise within engineering and business teams.
* Take ownership of assigned tasks and support activities, proactively driving issues through resolution while communicating progress, risks, and recommendations to stakeholders.
* Ensure compliance with company procedures, quality standards, and engineering governance requirements.
* The successful candidate will work under guidance of Senior Analyst, who will oversee their workload and scheduling.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in information systems, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Software Engineering, Engineering Technology, or a related discipline.
* Master's degree in information systems, Software Engineering, Engineering, or a related subject is preferred.
* 1\-3 years of experience supporting business applications, enterprise systems, engineering systems, or technical software platforms, with hands\-on experience using SQL for reporting, data analysis, data validation, and troubleshooting data\-related issues.
* Understanding of relational database concepts, data structures, and relationships between enterprise systems.
* Exposure to enterprise platforms such as PLM, ERP, Product Data Management (PDM), Document Management, CAD, or similar engineering systems is preferred.
* Familiarity with technologies such as Microsoft SQL Server, VB.NET, ASP.NET, Visual Studio, JSON, XML, XSLT, ODBC databases, and Web Services is advantageous.
* Basic knowledge of Windows Server environments, application hosting platforms, and system administration concepts.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to investigate and resolve technical and data\-related issues.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across engineering, business, and IT teams.
* Demonstrates ownership by taking responsibility for issues, following through on actions, and driving tasks to completion.
* Shows curiosity and initiative by continuously learning new systems, technologies, and business processes.
* Communicates proactively, builds positive working relationships, and effectively collaborates with internal stakeholders and external partners.
* Produces accurate, well\-documented, and maintainable solutions while maintaining a high standard of quality.
* Approaches challenges with professionalism, persistence, and a customer\-focused mindset.
* Experience within an engineering, manufacturing, industrial, or operational environment is desirable.


**About Us**
 Every day, the oil and gas industry’s best minds put more than 150 years of experience to work to help our customers achieve lasting success.
   

  

**We Power the Industry that Powers the World**
 Throughout every region in the world and across every area of drilling and production, our family of companies has provided the technical expertise, advanced equipment, and operational support necessary for success—now and in the future.
   

  

**Global Family**
 We are a global family of thousands of individuals, working as one team to create a lasting impact for ourselves, our customers, and the communities where we live and work.
   

  

**Purposeful Innovation**
 Through purposeful business innovation, product creation, and service delivery, we are driven to power the industry that powers the world better.
   

  

**Service Above All**
 This drives us to anticipate our customers’ needs and work with them to deliver the finest products and services on time and on budget.

title: EDI Support Analyst
description:
**Job Description**
 The EDI Support Analyst will be responsible for supporting NOV’s electronic data interchange (EDI) and business\-to\-business (B2B) integrations within the Shared Services organization. This position focuses on production support, customer onboarding, and project coordination to ensure stable and efficient data exchange between NOV and its trading partners. The role requires a balance of technical acumen, communication skills, and process discipline to drive seamless integration, issue resolution, and continuous improvement across NOV’s EDI/B2B landscape.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Provide day\-to\-day production support for EDI/B2B transactions, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and issue resolution.
* Monitor and troubleshoot EDI transaction failures and coordinate with internal teams and external partners to resolve them promptly.
* Support onboarding of new customers and suppliers to NOV’s EDI/B2B platforms.
* Partner with business users and ERP technical teams to analyze integration requirements and implement new EDI/B2B connections.
* Coordinate testing, documentation, and deployment of EDI/B2B enhancements or projects.
* Maintain transaction performance reports and support continuous improvement initiatives to enhance system reliability and data quality.
* Document and maintain partner profiles and process flows.
* Collaborate with Shared Services, Operations, and external trading partners to ensure alignment in business processes and system capabilities.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in information systems, Computer Science, Business, or a related field.
* 2–3 years of hands\-on experience in EDI/B2B integration, including production support and project coordination.
* Working knowledge of EDI standards (e.g., ANSI X12, EDIFACT, XML) and related transaction sets.
* Familiarity with integration of middleware tools (e.g., BizTalk, or equivalent).
* Familiarity with supply chain transactions like RFQ/Quote/PO/SO/Ship Notice/Invoice etc.
* Experience managing incident tickets and change requests (Jira, or similar).
* Strong communication, problem\-solving, and analytical skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively across teams and manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Experience with customer/vendor onboarding and production support in a supply chain environment.
* Exposure to Shared Services or global IT support functions.
* Understanding of ERP integrations, preferably Oracle PO/SO/Ship/Invoice modules.

**Role Overview**
 We are seeking experienced and hands\-on Senior Infrastructure Automation Engineers (DevSecOps) with strong proficiency in Azure and Kubernetes to design, provision, automate, secure, and support scalable multicloud infrastructure for enterprise workloads.
   

  

 The role requires deep expertise in Infrastructure as Code with Terraform, container orchestration on Kubernetes, automated CI/CD pipeline engineering, Python\-based infrastructure automation, and embedding security controls across the build, deploy, and run lifecycle, with a strong focus on reliability, compliance, cost\-awareness, and delivery quality.

* Strong expertise in Terraform — module development, state management, multi\-environment patterns, and integration with policy\-as\-code frameworks.
* Proven experience designing and operating CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent, including pipeline security and supply\-chain controls.
* Strong proficiency in Python for infrastructure automation, tooling, and integration; working knowledge of Bash / Shell scripting.
* Solid grounding in cloud security — IAM, network segmentation, encryption, secrets management, vulnerability management, and DevSecOps tooling (e.g., Trivy, Checkov, tfsec, SonarQube, Snyk, Aqua / Prisma Cloud).
* Good understanding of cloud networking, hybrid connectivity, load balancing, observability, logging, and access controls.
* Demonstrated experience troubleshooting complex infrastructure issues, deployment failures, distributed systems, and performance bottlenecks.
* Strong awareness of cloud governance, compliance frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2, CIS Benchmarks), cost optimization, and operational best practices.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, documentation, collaboration, and stakeholder communication skills.

* B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.

* Strong commitment to continuous learning and staying current with cloud, DevSecOps, Kubernetes, and platform engineering practices.

* Exposure to GCP and broader multi\-cloud operating models.
* Experience with policy\-as\-code and guardrails (OPA / Gatekeeper, Kyverno, Azure Policy, Sentinel).
* Experience with service mesh, GitOps tooling (ArgoCD, Flux), and progressive delivery patterns.
* Experience with monitoring and observability stacks such as Prometheus, Grafana, Azure Monitor, CloudWatch, ELK, Datadog, or Dynatrace.
* Experience with Azure Cost Management, AWS Cost Explorer, tagging strategies, and FinOps practices.
* Exposure to platform engineering, internal developer platforms (IDP), release management, and SRE practices.


**Working Expectations**
